We provide reasonable accommodations for qualified applicants with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs.

title: Head of Creative (Remote US)
description:
**Directive Consulting** is the leading B2B marketing agency for companies that are done optimizing for metrics that don't move the business. With over a decade of expertise and 420+ B2B brands behind us, we know what real results look like. We operate through 3 divisions: **Performance, Communications, and Commerce,** each built to share intelligence and align on revenue. Our methodology, **DiscoverabilityOS**, aligns brand and demand to guide your ICP to choose you across every decision point. Across Technology, Industrial, and Services verticals, that system spans everything from Paid Media and **Content** Marketing to PR and Paid Social to Marketplace and Lifecycle Marketing.

At Directive, we're always looking to connect with talented people who care about work that actually counts. As we grow across all 3 divisions, we're seeking forward-thinking people who thrive in fast-paced environments, are obsessed with analytics and storytelling, and are ready to make their mark doing B2B marketing that actually means something.

**THE ROLE**

We're looking for a Head of Creative to lead our Performance Design department — a team that sits at the intersection of creative craft and performance marketing. In this role, you will often wear two different “hats”. You'll be equally responsible for the strategic & financial direction of the department and the day-to-day development of the people and work within it. You'll inherit a team with strong momentum, an established methodology, and a clear positioning — and your job is to scale it.

This role reports to senior leadership and manages the full Performance Design team, including designers, project management, and motion contractors.

**Creative Leadership & Output**

* Own the creative vision and quality standard for the Performance Design department
* Ensure all work meets both craft and conversion benchmarks — great looking and built to perform
* Review and elevate creative across paid social, display, video, and landing page formats
* Build systems and workflows that help support excellent creative output for our clients both internally and externally.
* Ensure we’re running campaigns vs. ads
* Ensure we are testing & learning
* Partner with Directive senior leadership to develop our unique and ownable creative process that supports DiscoverabilityOS

**People Management & Team Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary team of designers and motion contractors
* Set clear expectations, foster accountability, and build a culture where creative people do their best work
* Identify growth opportunities for team members and actively invest in their development

**Strategy & Client Partnership**

* Partner closely with paid media and client success teams to ensure the creative is data-informed from the start
* Represent the department in new business pitches, cross-sell opportunities, and client conversations. While you will not be client-facing from a day-to-day perspective with our clients, you will be expected to meet with them monthly during leadership meetings to discuss quality & results.
* Articulate the value of Performance Design as a strategic capability, not just an execution function.

**Financial Ownership**

* Own and manage the department P&L - helping to make all budgeting decisions around staffing, tech investments, and other investments for the department.
* Monitor margins, manage resourcing decisions with financial impact in mind, and ensure the department operates as a profitable, scalable business unit with monthly revenue targets and direct margin goals.

**AI & Technology Integration**

* Lead adoption of AI creative tools across the team
* Identify where emerging technologies can sharpen output and improve efficiency
* Build AI into real production workflows — not just as a proof of concept

**WHAT YOU OFFER**

**Experience & Background**

* 5+ years in creative roles within performance marketing, paid media, or growth-focused agency environments
* Proven track record in managing creative teams and balancing creative quality with business outcomes
* Comfortable presenting department strategy and financial projections to VPs and CMOs, just as much as reviewing a creative brief

**Business Acumen**

* Strong understanding of how a creative department operates as a business
* Direct experience managing or having visibility into P&L, margin, and resourcing decisions
* You think like an owner and make decisions with financial impact in mind

**AI & Tools**

* Hands-on experience with AI creative tools — generative image, AI-powered video, design analytics, or similar
* Knows how to integrate AI into real production workflows, not just demo it
* Experience with platforms like EyeQuant, Creatify, or Superside is a plus

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* Strong communicator with executive presence who can translate creative thinking into business language
* Track record of building trust with both creative practitioners and senior leadership

**What Success Looks Like:**

In the first 90 days, you've built strong relationships across the team and key internal stakeholders, identified gaps in methodology and workflow, and begun making your mark on the department's output.

Within six months, you're running the department with full confidence — driving creative quality, owning margin targets, making smart resourcing decisions, and positioning Performance Design as a competitive differentiator in new business conversations.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* We have a set living wage at Directive; The annual base salary range for this position based in the US is $160,000-$185,000 USD. This salary range is an estimate, and the actual salary may vary based on Directive's compensation practices, job related skills, and depth of experience.
* Medical, dental, vision plans, disability, and life insurance coverage for you and your family that fit your lifestyle

  + Including a 100% employer-paid plan for you and a 50% employer contribution for your dependents
* Benefits to Support the Whole Person:

  + Mental - Access to certified therapists through Spring Health, membership to Headspace
  + Physical - Physical therapy through Omada, fertility support through Carrott, thousands of Aaptiv virtual workouts, complimentary One Medical membership for primary and virtual care
  + Time Off - Unlimited PTO (2-week minimum), Paid Company Holidays, Your Birthday Off, End of Year Recharge (Closed December 24 - January 1), Paid Parental Leave
  + Financial - Traditional and Roth 401(k) with a 3% company match
  + Bonus - Annual bonus based on tenure, which scales in total amount over time

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

Directive is a remote-first company. This role operates 100% virtually from your home office. We collaborate through Zoom and Slack. You will need a reliable setup, high-speed internet, and a professional working environment capable of running Adobe Creative Suite and video production software without interruption.

We accommodate global candidates in markets where Directive has established business operations, including Canada, Mexico, and the UK. Current, permanent work authorization in that country is required. Due to the nature of this role, you must be able to remain stationary for extended periods, operate design and video software on Mac or PC, and observe and interpret written and verbal communication consistently. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities — contact recruiting@directiveconsulting.com.

**ADDITIONAL INFORMATION**

At Directive, one of our core values is People First. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture in the digital landscape. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you require reasonable accommodations in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to recruiting@directiveconsulting.com.

title: Design Director, Brand
description:
**About AlphaSense**
AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.
  
  
**Location:**
New York or San Francisco preferred, open to remote within the US
  
  
**About The Team**
The AlphaSense Brand Team is a creative powerhouse composed of great talent across copywriting, brand design, advertising & filmmaking. This team of creative technologists help drive the innovation, conceptual storytelling, execution & delivery of our brand and products each & every day. At our core, we're here as a partner to the broader business – which we do by identifying customer problems, understanding market needs, & inventing ways to deliver world class brand experiences.
  
  
**About The Role**
As the
**Design Director**
on the AlphaSense Brand & Creative team, you own the strategic and conceptual pull-through of our brand — translating who AlphaSense is into ideas, design systems, and experiences that show up everywhere the company does. You set the creative vision and the standard of craft for the design discipline, and you're a leader-doer: you direct from inside the work, getting your hands on it when an idea demands it. This is a defining moment for the brand. As the market shifts from an information economy to a reasoning economy, it's racing toward a shortcut — assuming that wiring a model up to more tools and more sources adds up to intelligence. AlphaSense exists to prove otherwise: access isn't intelligence, and the question that matters isn't “Can it connect?” but “Can I trust it?” You'll be the one who makes that argument — connected isn't intelligent — look and feel as undeniable as the platform makes it true.
  
  
This role is equal parts vision and craft, leadership and making. You'll shape the creative direction for our most significant brand investments — campaigns, product storytelling, OOH, social, web, and events — then build the team and systems that let that work scale without losing its edge. You'll mentor and grow the design team alongside the Design Manager, while partnering across PMM, Product, Web, and Comms, and directing agency and production partners, to align stakeholders behind brave ideas. Your north star: take the highest-stakes ideas in enterprise intelligence — trust, evidence, judgment under pressure — and make them clear, human, and impossible to ignore.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* A Proven Creative Leader: 10+ years in brand and creative design, with a portfolio that shows range across campaigns, brand systems, and high-craft execution — and a track record of leading teams to do the best work of their careers.
* A Leader-Doer: You set the vision and the bar, but you stay in the work. You direct from inside it and get hands-on when an idea needs your hand — not from a distance.
* Ideas-First: You lead with concept. You can take an abstract, technical idea — like enterprise market intelligence — and find the visual metaphor that makes it land for a sophisticated audience.
* A Builder of Teams & Culture: You've managed and mentored designers (including through other managers), shaped roles, grown careers, and cultivated a creative culture of transparency, connectedness, and inspiration.
* A Systems Thinker: You think in systems and scale — building design languages and ways of working that keep the brand consistent as it grows while still leaving room to surprise.
* A Trusted Cross-Functional Partner: You build deep relationships across PMM, Product, Web/Growth, and Comms, influence senior stakeholders, and can win support and alignment for ambitious, high-stakes work.
* Fluent in Complex & Enterprise Storytelling: You've made technical, B2B, or otherwise “dry” subject matter feel anything but boring, ideally for expert or executive audiences.
* Strategically Grounded: You balance creative ambition with clarity, strategy, and business outcomes, and you thrive in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities and a fair amount of ambiguity.

**What You’ll Do**

* Help Drive the Design Vision: Define and evolve the creative direction for the AlphaSense brand across campaigns, product storytelling, OOH, social, web, and events — ensuring a cohesive, elevated, unmistakably-AlphaSense expression at every touchpoint.
* Lead Idea-Centric Work: Drive the strategic and conceptual pull-through of big ideas from brief through execution, setting the bar for craft and originality on our most visible, highest-stakes brand investments.
* Hands-On: The team is lean, so using your own design thinking and execution to make the work when the moment calls for it is imperative — you direct from inside the work, not from a distance.
* Build & Grow the Team: Lead, mentor, and develop the brand design team in partnership with the Design Manager — shaping roles, raising the craft bar, growing careers, and keeping morale and creative culture high.
* Partner Across Functions: Build deep, productive relationships across creative functions (copy, art direction, production, film) as well as marketing functions (PMM, Product, Web/Growth, and Comms) and lead agency and production partners when the time calls for it — aligning stakeholders and securing support to move ambitious work forward.
* Evolve the System: Develop and steward the AlphaSense design system and visual language so the brand scales with consistency while still leaving room to surprise.
* Push Product Integration: Find innovative ways to bring the product into the brand story, demonstrating the full creative potential of the platform.
* Develop Deep Product & Market Fluency: Build a thorough understanding of the AlphaSense platform, our customers, and the broader B2B enterprise landscape so the work reflects real product value, use cases, and buyer context — not just surface-level aesthetics.

Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.

title: Regional Patient Care Manager
description:
**Company Description**

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

**Why join us?**

Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now *and* build for long-term success.

**Job Description**

**How will you make an impact?**  
**Job Purpose**

As Patient Care Regional Manager, you will be the people manager and operational lead for Patient Care teams in your assigned European markets. You will own team performance, quality reviews, and day-to-day operations — while working closely with Country Managers and the Global Patient Care Head to align on priorities and ensure service consistency across markets.

You will be the missing link between global standards and local execution: someone who can read data, give direct feedback, run a tight operational cadence, and genuinely develop the people on your team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**People Management**

* Own performance reviews, 1:1s, and development conversations for direct reports across your markets
* Manage absence, availability, and team sizing for your region
* Lead hiring decisions and internal mobility within the Patient Care team
* Build a culture of direct feedback and consistent follow-through

**Operational Performance**

* Track and own regional KPIs: response SLA, first-contact resolution, CSAT, and quality scores
* Run quality review and moderation programs — calibration sessions, rubric definition, feedback loops
* Identify performance trends using dashboards and reports; translate them into concrete actions
* Own escalation protocols for complex patient cases

**Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Country Managers to align on priorities, workload, and service commitments
* Work with the Product/PATS team on tooling rollouts, workflow automation, and process improvements
* Contribute to the monthly Patient Voice reporting — classified ticket analysis, actionable issue surfacing
* Act as regional interface for global policy rollouts and operational changes

**Qualifications**

**What will help you thrive?**

**Must-haves**

* 5+ years in customer support, patient experience, or service operations — with at least 2 years managing people
* Experience managing teams across multiple countries in Europe (not just one market)
* Strong people instincts: direct, empathetic, consistent — someone teams trust and grow under
* Data-driven: comfortable with dashboards, pulling operational reports, and making decisions from numbers
* Experience running quality review or moderation programs (calibration, rubric design, scoring)
* Fluency in English mandatory
* Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Jira, Notion, or similar)

**Nice to have**

* Background in healthtech, marketplace, or two-sided platforms
* Experience working with AI-assisted support tools or automation workflows
* Familiarity with Intercom, Zendesk, or equivalent support tooling
* SQL knowledge or comfort querying data independently
* Experience onboarding a new org structure or consolidating teams
* Strong plus — Spanish, Italian, Polish, or German language speaker.

**What to Expect from Our Hiring Process**

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

**Intro Chat** – A first call with our Talent Partner to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

**Hiring Manager Interview** – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with your Hiring Manager and your potential manager in this role**.** Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

**Business Case –** A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings.

**Additional/ Final Interview (Optional)** – A final conversation with another senior stakeholder from our Global Team.

**References & Offer!**

**Why You’ll Love It Here**

**Global Benefits –** No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:

* Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
* Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
* Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.

**Local Perks –** Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

**Career Growth –** We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

**A Truly Global Team –** Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

**Flexibility That Works for You –** Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

*Please note:*At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

**What We Believe In**

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

**Focus on results –** we're here to make an impact.

**Think like an owner –** take responsibility, drive outcomes.

**Keep it simple, keep it lean –** smart solutions over complexity.

**Be respectful and radically honest –** openness builds trust.

**Learn and be curious –** growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

U. S. Citizens

  

**Duties**
----------

* You will be responsible for Gas Turbine troubleshooting and repair work for forces afloat.
* You will provide technical assistance for urgent mission-degrading Casualty Reports (CASREPS) or requests for technical assistance affecting assigned subsystems, frequently at Temporary Duty (TDY) locations.
* You will provide authoritative technical/engineering guidance to Naval Sea Systems Command (NAVSEA) activities and port engineers in resolution of repair/overhaul or test/grooming problems beyond their level of in-house engineering expertise.
* You will perform special engineering analyses and studies in support of Naval Sea System Command or in service engineering agent (ISEA) for the purpose of developing or evaluating improvements in design, maintenance procedures, material, etc.
* You will perform functional checkout, assessment, adjustment, and test of new or modernized shipboard systems in a systems qualifications test environment, in which you have responsibility for operation of major Gas Turbine and associated systems.
* You will evaluate through research and testing the compatibility and interoperability of currently installed and planned installations of Gas Turbines and associated system components onboard afloat units.
* You will provide and communicate risk-based analysis of impact to ship, required risk mitigations, operational restrictions, monitoring requirements, and risk assessment.
* You will comprehend all requirements supporting their responsible equipment requirements to include, but not limited to, technical manuals, system drawings, parts support, class advisories, naval messages, etc.
* You will utilize resources and tools for collection and analysis of data representative of the material condition of Gas Turbines onboard afloat units, including but not limited to borescope units and laser alignment tooling.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Conditions of employment**

* Must be a US Citizen. Must be determined suitable for federal employment. Must participate in the direct deposit pay program.

* May be required to obtain a VISA dependent on the overseas country's laws/regulations.
* You will be required to sign the Statement of Understanding for Overseas Employment acknowledging receipt and understanding of the statement of living and working conditions for this location.
* You will be required to successfully complete a pre-appointment physical examination.
* You will be required to obtain and maintain an interim and/or final security clearance prior to entrance on duty. Failure to obtain and maintain the required level of clearance may result in the withdrawal of a job offer or removal.
* You will be required to complete training, obtain, and maintain a government credit card for travel and travel-related purchases.
* This position may require travel from normal duty station to CONUS and OCONUS and may include remote or isolated sites. You must be able to travel on military and commercial aircraft for extended periods of time.

* This position requires a certification of Marine Gas Turbine Inspector (MGTI) certification.

### **Qualifications**

Your resume must also demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-11 grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector.
  
Specialized experience must demonstrate the following:
  
1) Providing technical services and support of major systems and equipment specific to Marine Gas Turbine engines and generators.
  
2) Performing testing and inspections of shipboard marine gas turbine systems or equipment to determine material condition and state of operability.
  
3) Identifying and resolving repair/overhaul or test/grooming problems affecting the overall system.
  
4) Conducting engineering analyses and studies for the purpose of developing or evaluating improvements in design, maintenance, safety and operation of assigned equipment/systems.

This announcement uses the Certain Personnel of the DoD direct hire authority to recruit and appoint qualified candidates to positions in the competitive service.

There is no education requirement for this position.

title: Senior Product Designer (m/f/d)
description:
### **About Hilo by Aktiia**

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

### **Role overview**

UX is our number one priority. As a Series B scale-up, we are investing heavily in the product experience, and you will be central to it. You will own our biggest new product bets: new features, health insights and early vision work across the app. You will bring ideas to life fast, with polished high-fidelity prototypes and motion, then take them to a shipped result.

You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. Alongside you are a Lead Product Designer and a Lead UX Writer, who keep the whole product consistent and high quality.

You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft.

Location: Fully remote, open to candidates across the UK and Europe.

### **Core responsibilities**

### **Ownership & Outcomes**

* Own your product areas from first idea to shipped result.
* Set the measures for your work and own whether it succeeds.
* Turn research, feedback and data into clear decisions.

### **Prototyping & Design**

* Spin up working prototypes with AI tools and our design system, not just static screens.

### **Collaboration & Continuity**

* Work daily with design engineers and product managers, and unblock them fast.
* Take over existing product design work and keep quality high.

 **Requirements**

### **Background & Experience**

### **Essential**

* Senior product design experience, ideally in health, consumer, behavior change or regulated products.
* 1 to 3 shipped case studies that show the problem, your role, your decisions and the measurable impact.
* Strong UX and UI craft: visual hierarchy, typography, motion and attention to detail.
* High-fidelity prototypes you can screen-share and walk through (Figma, AI tools such as Claude or Lovable).
* Daily, practical use of AI tools, and enthusiasm for trying new ones.
* Fluent Figma, including components, variables and tokens.
* Close work with engineers, and clear, short communication.
* A public portfolio website (required with your application).

### **Nice to Have**

* AI-ready design systems, mobile apps, connected devices, simple prototypes in code.

### **How you work**

* AI first — You'd rather show a working thing than describe one.
* Builder — You ship, starting from nothing if you have to.
* Bias for action — You don't need to be told what to do or be chased. You spot what could go wrong, pick the one that matters most and fix it.
* Disciplined — Tokens, not screenshots. Decision logs, not memories.
* Curious — You want to know why, not just what.
* Clear under pressure — Medical regulation and different market rules are design problems, not excuses.

### **This isn't for you if**

* You need a finished brief, all the requirements or all the research before you start.
* You measure screens shipped, not outcomes moved.
* You'd rather list risks than own one.

### **How we hire**

* Recruiter screen (30 min)
* Portfolio interview with the Head of Design (60 min)
* Product thinking and interaction design deep dive
* Cross-functional conversation with design engineers and product
* Final conversation with senior leadership

### **What success looks like**

* You take something off our plate and it gets done.
* If it won't happen, you tell us first.
* You bring the problem, the root cause and options.
* You flag risk to dates early, while we can still change it.

  
**Benefits**

### **What Makes You A Great Fit**

**At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:**

**Move the Needle** — You focus on what drives real impact. You understand that a great product experience is fundamental to good decision-making and growth, and you take accountability for the quality and outcomes of your work, from first idea through to shipped result.

**Move Fast, Learn, Refine** — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with craft. You continuously improve the way Design operates, experiment with better tools and processes, including AI, and solve root causes rather than accepting repetitive manual work.

**Team First** — You collaborate effectively with colleagues, engineers, product managers and stakeholders across countries and functions. You build trust by being reliable, clear and constructive, while maintaining high standards for quality and consistency.

### **Why Join Us?**

* Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story.
* Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
* Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
* Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team.
* Competitive compensation and equity program, and other benefits (depending on location).

### **Ready to Move the Needle?**

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

The mechanical design engineer will primarily support the hydraulic + passive mechanical braking systems through the entire life cycle from conceptual design through detailed design and development, testing, qualification, manufacturing, and installed fleet support. The engineer will drive technical excellence and continuous improvement in the design, analysis, cost, and reliability of the components under their responsibility.

**Job Description**
===================

**Essential Responsibilities**

You will:

* Execute projects pertaining to new product introduction, new technology integration, and field issue resolution with a heavy focus on quality and reliability verified by physical testing
* Be responsible for designing yaw system components for wind turbines focusing on hydraulic pressure unit (HPU) systems, yaw bearings, yaw drives, and yaw brakes encompassing component design, system interaction, and system reliability
* Hold ownership of and drive lessons learned, best practices, and standardization into design related documentation such as design practices, drawings, and technical specifications
* Responsible for design, development of testing/validation plans to prove component function and reliability
* Provide innovative design solutions to meet aggressive timing, product cost, and reliability targets
* Ensure quality of new and revised drawings, BoMs, and specifications applying all GEV and industry processes, standards, and best practices
* Work cross functionally, developing strong relationships with quality teams, manufacturing engineers, sourcing, suppliers, field support, and others to improve product quality and first-time yield
* Support manufacturing, sourcing, and the field with issue resolution and quick corrective actions for design related causes (NCR, SDR, PAC)
* Drive quick, complete technical root cause analysis of field failures and identify design related corrective actions to prevent recurrence
* Identify and execute cost saving ideas and strategies
* Drive efforts to introduce advanced technology, materials, manufacturing methods, new design tools/methods to advance the strategic position of yaw subsystem components
  

  

**Qualifications/Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering
* Proven experience in mechanical analysis and design experience in industry
* Working knowledge of technical drawings, GD&T, and manufacturing
* Experience with 3D-CAD tools like Unigraphics / Siemens NX
* Excellent communication, project management, interpersonal, and presentation skills
* Proven ability to lead global projects with team members across cultural boundaries
* Ability to work under pressure and challenging conditions
* Established problem solving process knowledge and execution
* Strong desire and ability to drive improvement and change
* Fluent English written and spoken
* Ability to travel up to 10%
  

  

**Desired Characteristics**

* Master’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering
* Working knowledge of Ansys or other finite element analysis tools
* Design experience working on components in the wind turbine yaw subsystem (yaw drives, yaw bearings, bolted joints, hydraulic + mechanical yaw braking systems)
* Experience with system design including interface definition, system stiffness, DFMEA, and design for manufacturability / installation / serviceability.
* Proven track record of collaborating with business product managers and suppliers/vendors to optimize component costs and influence purchasing strategy

**Associate Partner, Management Consulting – Energy & Utilities, Iberia**

Working side by side with clients, we deliver integrated solutions that span the full lifecycle of change, from initial strategy to sustained impact. We are focussed on fostering an inclusive environment where diverse talent thrives.

  

In Iberia (Spain and Portugal), we are building the practice from the ground up, with Data & AI at its core and an initial focus on Banking & Insurance, Energy & Utilities and the Public Sector. We connect strategy, technology and execution end-to-end, from the first diagnosis through to production.

  

**Your role will involve:**

As Associate Partner for Energy & Utilities, you’ll work closely with the Consulting Partner to build and grow the sector across Iberia, with Data & AI as the engine of transformation. Your challenge is to help energy companies and utilities turn AI into measurable results: running their networks and assets more efficiently, accelerating the energy transition, meeting growing regulatory demands and building the data foundations that make AI work at scale.

  

As a market-facing visionary, you’ll be targeted to pursue new revenue and business development opportunities, whilst nurturing key client relationships, and leading collaborative, high-performing consulting teams. Your exceptional ability to build and maintain lasting, trusted relationships will empower clients to fulfil their business aspirations.

  

As a thought leader in your field, you’ll influence the future of Uvance Wayfinders consulting, bringing fresh perspectives and creative, innovative solutions.

  

**As an Associate Partner, you will be responsible for:**

**Business Development**

* Driving the go-to-market strategy for Energy & Utilities in Iberia and leading business development efforts, including proactive proposals, RFPs and executive presentations, resulting in standalone consulting revenue growth.
* Defining our Data & AI proposition for energy companies and utilities, from AI strategy and Agentic AI to data foundations, across networks, operations, the energy transition and customers.
* Originating and scaling strategic transformation opportunities, from use-case portfolios and business cases to enterprise-wide programmes.
* Identifying pull-through opportunities for technology solutions and services through consulting engagements and gained knowledge of clients’ business challenges.
* Shaping complex value cases and facilitating executive workshops that link AI and data investments to measurable business outcomes.
* Leading deal shaping, pricing and commercial negotiations, and managing revenue, margin and delivery health across engagements.
* Building and maintaining a strong pipeline of opportunities with energy companies and utilities across Iberia.
* Creating eminence and thought leadership through provocative points of view on AI, the energy transition and critical infrastructure.
  

**Client delivery & leadership**

* Setting the direction for complex, multi-disciplinary consulting engagements, identifying the right functional knowledge, technical expertise and proprietary tools required to deliver.
* Serving as a trusted advisor to the C-suite of energy companies and utilities, turning emerging technologies into pragmatic roadmaps and measurable value.
* Leading Agentic AI and Generative AI programmes from opportunity and business case through architecture, implementation and adoption.
* Applying AI to networks and operations: predictive maintenance, asset and network management, digital twins and field operations.
* Building scalable data foundations: data strategy, data governance, operating models and modern architectures, including data for sustainability reporting.
* Advising clients on how to deploy AI in line with sector regulation, including the EU AI Act requirements for critical infrastructure, NIS2 and sustainability reporting.
* Collaborating with the wider Uvance Wayfinders network and technology partners to bring the right capabilities and solutions to each client challenge.
* Providing senior technical oversight across multiple AI and data engagements.
* Validating architectural approaches spanning data platforms, machine learning, large language models, AI agents and orchestration layers.
* Ensuring AI solutions are production-grade, scalable, secure and aligned with enterprise standards, with strong engineering discipline and MLOps practices.
* Guiding teams on trade-offs between rules-based systems, machine learning, LLMs and hybrid approaches.
* Acting as the senior escalation point for complex technical, architectural or Responsible AI decisions.
* Building and sustaining long-term client relationships, ensuring high satisfaction and repeat business.
  

**Practice development**

* Collaborating with the Consulting Partner to shape the Energy & Utilities offering, including methodologies, accelerators and thought leadership.
* Building a high-performing Energy & Utilities team, providing direction, mentorship and quality assurance over team performance and deliverables.
* Working with Uvance Wayfinders partners across Europe and with the teams already present in client accounts.
* Inspiring Uvance Wayfinders consultants to realise their full potential, supporting collaboration, continuous development and a culture where talent thrives.
  

**Your transferable skills and experience:**

* 14+ years of experience in consulting or equivalent senior industry leadership roles, including experience at Associate Partner, Principal Director, Director or Managing Director level in a tier-one consultancy or technology advisory firm.
* Proven ability to build trusted C-suite relationships and originate consulting revenue.
* Experience working with energy and utilities clients in Iberia (electricity networks, generation, energy retail or oil & gas).
* Hands-on leadership of Data & AI in the energy sector: Agentic AI, Generative AI, advanced analytics, data strategy and data governance.
* Track record leading large multidisciplinary teams and project portfolios, balancing growth, delivery quality and talent.
* Solid knowledge of the sector’s regulatory framework, including the EU AI Act, NIS2, sustainability reporting (such as CSRD) and the role of the energy regulators (CNMC and ERSE), and its impact on AI initiatives.
* Experience building practices or offerings from scratch and taking them to market.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a hands-on approach to growing, developing and inspiring cross-functional teams.
* Strong understanding of modern data and AI architectures, including cloud-native data platforms and pipelines, machine learning and advanced analytics, LLM-based solutions (prompting, RAG, agents), and orchestration, monitoring and lifecycle management.
* Experience overseeing AI systems in production and understanding their operational risks: performance, drift, reliability and security.
* Proven ability to build complex value cases and to facilitate workshops with senior decision-makers to shape engagement outcomes.
* Strong commercial acumen, with revenue and margin accountability.
* University degree required; advanced degree preferred.
* Fluent Spanish and professional English; Portuguese is a plus.
  

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with IoT, OT/SCADA environments or digital twins.
* Experience in energy transition programmes (renewables, electrification, storage or hydrogen).
* Experience with ecosystems, technology partnerships or acquisitions.
* Market presence through executive teaching, speaking or publications.
  

**Recruitment process:** The recruitment process consists of 3 stages.

  

**About Uvance Wayfinders**

Uvance Wayfinders is Fujitsu’s global consulting business, launched in February 2024. The name reflects what we do: help organisations find their way when the route is unknown or uncertain, from setting direction and designing the strategic path to guiding implementation. We combine AI-driven consulting, deep industry expertise and advanced technology to turn strategy into measurable business outcomes, connecting strategy, architecture, technology and execution from planning through to adoption. Our services span four domains: Industries, Operations, Experiences and Technologies.

We are people centric: Our hybrid work environments enable you to Be Completely You. Our active people-led Inclusive Community networks are representative of all aspects of diversity and are instrumental in enabling and supporting our innovative approach to inclusion.

title: Team Lead, Reliability Engineering
Chief Technology Officer (CTO) | Hydrogen
description:
*Lead the technological core of Kerionics: the development and industrialization of the SOEC technology you'll bring to market in 2028.*

### **About us**

At Kerionics, we accelerate industrial decarbonization through technologies that make cleaner, more efficient energy possible. We are a spin-off from ITQ (UPV-CSIC), born from scientific knowledge with a clear goal: turning research into real industrial solutions.

Our SOEC (solid oxide electrolysis) technology produces hydrogen with high energy efficiency where it is needed most: energy-intensive industries such as steel, petrochemicals, cement, ceramics and paper, where replacing fossil fuels remains a major challenge. We are a multicultural team of more than 40 people, united by a shared purpose.

### **What we are looking for**

We need a CTO to lead the development and industrialization of our SOEC technology, with our 2028 go-to-market in sight. Over the coming years we will scale the technology by orders of magnitude. You would join at a critical point: not at the beginning, where everything is exploration, nor at the end, where everything is execution, but where scientific rigor and industrial discipline must coexist every day.

We want someone who combines the scientific rigor to solve the open challenges in MEA (Membrane Electrode Assembly), Stack and Balance of Plant (BoP) with the discipline of New Product Introduction (NPI) to take the technology from the lab to an industrial product.

You will lead three managers, one each for MEA, Stack and BoP: people with judgment, autonomy and deep knowledge of their fields. Your challenge is not to build a team from scratch, but to take it to the next level: aligning everyone around the roadmap, professionalizing how we develop product and building a technical culture together.

This is not a role for silent execution. You will be **the CEO's technical right hand**: following the defined strategy and, when needed, challenging it with arguments if you believe something has been decided wrongly. You report to the CEO, but we expect you to co-build, not just execute. That technical honesty is part of the job.

### **Why this role matters**

* **Technical leadership of a European deeptech scale-up**, with technical, commercial and environmental impact at the same time.
* **A project with real backing**: financial support from deeptech-specialized funds such as InnoEnergy, top-tier industrial and scientific partners, participation in strategic European projects, and new conversations with private investors for the next phase.
* **A real voice in strategy**: you sit on the management committee, take part in strategic and investment decisions, and your technical opinion carries weight.
* **The full transition to market**: from prototype to product, from lab to industrial plant, from first customer to deployment.

### **What you will do**

* **Product development:** lead the cross-functional development of our SOEC technology across MEA, Stack and BoP; make sure it follows an NPI logic with clear stage gates, technical pass/fail criteria and traceability of decisions; lead the transition from R&D to industrialization.
* **Team and culture:** lead the MEA, Stack and BoP managers directly, unblock what they need, build a technical culture grounded in data, honesty and accountability, and take an active role in technical hiring.
* **Critical technical problems:** provide top-level judgment on open challenges and lead decisions that cut across areas, even with incomplete data.
* **Strategy:** be the technical reference in the management committee, give the CEO honest judgment, and represent Kerionics before partners, investors and customers.
* **Industrialization and quality:** coordinate with the Industrial Project Manager on the future plant, and with the Quality & Testing Manager to align validation criteria with the product.

### **What we expect in your first 12 months**

1. **Own the technical roadmap:** understand the current state of the product and the commitments made to partners and investors. By the end of your first quarter, present your own critical assessment of the roadmap to the CEO and the board.  
2. **Build the trust of the MEA, Stack and BoP managers and their teams**, and the cross-functional rituals and processes that do not yet exist.  
3. **Strengthen the development process:** consolidate the existing stage-gate system, refining pass/fail criteria, decision traceability and documentation.  
4. **Bring AI into how the team works**, where it adds real value, leading by example. No top-down rollout.  
5. **Deliver the next major validation milestones** of the roadmap.  
6. **Build Kerionics' technical voice externally** and position it as a SOEC reference in Europe.

### **How we work**

We work **on-site** at Parque Tecnológico de Paterna (Valencia), close to the product: lab, workshop, prototypes and test benches. We usually start early (around 7:30), which leaves your afternoons free for sports, family or whatever you prefer.

### **What we ask for**

**Must-haves**

* Advanced degree in Engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Materials, Energy), Materials Science or Chemistry. A PhD will be highly valued.
* At least **5 years** in electrochemical or hydrogen technologies (electrolysis, fuel cells or equivalent). Direct SOEC experience is not required: we value deep knowledge of stacks, MEAs or systems that you can bring to ours.
* At least **3 years** leading product development from R&D toward industrialization.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary technical teams.
* Solid knowledge of at least one pillar: MEA and electrochemical materials, stack design and validation, or BoP in complex energy systems. We do not expect equal depth in all three, but you must hold demanding technical conversations across them.
* Fluent English, spoken and written, for technical discussions and for representing the company.
* Availability to relocate to Valencia within 2-3 months. If you need more time for family reasons, let's talk.
* Valid work permit for Spain, or eligibility to obtain one. For the right candidate, we support the paperwork.

**We are looking for someone who...**

* Has the judgment to say no to a good project that doesn't fit the strategy, and yes to a hard one when the evidence supports it.
* Decides under uncertainty without falling into paralysis or improvisation.
* Challenges the CEO with arguments when needed, while staying loyal to the agreed strategy.
* Leads through context and example, not micromanagement, and stays hands-on when needed.
* Stays current with AI and uses it critically.
* Can join an already formed team and earn its trust through knowledge and respect, not hierarchy.

**Not required, but you'll surprise us if you also...**

* Have direct experience with SOEC or SOFC, or high-temperature ceramic materials.
* Have been a CTO, VP of R&D or Head of Technology in a deeptech scale-up.
* Have lived a complete industrial scale-up (TRL 5-6 to TRL 8-9) in electrochemical, energy or advanced materials technologies.
* Know our target sectors (steel, cement, petrochemicals, ceramics, glass, paper).
* Speak Spanish.
* Have your own network in the European hydrogen, SOEC/SOFC or industrial decarbonization ecosystem.

**A note before you decide...**

This list describes an ideal profile, not a checklist. People from groups underrepresented in deeptech and engineering tend to be harder on themselves when reading job descriptions. Don't decide for us: send us your CV, and let us decide whether there's a fit.

### **What we offer**

* **€70-90K gross per year**, depending on experience and fit.
* **Variable bonus of up to €20K**, linked to the technical milestones of our roadmap. Details shared during the process.
* **Stock option plan.** Full terms shared during the process.
* **Permanent contract**, with a standard 6-month probationary period.
* Relocation support package for candidates moving to Valencia.
* 22 working days of holiday.
* Language lessons (Spanish or English) if you want to strengthen your language skills.
* Annual training budget tailored to your needs.
* A multicultural team: colleagues from India, the UK, France, Pakistan, Mexico, Uruguay, Colombia, Ecuador...
* Every Friday, 11:00 to 12:00, a good Valencian esmorzaret to disconnect and celebrate the week's small wins.

### **How our selection process works**

1. A video call with our Head of People & Culture.  
2. A video call with our CEO, to explore your technical vision and how it fits with Kerionics' strategy.  
3. A video call with an external expert.  
4. A video call with a member of our Board, focused on long-term vision and an independent view of strategic fit.  
5. A full-day visit to our facilities in Paterna (Valencia), where you will see the product and meet the MEA, Stack and BoP managers, your future direct reports. We cover your travel and accommodation.

We will update you within 5 working days after each step and treat your candidacy with full confidentiality.

title: Senior Campaign Manager (Temp Contract)
description:
**About Pleo**
Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.
  
  
The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.
  
  
Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for a Senior Integrated Campaign Manager, Brand & GTM to join our Integrated Marketing team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help architect, roll out, project manage, and drive the Go-To-Market (GTM) execution for our major 2027 brand marketing strategy and campaigns and be part of turning brand strategy, positioning, and creative concepts into operational GTM blueprints as we scale our multi-segment (SMB, Mid-Market, Enterprise) reach across 6 key European markets. If you're excited about high-visibility, full-funnel orchestration and balancing long-term brand equity building with full-funnel conversion, and are passionate about integrated brand and GTM marketing in high-growth B2B SaaS, then this is the opportunity for you!
  
  
**Please bear in mind this role is a temporary contract of 1 year.**
**Who You’ll Be Working With And Reporting To**
You’ll report to our Director of Integrated Marketing and work closely with teams in Brand Marketing, Digital, Field/Events, Content, PR, Product Marketing (PMM), Marketing Ops, Data, and Sales/Growth channels. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to bridging top-of-funnel brand awareness with lower-funnel acquisition, ensuring every campaign moment translates into market salience, customer engagement, and measurable business impact. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across country teams, local market stakeholders, Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field squads to ensure success.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**
As a Senior Campaign Manager, you will:
  
  

* Integrated GTM Architecture & Strategic Planning: Translate the overarching 2027 brand strategy into actionable, full-funnel GTM campaign blueprints across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments, architecting campaign flighting and distribution models across 6 European markets.
* The "Master Brief" & Cross-Functional Squad Leadership: Own and author comprehensive Integrated Campaign Master Briefs, leading the operational rhythm of cross-functional squads to execute multi-channel strategies (OOH, Paid Social, VIP activations, Digital, ABM) on time and within scope.
* Localization & Regional Adaptation: Partner with country teams and local market stakeholders to ensure master campaign frameworks balance global consistency with local relevance and execution precision.
* Strategic Brand Partnership & Enablement: Serve as the strategic execution peer to the Brand Marketing Lead, while partnering with Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field teams to equip customer-facing squads with the stories, tools, and campaign momentum needed to capitalize on campaign-generated intent.
* Campaign Operations, Budget & ROI Accountability: Maintain and protect the integrated campaign master calendar, manage and allocate the multi-country integrated campaign budget, and partner with Marketing Ops, Data, and Brand Intelligence to track brand lift, consideration, pipeline growth, and closed-won impact.

**What You Bring**
You’ll thrive in this role if you have:
  
  

* A proven track record leading multi-million dollar, multi-country, full-funnel integrated campaigns in high-growth B2B SaaS or tech environments.
* Deep experience taking high-level brand frameworks and translating them into multi-channel GTM blueprints across varied audience segments (SMB to Enterprise).
* High proficiency in aligning cross-functional teams (Creative, Digital, PR, Ops, Sales) and holding squads accountable to tight deadlines and complex campaign launches.
* Deep understanding of how to run campaigns across diverse European markets, with a clear perspective on modular campaign design and local adaptation.
* Experience with tracking brand-to-pipeline performance metrics, campaign flighting dynamics, brand lift, consideration, and total ROI.
* A background in integrated marketing, GTM campaign management, or brand marketing orchestration within B2B technology or SaaS.

**Why is this role a good fit for you**
This role is a good fit for you if:
  
  

* You thrive as the operational bridge between high-level brand strategy and lower-funnel demand generation, turning concepts into structured GTM blueprints.
* You love leading cross-functional squads across multiple international markets, balancing consistency with local nuances across 6 key European countries.
* You take pride in end-to-end accountability, from authoring master briefs and handling multi-country budgets to tracking downstream pipeline velocity and closed-won revenue impact.

This role is not a good fit for you if:
  
  

* You prefer focusing purely on high-level creative ideation, copy, or audience insight development without building the operational execution machinery.
* You prefer running single-channel or single-market marketing initiatives rather than orchestrating complex, multi-segment (SMB to Enterprise), multi-channel matrices.
* You are uncomfortable navigating data, campaign flighting performance, budget allocations, and downstream pipeline attribution alongside brand metrics.

**How You’ll Develop In This Role**
In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:
  
  

* Lead the architecture and rollout of the 2027 integrated brand campaign calendar across all target European markets.
* Collaborate with the Brand Marketing Lead, country teams, and Marketing Ops to stand up the Master Briefing framework and streamline cross-functional execution rhythms.
* Grow your skills in full-funnel orchestration and multi-market scale, driving measurable brand lift, consideration, and downstream pipeline velocity as Pleo continues to expand.

**The location**
Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.
  
  
**Show me the benefits!**

* Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)
* Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office
* Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis
* 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).
* For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options
* We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far
* Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

**The interview process**
We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:
  
  

* Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.
* Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 minute chat to deep dive into your experience
* Challenge & Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role
* Final Interview: A final interview with a senior leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!
  
  
Last time we hired for this role, we received a total vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call.Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:
  
  

* CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, :2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!
* Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.
* Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

**About Your Application**

* English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.
* A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.
* Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.
* Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.
* Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.
* Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.
* Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

* People & Talent

**What you will do**

As a **Senior HR Business Partner** at Lighthouse, you'll partner with directors, vice presidents and leadership teams across Revenue and Marketing to shape people strategy and turn business priorities into practical action. This is a hands-on advisory role, combining workforce redesign and talent development with performance management and complex employee relations. Within an AI-native People & Talent function, you'll use people analytics and tools such as Claude to connect signals across clusters and bring leaders clear recommendations. You'll challenge assumptions, help leaders own their decisions and measure success by whether the business makes better decisions about its people because of your involvement.

**Where you will have impact**

* Partner with senior Revenue and Marketing leadership teams to shape people strategy and translate business priorities into quarterly people plans and targeted projects.

**About our team**

You'll work closely with fellow HR Business Partners, People Operations and Talent Acquisition to support Revenue and Marketing leaders across Europe, the United States and Asia-Pacific. * Flexible time off: Autonomy to manage your work-life balance.
* Alan Healthy benefits: 160€/month for food or nursery.

* Comprehensive health insurance: 100% Alan coverage for you, your spouse, and dependents.
* Collaborative team: High-bar, friendly, creative, and passionate colleagues.

* Impactful work: Shape products relied on by 85,000+ users worldwide.
* Competitive compensation: Proactively maintained to value your work.
* Referral bonuses: Earn rewards for bringing in new talent.

**Who you are**

* Experience partnering with Revenue teams in an international organisation, with an understanding of commercial pressures.
* Credibility advising directors and vice presidents on people strategy, organisation design and workforce change, alongside hands-on performance management experience.
* Clear, concise communication and senior stakeholder influence, including the ability to present recommendations, challenge assumptions and maintain a constructive position under pressure.
* Data storytelling skills that connect signals across clusters, distinguish local issues from organisation-wide patterns and build a business case for action.
* Understanding of how artificial intelligence reshapes roles, team structures and capability needs, and the ability to guide leaders through workforce redesign decisions.
* Generative AI fluency for synthesis, pattern recognition and insight generation, including basic analysis and HTML dashboards, with sound judgment about the limitations of AI outputs.
* Experience independently managing complex employee relations cases with significant business, legal or reputational dimensions, including knowing when to escalate or involve Legal.
* Ability to hold a multi-cluster portfolio in view while remaining hands-on, adapting to changing priorities and organising work across time zones.

**We welcome**

* International Revenue partnering experience from outside SaaS; SaaS experience is helpful, not required.
* Experience contributing to or designing HR frameworks, programmes or operating models.
* Familiarity with organisation design methods, including responsibility mapping, spans of control and role design principles.
* First-hand experience supporting a function through significant AI-driven transformation.

**Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging**

Thank you for considering a career with Lighthouse. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace that values equal opportunity for all. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender, race, religion, sexual orientation, and disability. Our commitment to equality is part of our culture. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point during the application or interview process, please notify your recruiter.

description:

You will work closely with the store team ensuring the right products are available on and close to the shop floor enabling an excellent client experience.

### **Job responsibilities**

**Your role will be:**

* Maintain the organization of the stockroom to the highest standards with merchandise stored in a clear and organised way which allows the efficient flow between front and back of house.
* Manage the delivery of stock into the store, checking that it matches against the invoice and informing HQ / Inventory of any discrepancies.

* Support and coordinate the aftersales process (repairs, alteration, etc) to ensure an excellent client experience.
* Fully integrate and participate in the store activities such as morning briefings, relevant training, etc.

### **Profile**

**What is important for the role:**

* Proven experience in achieving individual goals and contributing to team results
* Experience within a similar role , preferably in fashion/luxury
* Organised, with close attention to detail and able to work effectively in a fast-paced environment
* Clear communication with the ability to connect with and influence various people
* Confident to work a utonomously and as part of a team
* A deep interest in Fashion, Art and Culture
* Fluent in Spanish, English will be a plus

### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.

At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.

***LOEWE*** 
**MAISON**
-----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  
Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  
Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  
Radical and ever-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  
Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  
Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  
At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

description:
**About Impress**

We believe everyone deserves a smile they’ll love. We are IMPRESS, the largest chain of digital orthodontic clinics in Europe, revolutionizing the invisible orthodontic sector and bringing smiles to people's faces. Our unique combination of medical expertise and digitalization has earned us recognition as one of the top fastest-growing Health Tech companies by Forbes. Born in Barcelona in 2019, we have expanded across 10 countries with more than 110 locations, offering leading care and state-of-the-art technology.

#### **Role Overview**

We are looking for an **Expansion Project Manager** to oversee the full expansion lifecycle for Impress, driving commercial growth through strategic partnerships and leading the delivery of flagship clinic construction projects worldwide. This role is responsible for identifying and closing real estate and B2B dental opportunities, coordinating cross-functional teams, managing CAPEX budgets, and executing end-to-end fit-out and site delivery.

### **Your Responsibilities:**

#### **1. Business Development & Real Estate Partnerships**

* Identify, prospect, and engage new real estate partners, including landlords, property owners, retail groups, and shopping centers.
* Pitch the Impress model to generate strong interest in hosting clinic locations.
* Build and manage an active pipeline of prospective sites, leading the full negotiation cycle through to contract signature.
* Develop and maintain an ongoing network of strategic partners, including landlords, commercial brokers, and investors.
* Represent Impress during meetings, site visits, and industry events to maximize expansion opportunities.

#### **2. Dental Partnership Development (B2B)**

* Prospect dental practices and orthodontists to establish strategic B2B partnerships.
* Present the Impress partnership model, tailor the pitch to partner needs, and execute agreements.
* Maintain strong, long-term relationships with existing partner practices to optimize ongoing collaboration.

#### **3. Construction & Project Delivery**

* Lead and manage flagship construction projects worldwide, owning each phase from design coordination and the tender process through construction, opening, and site handover.
* Manage the workload and output of regional teams involved in design and construction.
* Ensure all projects align with expansion forecasts, new opening schedules, and operational goals.
* Oversee the maintenance and remodeling of operational clinics to reflect strategic decisions, policy updates, and brand improvements.

#### **4. Budget Management**

* Build budgets prior to presentation to senior management for executive approval.
* Oversee comprehensive cost and budget management, evaluating and approving additional spending when necessary.

#### **5. Cross-Functional Coordination & Reporting**

* Collaborate closely with operations, finance, legal, marketing, and construction teams to ensure cross-functional alignment on expansion priorities and deadlines.
* Engage with internal and external stakeholders (such as Country Managers and Medical Directors) to communicate regional needs, address requirements, and mitigate escalations.
* Escalate critical issues promptly to ensure all project milestones and opening dates are met.
* Identify potential operational, financial, or delivery risks early and implement corrective solutions.
* Deliver regular, structured reporting on pipeline status, contract negotiations, construction milestones, and upcoming clinic openings.

### **What you need to be successful:**

* Academic Background: Degree in Engineering (Civil, Industrial, Mechanical, Architectural, or related field).
* Experience: 5+ years in commercial real estate expansion, retail/network rollouts, or multi-site technical project management.
* Languages: **Native or Professional fluency in English** (additional languages are a plus).
* Mobility: **Willingness to travel frequently** for site visits, contractor inspections, partner meetings, and industry events.
* Commercial & Deal-Making Track Record: Proven background in B2B sales, real estate acquisition, lease negotiation, and partnership development with landlords, brokers, and healthcare professionals.
* End-to-End Project Delivery: Direct experience managing fit-outs and construction projects from initial design and tender to contractor oversight, site handover, and maintenance.
* Financial Acumen: Strong experience formulating, tracking, and managing multi-site CAPEX budgets and construction cost accounts.
* Stakeholder Management: Exceptional interpersonal and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence C-level executives, landlords, regional country managers, and medical directors.
* Project Management & Organization: Strong organizational skills with a track record of running parallel projects across multiple regions while hitting strict launch deadlines.
