title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
description:
**Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!**

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

*Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.*

**The team**
------------

At blp, dedicated engineering teams own individual products such as invoices, customer orders, and order confirmations. The Platform Team owns what all of them are built on: shared services and APIs, the data access layer, and the component and design system that shape how the product looks and behaves.

The team's focus has been the frontend platform, and we are now deliberately extending that ownership deeper into the stack. You would be central to that shift, with real influence over how the platform layer gets defined rather than inheriting someone else's blueprint.

**About the role**
------------------

* **What you'll do and for whom.** You build and run the core backend service our product teams rely on, from its APIs and persistence layer to email, user provisioning, and cross-tenant capabilities for large enterprises. Through those teams, your work reaches the 20'000+ people who use our Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash agents every day.
* **Where you'll work.** You join the Platform Team, about 10 engineers. At BLP, platform means the core of our product, not internal infrastructure: the shared services, data access layer, and design system that every product runs on. You work closely with the senior backend engineer who owns these areas today, in a large production Go codebase with well-established patterns.
* **What success looks like.** In your first year, you own one core area end-to-end, for example, user provisioning, outbound email, cross-tenant capabilities, analytics, or workflow configuration, from the Go service to the customer using it.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Build the service that product teams build on.** Design, build, and evolve the core APIs behind document processing, approval workflows, administration, and analytics, with clear contracts so product teams can ship on top of them without workarounds.
* **Own the persistence layer.** Each tenant has its own isolated MySQL database. You evolve the abstraction product teams build on (a tenant-scoped unit of work, typed repositories, and shared type-safe querying) so that isolation, transactions, and permissions are right by default.
* **Scale BLP for large enterprises.** Extend our cross-tenant capabilities so customers with many subsidiaries and business units can manage users, permissions, and documents across all of them from one place, correctly, securely, and fast.
* **Own email, in and out.** Own our email document ingestion and outbound email services, including the audit trail and its UI.
* **Make setup self-service.** Turn manual SSO, SCIM, and email setups into migration tools and admin UIs that customers and project managers can run on their own.
* **Work with customers.** Join onboarding calls with customer IT teams and project managers, get their setups running, and turn what you learn into better tooling.
* **Own it end-to-end.** From the Go service through the React UI to production, including tracing, metrics, and incident analysis after it ships.

**Tech stack:** Go, React/TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, Temporal, Kubernetes on GCP and AWS, GitHub CI/CD, and OpenTelemetry with Grafana, Prometheus, Tempo, and Parca for observability.

**We're excited about you because**
-----------------------------------

* You have **4+ years of experience as a software engineer**, with most of that time spent building and operating backend systems in production.
* You have **2+ years of professional Go experience**, writing services that run in production, not side projects.
* You've designed a backend service or API that other teams depended on, and kept it reliable and evolvable as usage grew.
* You work well across teams. You align with product, integration, and infrastructure teams on contracts, priorities, and rollouts, and you can explain technical trade-offs to people who aren't engineers.
* You improve existing production systems step by step, and you know when a rewrite isn't worth it.
* You have strong fundamentals in type systems, composition, testing, and clean architecture, and you're comfortable working in a codebase built on functional patterns.
* You're fullstack where it counts: you build on the components and design system our frontend experts maintain to ship admin UIs quickly, even though the backend is where you do your deepest work.
* You think in products and take ownership. You translate business problems into precise specifications, weigh cost against benefit, work directly with customers when a setup needs it, and stay responsible for what you ship after it goes live.

**Strong plus**
---------------

* Experience with *distributed systems*, Kubernetes, Temporal, or cloud infrastructure.
* Experience with user provisioning (SCIM) and SSO (OIDC).
* Experience running multi-tenant systems.
* Domain knowledge in ERP, finance, procurement, or supply chain processes, or German language skills.

**What you'll get**

* **Ownership of visible outcomes.** The areas you own decide how fast enterprise customers go live and how well BLP scales with them.
* **Impact at scale.** Every improvement you ship to the product core multiplies across all product teams and the 20'000+ people who use BLP daily.
* **Senior scope from day one.** You'll lead technical initiatives and mentor engineers on a team that is actively growing its backend ownership.

Learn more about BLP and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

Please note: Hybrid work in London office, or remote in wider UK and Europe.

As Market Development Manager you own how Auditdata enters and grows beyond its established accounts across EMEA: which markets are worth opening, which chains are worth pursuing, and what it takes to get in. You will shape that view with the VP EMEA and then go and prove it in the market yourself. Who you work with the VP EMEA on strategy and prioritisation, the VP Marketing as an equal partner on campaigns and account-based programmes against your target map, the Account Managers and Account Executives when an opportunity grows into an enterprise cycle. title: Chief Customer Officer
description:
**Work from anywhere, impact everywhere**
-----------------------------------------

Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank.
  
We're a fully distributed team of over 160 Xapiens that work remotely from 50+ countries around the world.

Our beginning: A world that enjoys economic freedom and wealth protection,no matter where you live or who is running your country.  
To achieve that, we search the world for the best people for the job.
  
We work hard, think globally, and inspire each other to learn and grow.
  
We are committed to changing the way things are done.

Although we are headquartered in Gibraltar, this is a full time, 100% remote position  
Work from anywhere!

**Position overview**
---------------------

Xapo's product suite has grown from a Bitcoin vault into a full member proposition: BTC and USD accounts that pay interest, a global card with Bitcoin cashback, Bitcoin-backed loans, a growing suite of BTC wealth and credit products, and access to stocks, ETFs, and stablecoins, all inside one regulated relationship.

Xapo is a bank, and a bank earns on the money its members choose to hold with it. Each of those products shipped well. What hasn't yet existed is a single owner of the economics of the customer relationship: one person accountable for winning the right members, growing what they hold with us, and keeping them, and for the balance-sheet products that make that possible.

The Chief Customer Officer is a new role at the top of the house, reporting to the CEO. You will run the stream that grows what members hold with Xapo, and you will own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional. It brings growth, client coverage, product management, and product design under one leader who is judged on customer contribution, the assets attracted and kept, and the members who stay. This is a customer-focused role in the most commercial sense: what a member earns from us, not the feature we shipped, is the centre of every decision.

The measure of success is a Customer P&L that grows on what members hold and keep: LTV:CAC improving, approved-to-paid rising, churn falling, and customer contribution the business can plan against.

This is a banking role, not a requirements-gathering role, a marketing role, or a role you can run from a dashboard. Products are priced on the balance sheet and judged on the money they attract and keep.

**The mandate**
---------------

* **Own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional.**
    
  You own customer contribution: customer gross profit from what members' balances earn, secured lending, Bitcoin yield, and conversion, stocks and ETFs, less the cost of winning and keeping members. We earn on what members hold, not on what they tap, send, or click, so you run on assets held and the margin they earn, not payment volume. Good looks like a Customer P&L the Exco and Board can plan against, where every line has a number you own and can explain, up or down.

* **Grow what members hold with us, through earning products run like a banker would.**
    
  You own the roadmap for the balance-sheet products: deposits and savings, lending and credit, and trading and structured. Each is led by a mission PM who is a banker, owning a product's contribution and its price on the balance sheet, not a backlog. Requirements go through the gate; the economics are the job. Every item is priced by Finance before it is built, on a shared risk appetite with Risk and Treasury. Good looks like products that scale assets held and member lifetime value at a risk profile the Board actually approved.

* **Win the right members, efficiently.**
    
  You own Growth: audience, lifecycle, and content, with one head accountable for the path from approval to paid. You own CAC and approved-to-paid, find the members who bring other members, and activate them in week one. Every incentive is priced before it runs. Good looks like net paid-member growth that improves every quarter, at a CAC that LTV comfortably justifies, because you diagnosed where the funnel leaks rather than spending more to fill it.

* **Keep members, and deepen the relationship with the ones who hold balances.**
    
  Retention is the most efficient growth we have. You own churn, and you own Client Coverage: relationship managers who sell the missions' products to the members who hold balances, and loop demand back into the roadmap. You are accountable for net new AUM flow, covered-book retention, and products per covered member, and for growth that is broad-based rather than concentrated in a few accounts. Good looks like falling churn and AUM growth from members who stay and expand rather than members re-acquired at cost.

* **Make the value of Xapo visible, and the experience effortless.**
    
  You own Product Design: one design system and one shell, so that members see the value of what they are earning clearly and early, and find every task simple. You design the proposition in the stream with Finance and partner with Operations, who run onboarding, KYC, support, cards, and payments, to remove friction at the points that affect members most. Good looks like members who understand their return, complete what they set out to do, and stay.

* **Build one Customer organisation, not four.**
    
  Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design come together under one operating model: one set of key results read weekly from one source, shared frameworks for discovery and prioritisation, and real career paths for the people in it. Engineering is pulled to a single ranked roadmap, and nobody in your line has engineers of their own. Good looks like fewer hand-offs per outcome and a number for every cell that its owner explains every week.

* **Bring the regulated-bank and crypto-native lens to every customer call.**
    
  You understand that a KYC onboarding decision and an AML monitoring decision carry different risk appetites, that a false positive at the gate is a paid-for member lost, and that a proposition built for a crypto-native power user can still fail a first-time bank customer. You can sit in the same room as a CRO, an MLRO, a CFO, and an engineering lead and make a customer case that survives all four conversations.

**How you'll operate**
----------------------

This part matters as much as the mandate. The known failure mode for this role, in any company, is a CCO with a polished customer-insight deck and no ownership of the number. That is disqualifying here.

* **You lead from inside the work.** You sit in on growth reviews, mission PM reviews, client meetings, and member calls, not just steering committees. PMs, designers, and relationship managers three levels down know your name because you've solved problems with them.
* **You move people with the business case, not the whip.** When a priority needs to change, you diagnose the problem, build the case with data and the economics, and show teams why it matters, so they re-prioritise because they're convinced, not because they were told. Your authority comes from being right and being useful, not from your title.
* **You have extreme ownership.** You own the Customer P&L and the member metrics beneath it, not the feature ship date. If a launch didn't move contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, or churn, you don't report "the roadmap item shipped", you change the approach.
* **You have genuine gravitas.** Senior, experienced leaders welcome your input because you've earned the standing to give it. You can challenge any executive's plan, including the CEO's, constructively, with evidence, and be thanked for it, because your challenge makes their work stronger.
* **You diagnose before you prescribe.** You can walk into a leaking funnel, a churning segment, or a product that isn't earning and find the structural cause, then fix the economics, not just the symptom.

**What you'll have done**
-------------------------

* 10+ years in senior commercial or customer leadership (CCO, Chief Growth or Commercial Officer, MD or Head of Retail or Wealth, or equivalent) in digital banking, fintech, or payments, including meaningful time in a regulated environment (banking licence, e-money, or equivalent prudential/conduct regime).
* Crypto-native credibility: hands-on experience building and growing customer propositions on or around digital assets, custody, on-chain flows, Bitcoin-backed lending, or similar. You don't need Bitcoin explained to you, and you don't need banking explained to you either.
* Customer P&L ownership: you have owned a customer or product P&L judged on contribution, balances, and margin rather than transaction volume, and you are fluent in NIM, unit economics, customer contribution, and LTV:CAC.
* Growth and lifecycle: a track record of acquiring, activating, and retaining members in a regulated, KYC-heavy environment, improving approved-to-paid and churn while holding CAC to a level that LTV justifies, not just growth-hacking a free consumer app.
* Banking-grade product leadership: you have led product management for balance-sheet products such as savings, lending, or structured products, priced with Finance, with PMs who own a product's economics rather than a backlog. Experience with client coverage or relationship-managed models for high-balance and institutional clients is a strong advantage.
* Commercial and risk fluency: you can build a customer business case that survives scrutiny from Finance, Risk, and Compliance in the same meeting, and you know the difference between growth that's sustainable and growth that's borrowed from tomorrow's risk appetite.
* A track record of outcomes you can narrate: specific LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, AUM, or contribution numbers you owned, bets you killed when the data didn't support them, and outcomes you can prove.

  

**The first 90 days**
---------------------

**Day 30:** The Customer P&L baseline is documented across retail and institutional: customer contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, net paid-member growth, and assets attracted and kept. You have formed your own independent view of where members are won, lost, and under-served, and shared it with the CEO and Board.  
**Day 60:** The unified Customer operating model is live: one set of key results across Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design, read weekly from one source. Every mission PM owns a product's contribution and its price, and the roadmap is ranked on what it earns, built with Finance and the line leads.  
**Day 90:** At least one measurable improvement in LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, or net new AUM flow is live and attributable to a change you made, not a feature ship, an outcome moved. Every cell in your line has defined key results and an owner who explains the number every week.

**What this role is not**
-------------------------

* Not a requirements-gathering role. Mission PMs are bankers who own a product's contribution and price, not a backlog. You partner with Technology, Finance, and Operations on execution; you don't run those functions.
* Not a volume role. If your primary output is card spend, transfer volume, or a shipped list rather than assets held and the margin they earn, we have both failed.
* Not a reporting layer. If your primary output is a customer-insight deck or a roadmap deck, we have both failed.
* Not a role that can be done from a distance. Remote-first means distributed, not detached.

**Other requirements**
----------------------

* A dedicated workspace.
* A reliable internet connection with the fastest speed possible in your area.
* Alignment with Our Values and the Xapo Values-Driven Leadership principles.

**Why work for Xapo?**
----------------------

Impact Globally, Work Remotely.

* **Shape the Future**  
  Improve lives through cutting-edge technology, work 100% remotely from anywhere in the world.
* **Great work-life balance**  
  Build amazing things with a balance of autonomy and collaborative teamwork. Set your own work schedule and make use of a flexible PTO plan when you need to recharge.
* **Expect Excellence**  
  Collaborate, learn, and grow with a high-performance team. Learn how you learn best - from books to conferences, you'll get a yearly budget for your individual learning and development goals.

At Xapo, we prioritize consumer protection and adhere to regulatory requirements by ensuring that all Xapiens are accountable for upholding principles of fair treatment, transparency, and ethical conduct in their interactions with customers and stakeholders.

This can be spent on self-purchase of health insurance or on doctor's fees for yourself and close relatives (spouse, children);

title: Urban Resilience Expert
description:
Result of Service

The consultant contributes to the successful implementation and expansion of the City Resilience Global Programme by providing high-quality technical expertise, analytical support, capacity-building services, and programme development assistance to partner cities, territories, and institutions. The consultancy supports the achievement of UN-Habitat's objective of fostering inclusive, sustainable, climate-resilient, and risk-informed urban and territorial development by strengthening the capacity of public institutions, communities, and key stakeholders to understand risks, make informed decisions, mobilize resources, and implement integrated resilience and climate adaptation actions. The expected outcome is enhanced resilience capacity among local and regional governments, improved resilience planning and implementation, stronger multi-level governance mechanisms, increased access to financing opportunities, and the development of actionable strategies that contribute to the objectives of the New Urban Agenda, the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction, the Paris Agreement on Climate Change, and the Sustainable Development Goals.

Work Location

Homebase

Expected duration

6 months

Duties and Responsibilities

The United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is the United Nations agency mandated by the General Assembly to promote socially, economically, and environmentally sustainable towns and cities. UN-Habitat works with national and local governments, civil society, academia, development partners, and the private sector to advance sustainable urbanization and improve the quality of life in human settlements worldwide. As the lead UN agency for sustainable urban development and human settlements, UN-Habitat plays a key role in supporting countries and local authorities to address increasing urban challenges, including climate change, disaster risk, environmental degradation, rapid urbanization, inequality, and vulnerability to shocks and stresses. Through its urban resilience programming, UN-Habitat promotes integrated, people-centered, and systems-based approaches that strengthen the capacity of cities and territories to anticipate, absorb, adapt, and transform in the face of current and future challenges. UN-Habitat's resilience work builds on global frameworks including the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, the New Urban Agenda, the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction 2015-2030, and the Paris Agreement on Climate Change, supporting local and regional governments in translating these commitments into effective action at territorial level. Recognizing that resilience challenges extend beyond administrative boundaries, UN-Habitat supports multi-level governance approaches that strengthen coordination among cities, metropolitan areas, regions, and national institutions. Its resilience interventions combine risk-informed planning, climate adaptation, disaster risk reduction, urban regeneration, nature-based solutions, governance strengthening, and inclusive stakeholder engagement to support sustainable territorial development. The programme works closely with local and regional governments, public institutions, civil society organizations, community groups, academia, and development partners to design and implement resilience-building initiatives. Attention is given to vulnerable populations, including women, youth, older persons, displaced populations, and other groups disproportionately affected by climate change, disasters, and socio-economic shocks. Main Responsibilities of the Urban Resilience Consultant: Under the direct supervision of the Head of the City Resilience Global Programme (CRGP), the consultant will provide technical support to the Programme and undertake the following tasks: Task 1. Implement the CRGP methodology and support technical operations with partner institutions, cities, and regions in collaboration with technical experts and focal points: - Review, reshape, and calibrate the methodology and analytical framework to the context of each city or territory. - Develop work plans and implementation strategy of the methodology with the partner local and regional governments. - Collaborate in the preparation of reports, including desk research, data analysis, writing, preparation of maps and diagrams, and report editing. - Facilitate stakeholder mapping and engagement processes to ensure inclusive participation of government entities, academia, civil society, and relevant technical partners. - Coordinate data collection, validation, and quality assurance processes with partner institutions. - Monitor implementation progress and identify operational risks and mitigation measures. Task 2. Provide knowledge generation, capacity building and technical expertise on urban resilience, disaster risk reduction, and climate adaptation: - Hold technical consultations, knowledge exchange and training sessions on urban resilience, territorial diagnostics and participatory planning. - Support and collaborate with project focal points and working groups/teams in the production of reports and planning of local activities. - Participate in institutional and policy dialogue sessions and support the development of relevant knowledge products. - Develop and deliver training materials, toolkits, and practical guidance documents for local stakeholders. - Capture and document lessons learned, good practices, and innovations emerging from project implementation. - Provide technical advisory support on integrating resilience, climate adaptation, and risk reduction considerations into local planning instruments. Task 3. Development of a cross-country comparative framework for NewMed 2030 project: - Develop the guiding steps for the analytical process to be utilized for producing city profiles under the NewMed 2030 framework. - Define the resilience targets and map out the indicators that will guide the analysis phase during the diagnosis. - Coordinate with CRPiT technical developer to align selected indicators and profile outputs. - Validate and document the incorporation of the framework with partner organizations. - Develop a comparative analytical methodology to assess resilience performance and trends across participating cities. - Establish indicators and criteria for benchmarking and cross-country learning. - Contribute to the design of data management and visualization approaches to support comparative analysis. Task 4. Development and dissemination of knowledge products: methodological guides, practical tools, and comparative reports for NewMed 2030 project: - Consolidate learnings from the project into a binational learning report. - Systematization of experiences and methodological guide. - Contribution to the refinement and monitoring of the NewMed2030 (phase 1) - Prepare technical briefs, policy notes, and dissemination materials targeting different stakeholder audiences. - Support the organization of knowledge-sharing events, webinars, and peer-learning exchanges. - Contribute to communication products highlighting project results, impacts, and lessons learned. - Develop comparative synthesis reports identifying regional trends, common challenges, and transferable practices. Task 5. Development of a Barcelona Resilience Profile and Recommended Actions for Resilience: - Development of roadmap and implementation strategy (including baseline data mapping and data collection strategy). - Full process implementation of the CRGP methodology with the Barcelona City Council. - Conduct technical workshops with stakeholders ensuring the engagement of relevant municipal representatives. - Development of interim reports, Resilience Profile, and Recommended Actions for Resilience and Sustainability (RAR-S) report. - Coordinate data collection and stakeholder validation processes required for profile development. - Support the prioritization and validation of resilience actions through participatory workshops. - Develop monitoring recommendations and implementation pathways for shortlisted resilience actions. - Facilitate alignment of proposed actions with existing municipal strategies and sectoral plans. Task 6: Support the head of the programme in proposal development, project formulation, and fundraising: - Contribute to the identification of funding opportunities and strategic partnerships. - Support the preparation of concept notes, project proposals, logical frameworks, workplans, and budgets. - Conduct background research and institutional mapping to support project formulation. - Contribute to donor reporting, project monitoring frameworks, and results-based management processes. - Support engagement with development partners, financing institutions, and regional networks. The expected results are: - Increased commitments to build local and regional level resilience. - Local and Regional Resilience assessments are conducted. - Key issues and challenges identified in linking early interventions in crisis-prone cities and regions to long-term sustainable development inputs. - Capacity is built in cities, territories, local and regional governments to develop and implement integrated local climate and disaster resilience action plans. - Crisis-prone cities and territories have enhanced capacity to develop and implement plans to increase their resiliency.

Qualifications/special skills

- An advanced university degree or equivalent professional qualification in urban and regional planning, urban studies, urban geography, architecture, or a related field is required. - A first-level university degree in one of the above fields, combined with two additional years of qualifying professional experience, may be accepted in lieu of the advanced university degree. A minimum of four (4) years of experience is required in developing resilience strategies, guidelines, toolkits or policies for effective urban environments, in liaising with private and governmental authorities, other national/international institutions and NGOs, and in working within diverse urban environments. Previous experience in projects related to urban planning, resilience, climate risk, disaster risk, or territorial analysis is required. Ability to work with minimal supervision and with good sense of initiative to keep the head of the programme regularly informed of progress is required. Good communications, reporting and representation skills are required for the position. Experience in the Mediterranean or MENA region, particularly Lebanon or Morocco, is an asset. Experience in Spain, particularly Catalunya, and Latin American countries is an asset. Excellent computer skills in Microsoft Office, spreadsheets, and other software packages required. Familiar with and committed to the goals of International Organization is desirable. Ability to work with minimal supervision and with good sense of initiative to keep the supervisor regularly informed of progress is required. Good teamwork and drive for results is desirable. Adaptable to rapidly changing priorities and able to manage multiple deadlines and deliver high quality work products. Able to meet deadlines for reporting and all project work is desirable Express enthusiasm and willingness to continue learning new skills and share experiences with other members of the team is desirable Willing to take responsibility, act professionally at all times, and make sure tasks are fully completed is desirable

Languages

- Fluency in spoken and written English is required. - Knowledge of other UN languages would be an additional asset. - Knowledge of Arabic and/or Spanish is desirable.

Additional Information

Not available.

No Fee

THE UNITED NATIONS DOES NOT CHARGE A FEE AT ANY STAGE OF THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS (APPLICATION, INTERVIEW MEETING, PROCESSING, OR TRAINING). THE UNITED NATIONS DOES NOT CONCERN ITSELF WITH INFORMATION ON APPLICANTS’ BANK ACCOUNTS.

title: Head of Engineering
description:
**About Pillar**
----------------

Pillar was founded in 2025. Today, we are 90+ people, serve 1000+ customers, raised €15.2M (pre-seed and seed round) and are expanding internationally.

We are building the financial operating system for construction: bringing AI, automation and modern software to an enormous industry still full of slow, fragmented processes.

**We are looking for a Head of Engineering who has built production systems with their own hands, loves making a platform stronger as it grows and wants to lead the engineers who build it.**

**Why join now**
----------------

We have product-market fit and our customers, users and data are growing fast. Now we need someone who makes sure the platform holds as everything grows many times over, without slowing down delivery.

**The mission**
---------------

Own the health, scalability and day-to-day operation of Pillar's platform: lead our engineers, keep delivery fast and the system strong, side by side with our CPO.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Lead and grow our engineers, who report directly to you.
* Make sure the system scales as customers, users and data per customer grow.
* Make the infrastructure calls that keep the platform easy to run, weighing each option against its DevOps and running cost.
* Set and look after the standards for architecture, code quality, testing and reviews across the monorepo.
* Map technical debt, prioritise it and pay it down with a plan everyone can see.
* Balance short-term delivery and long-term health, and make the trade-offs clear to Product.
* Run engineering operations day to day: reliability, incidents, releases, on-call and team rituals.

**Who we are looking for**
--------------------------

**Builders at heart who think at scale and lead with care**

* You have built and shipped production systems yourself, and you can still go deep in code reviews and design docs.
* You have experience in B2B SaaS, ideally multi-tenant platforms with data-heavy workflows.
* You have lived a 1 to 10 phase: scaling a product, its architecture and its engineering team after product-market fit.
* You have made infrastructure and architecture decisions at scale, and paid down technical debt without stopping delivery.
* You have managed engineers directly: hiring, setting goals, giving feedback and helping people grow.
* You explain technical trade-offs in simple words, to Product and to people who do not write code.
* You stay calm during incidents and help the team learn from them, without blame.
* You are AI-native: AI is already part of how you build and how your team works.
* Fluent English. Based in Barcelona or happy to relocate.
* Nice to have: deep Postgres, Supabase and Vercel (and knowing when to move off them), AI agents in production, ERP, fintech or construction, Italian or Spanish.

**How we work**
---------------

* Small squads, high autonomy, no unnecessary layers.
* AI-first, in the product and in the way we build.
* Simple by design: we keep DevOps overhead low and choose managed tools until there is a real reason not to.
* Pillar is not for you if you are looking for a large platform team to manage. We are building it, and you will lead it.

**Hiring process**
------------------

* CV screening
* 30-min People call with Marta
* 1-hour conversation with Lorenzo, usually in person
* Business case, prepared at home (3 to 4 hours)
* Business case presentation with Lorenzo (1 hour, online)
* Conversations with our co-founders Paolo and Gabriel
* Optional: meet our product managers

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Gross salary 100.000-120.000 €, based on experience
* **A real leadership seat:** you will own the platform as it scales, not just keep the lights on
* **A team to grow:** engineers who report to you and want to learn from you
* **The chance to build something that lasts:** the system you shape will change how an entire industry works
* **An AI-native team:** AI is part of the whole development cycle
* **Our Barcelona product hub,** with Italian roots and a team in Milan
* **People who care:** a team that celebrates wins together, gives honest feedback and has fun along the way.

Compensation Range: €100K - €120K

Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  
Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.

You will work directly with the Head of Strategy and the rest of the team, partnering closely with business leaders and subject matter experts across the organization. You can expect to spend your time both supporting the Executive Board decision-making, and working with the business to drive execution. Your contributions will drive strategic initiatives, bring new clarity to complex problems, align stakeholders through challenging trade-offs and ultimately help STG deliver our strategic ambitions. Our team are the stewards of the Focus2030 strategy, and you will play a core part in keeping the strategy alive in the business while remaining responsive to market changes and execution learnings.

This would be an ideal role for an associate-manager level consultant looking to transition into a corporate role so they can take longer term ownership of their projects and see them come to life.

  

**What your day will look like**

As a Manager in the Strategy & Execution team, you can expect to work across a wide range of projects and initiatives. Example projects could include:

* Preparing materials for the Board of Directors strategy days
* Developing a methodology to define future market roles
* Building a business case to optimise our product portfolio to maximise growth and operational efficiency
* Supporting a business team to prioritise their focus areas for the strategy period
* Reviewing our progress to delivering our strategy for the Exec Board
* Creating a new Exec Board KPI dashboard to continuously monitor the success of strategy execution
* Developing a comms plan for Focus2030

Your role will vary from developing content yourself to collaborating closely with others, depending on the project or business needs. Your role will often include:

* Project managing complex, cross-functional projects
* Creating insightful analysis (gathering, testing, combining, summarising, visualising)
* Developing frameworks to bring simplicity and clarity to complex problems and decisions
* Working closely with experts and stakeholders to identify and refine recommendations
* Running workshops with senior leaders
* Building slide decks to tell a compelling message
* Managing and supporting the development of more junior team member(s)
  

**What you’ll bring**

* You will bring a minimum of 3-4 years of strategy and/or management consulting experience
  + Experience in a corporate environment (permanent or secondments) is a plus
* Problem and decision structuring – experience building frameworks to simplify challenges and decisions to enable the business to move forward
* Experience in Consumer-Packaged Goods and/or Retail sectors
* Demonstrated project management experience and attention to detail
* Strong stakeholder management and team working experience
* Demonstrated strong analytical skills including experience delivering complex analyses in Excel
  + Understanding P&L / key accounting principles / Cashflow modelling is a plus
  + Understanding of data structuring principles and leveraging multiple data sources a plus
* Good slide development skills (storyboarding, content development, polishing) for C-level messaging
* A learning and growth mindset – developing yourself and supporting the development of the team around you
* Experience and curiosity in using GenAi tools to accelerate and improve your work, including effective prompting, iterative refinement and critical evaluation of AI outputs
* Professionally fluent in English
  

**What you’ll learn**

* There will be a strong investment in your development where you need it, with a variety of experiences and supportive coaching
* This could include:
  + Deepening your experience in the CPG / Retail sector
  + Refining your presentation skills, to communicate complex topics in a clear and effective way
  + Leading projects that are critical to our strategy success
  + Strengthening your stakeholder management skills in a complex, cross-functional, international organization
* This role will give exposure to senior leaders across business globally and equip you to be a transformation leader with extensive experience working alongside C-suite
* Our Strategy department, which brings together teams focused on strategy execution, consumer insights, business intelligence, data, and sustainability, will provide you with an opportunity to broaden your expertise across these disciplines too
  

**Working at STG & What to expect**

At Scandinavian Tobacco Group (STG), we are so much more than what meets the eye. We combine the strength of global brands with the entrepreneurial mindset that allows people to make a real impact. Here you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, collaborate across borders, and help shape what's next. At STG you'll find more than a role—you'll find opportunities to grow, collaborate across borders, and make a meaningful impact. Our Strategy team brings together over 15 nationalities and 20 languages, for a culturally rich and diverse environment.

We work flexibly and understand the importance of balancing work with your personal life. At the same time, collaboration is a key part of how we work, so you can expect to be in our office in Gentofte or Alcantra at least 3 days per week.

Before starting our hiring process, your application will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We assess each application against key competencies and requirements for the role. * Set clear expectations, run a weekly performance rhythm with your Team Leads and partners, and act fast when results slip
* Make the tough calls when needed - on performance, staffing and priorities

**Lead the leaders**

* Manage, coach and develop our Team Leads in Málaga, building a leadership team that sets a high standard and holds each other accountable
* Potentially Llad one market team directly at first, and stay close to the work by regularly handling cases yourself
* Build a culture of ownership, independent judgement, and pride in the work, with a clear development path for advisors from junior to senior

**Get the best out of our partners**

* Share accountability with our Workforce Management team for partner performance: help define performance targets, train and coach partner teams on their floors, and funnel partner feedback to our enablement teams so root causes get fixed
* Spend time on site with them, review quality together, and reduce escalations that bounce back to the in-house team
* Contribute to partner selection, onboarding and incentive design

**Fix how we work**

* Spot and remove friction on the front line: unnecessary escalations, duplicated work and outdated processes
* Be the operational voice in the rollout of our new case management platform, making sure workflows reflect how cases are really handled
* Bring coaching back to the floor - buddy systems and hands-on onboarding - so new advisors and partner staff get up to speed fast and continuously improve
* Lead the move to a model where complex cases are solved end to end by our in-house experts, with no escalation layers

**Build bridges**

* Work as one team with our enablement functions: be clear about what the front line needs, and hold them to it
* Represent the voice of our guests and hosts in cross-functional discussions with Product, Tech, Sales and Account Management

**What success looks like**

* 30 days: you know every Team Lead, have handled cases in each queue, and have spent time with our partners
* 90 days: shared targets are agreed with Team Leads and partners, a weekly performance rhythm is running, and first quick wins are delivered
* 6 months: measurable improvement in cost per resolved case, CSAT, escalation rates, a stronger Team Lead bench, and all advisors performing to a higher standard

**What you bring**

* 8+ years of experience in customer service or customer operations, of which 4+ managing managers or multiple teams
* Has led an operation of 100+ people across in-house and outsourced teams
* A proven track record of turning around team performance, with measurable gains in both productivity and quality
* Experience managing outsourced support partners (BPOs) on performance and quality
* A leader who sets a high bar and holds people to it, while genuinely caring about their growth - you help your teams meet expectations rather than shield them from them
* Hands-on: you're comfortable stepping onto the floor and handling cases yourself
* Strong with data - you use KPIs to find root causes and drive action, not just to report
* Experience leading teams through change - new tools, new structures - while keeping people engaged
* Experience with complex, emotional B2C cases (eg. travel, hospitality, tour operators), not only transactional ticket queues
* AI-literate: you use AI tools in your own work, and you have run a team alongside AI agents or automation. You know where AI resolves, where it fails, and how to measure it.
* Fluent English; another of our market languages (Spanish, German, Italian, French) is a plus

  

**What we offer**

* **Impact:** Shape the future of travel with products used by millions of guests and thousands of hosts. At Holidu ideas become products, data drives decisions, and iteration fuels fast learning. Your work matters—and you’ll see the impact.
* **Learning:** Grow professionally in a culture that thrives on curiosity and feedback. You’ll learn from outstanding colleagues, collaborate across disciplines, and benefit from mentorship, and personal learning budgets—with a strong focus on AI.
* **Great People:** Join a team of smart, motivated and international colleagues who challenge and support each other. We celebrate wins and keep our culture fun, ambitious and human. Our customers are guests and hosts—people we can all relate to—making work meaningful and energizing.
* **Technology:** Work in a modern tech environment. You’ll experience the pace of a scale-up combined with the stability of a proven business model, enabling you to build, test, and improve continuously.
* **Flexibility:** Work in a hybrid setup with 50%+ in-office time for collaboration, and spend up to 8 weeks a year from other inspiring locations. You’ll stay connected through regular events and meet-ups across our almost 30 offices.
* **Perks on Top:** Of course, we also offer travel benefits, gym discounts, and other perks to keep you energized—but what truly sets us apart is the chance to grow in a dynamic industry, alongside amazing people, while having fun along the way.

Check out the adventure that awaits you on Instagram@lifeatholidu

title: Biology Lab Research Support Technician
description:
ICFO – The Institute of Photonic Sciences is a world-leading research center devoted to advancing the science and technologies of light. Based in Castelldefels, Barcelona, ICFO combines frontier research, education, innovation and technology transfer to generate scientific and societal impact.

Over the past two decades, ICFO has established itself as an internationally recognized center of excellence and a global reference in photonics. Today, with a highly international community of around 500 employees representing more than 70 nationalities, ICFO continues its institutional development aimed at strengthening scientific excellence, organizational effectiveness and long-term impact.

As a public research institution, ICFO is governed by a Board of Trustees and led by an Executive Leadership comprising the Director and the Managing Director, who are responsible for the scientific, strategic and operational development of the Institute.

ICFO is seeking a **Biology Lab Research Support Technician** to join its Biology Lab.

**Position Overview**

The main responsibilities of the Biology Lab Technician will have two components:

* operation and organization of the Laboratories and common areas of the Unit, and
* provide support to the research activity of Lab users.

**Key Responsibilities**

The main responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to) the following:

1. Supporting tasks in the management of the Facility:

* Assist in the registration, control and maintenance of the inventory of biological samples (mammalian cells, microorganisms, worms, model organisms, antibodies, etc.) of the Unit.
* Assist in the purchasing process, registration, supervision and maintenance of the inventory of laboratory consumables, media, reagents and chemicals, safeguarding their correct handling and storage.
* Organization and service of laboratory equipment as well as the glassware and plastic items.
* Handling and management of the biological and chemical waste generated in the Unit.
* Assist with the permanent training activities to Biology Lab users regarding safety and biosafety regulations.
* Assist with the permanent training activities regarding the use of equipment, handling of biological samples and chemicals,
* Development, implementation and vigilance of routine protocols oriented to ensuring the correct handling and disposal of biological and chemical waste generated in the Lab.

  
2.- Research support responsibilities:
  

* Perform routine culture and maintenance of mammalian cell lines, microorganisms and other model organisms.
* Perform routine breeding tasks and basic research procedures involving living animals.
* Assist in tasks related to the preparation and sterilization of culture media, buffers, reagents and additives.
* Perform routine protocols of classic and last generation biochemistry and molecular biology techniques for cloning, extraction, purification and characterization of DNA and proteins.
* Preparation of samples for high-resolution microscopy and nanoscopy techniques.
* Perform routine tasks related to the culture, handling and storage of C. elegans and other model organisms.

**Essential Qualifications**

* Minimum bachelor’s degree in Biological Sciences (Biology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology or similar).
* Updated official credential to work with experimental living animals (Projects and Procedures Design Function. RD 53/2013).
* Minimum B2 English Level.
* Minimum 2+ year experience in a similar position, preferably in an international research and/or academic environment.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience in classical and last generation biochemistry and molecular biology techniques.
* Hands-on experience in microorganisms and mammalian cell culture techniques.
* Hands-on experience in model organisms (mainly C. elegans) culture and handling.
* Hands-on experience in preparation of biological samples for microscopy and nanoscopy techniques.
* Experience in breeding and handling living animals, as well as experience in performing basic procedures involving living animals (euthanasia, surgery, dissection, etc.)

**Personal Competencies**

The successful candidates will demonstrate:

* Service orientation, initiative, proactivity, attention to detail, organizational commitment, and teamwork mentality.
* Strong organizational, planning and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-evolving international research environment.
* Strong communication skills.

**What ICFO Offers**

At ICFO, we offer the opportunity to contribute to the scientific, strategic and organizational development of one of the world’s leading research institutions.

The position provides:

* a highly stimulating and international research environment;
* meaningful responsibility and autonomy;
* competitive conditions commensurate with experience and qualifications;
* a unique location in Barcelona, one of Europe’s leading scientific, cultural and innovation hubs.

**Equal Opportunity**

ICFO is an equal opportunity employer. We hire based solely on merit and potential, regardless of gender, nationality, or disability. ICFO fully endorses the European Charter for Researchers and Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers, ensuring a transparent and supportive recruitment process.

**Conditions**

The contract offered will be a permanent contract for scientific and technical activities (ACT).
  
This is a full-time position.
  
A probationary period of 6 months will apply, in accordance with ICFO’s internal labor regulations and the applicable public-sector labor framework.
  
A salary according to ICFO’s approved salary scales will be offered, commensurate with the level of the position and the candidate’s experience.

**Application Process**

To apply, please submit your:

* resume,
* a cover letter outlining your experience,
* contact information for 2 professional references.

Applications should be submitted via the ICFOjobs platform http://jobs.icfo.eu.

The selection process is conducted in accordance with ICFO’s Open, Transparent and Merit-based Recruitment (OTM-R) Policy, ensuring equal opportunities, transparency, and fair treatment for all applicants. Candidates are assessed exclusively on the basis of their qualifications, experience, skills, achievements, and potential in relation to the requirements of the position. Further information on the recruitment principles and procedures, conflict of interest and the appeals mechanism available to candidates, can be found in the OTM-R Policy.

The selection process will consist of:

1. Eligibility check of applications
  
2. Assessment of merits (education, experience, and language)
  
3. Written test for pre-selected candidates to assess technical knowledge related to the job position
  
4. Interview with shortlisted candidates

The Evaluation Committee will include at least three members and ensure gender balance and impartiality.

Each phase will be documented, and candidates will be notified of the outcome within 15 days of the interview.

**Data Protection**

In accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Organic Law 3/2018, ICFO informs applicants that their personal data will be processed exclusively for recruitment purposes.

description:
**Everything you are looking for and more**

At InPost, we are looking for a Security Manager to lead and drive our security strategy across Spain and Portugal, ensuring the protection of our people, assets, facilities and operations.

Reporting to the Security Director Iberia, you will play a key role in strengthening security standards across our network, managing risks and ensuring business continuity in a dynamic logistics environment. You will oversee physical and electronic security, lead security teams and external providers, manage the departmental budget, and ensure compliance with applicable legislation and InPost Group standards.

This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on operational responsibility, including security systems management, incident investigations, site audits and collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.

Based in San Fernando de Henares (Madrid), you will travel frequently across Spain and Portugal, covering approximately 50% of the Iberian territory. Availability outside regular working hours and on-call support will also be required.

**What responsibilities and objectives will you have?**

* **Security Strategy & Risk Management:** Define and implement the security strategy for the assigned Iberian territory, aligned with InPost Group objectives. Identify, assess and mitigate risks across facilities, transportation and operational processes, ensuring business continuity and resilience.
* **Team Leadership & Workforce Management:** Lead, develop and coordinate security specialists, security guards and auxiliary personnel. Manage workforce planning, schedules, shift coverage, substitutions and team allocation to ensure service continuity and operational efficiency.
* **Budget & Provider Management:** Prepare and monitor the annual security budget, optimising costs without compromising protection. Act as the main point of contact for external security providers, overseeing service levels, performance, contractual requirements and continuous improvement initiatives.
* **Physical & Electronic Security:** Ensure that warehouses, operational hubs and other facilities meet InPost's minimum security standards. Oversee the design, implementation, commissioning and maintenance of CCTV, access control, intrusion detection, alarm and intercom systems, ensuring reliability, interoperability and availability across all sites.
* **Security Systems Administration:** Administer security platforms across the network, including user permissions, access rights, system audits and periodic health checks. Apply basic IP networking knowledge to support connectivity between sites and security devices.
* **Governance & Compliance:** Ensure compliance with applicable Spanish, Portuguese and EU legislation, corporate security policies and relevant international standards, including TAPA and ISO. Develop and implement security procedures, policies and projects across the assigned territory.
* **Audits & Continuous Improvement:** Plan and conduct security audits across facilities, identify gaps, implement corrective action plans and monitor progress. Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to incident reduction, audit compliance, service quality and system availability.
* **Incident & Crisis Management:** Lead incident reporting, assessment, investigation and resolution, coordinating root cause analysis and corrective actions. Manage critical security incidents, coordinate investigations and ensure timely communication with relevant stakeholders. Act as a 24/7 security point of contact for the assigned network.
* **Institutional Relations:** Coordinate with law enforcement agencies, judicial authorities and regulatory bodies, managing official requests and supporting investigations when required.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:** Work closely with Operations, Transportation, Quality, IT, Loss Prevention and Facility Management to embed security into everyday processes and protect the entire logistics value chain.
* **Reporting & Stakeholder Management:** Prepare executive reports and communicate security performance, risks, incidents and improvement plans to regional and Group leadership, ensuring clear and effective communication in Spanish and English.

**Well, what will the requirements be?**

* At least 3–5 years of experience in senior security roles, preferably within logistics, retail or large-scale physical security operations.
* University degree in Security, Criminology, Engineering, Law or a related field.
* Valid Spanish Director de Seguridad (TIP) licence is required.
* At least 4 years of hands-on experience implementing, configuring and administering CCTV, access control and intrusion detection systems.
* Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams, managing security budgets and coordinating external security providers.
* Strong knowledge of security risk assessment, incident investigation, crisis management, business continuity and corrective action planning.
* Working knowledge of basic IP networking to troubleshoot connectivity between sites and security devices. Experience managing security systems across multiple facilities is highly valued.
* Knowledge of private security legislation and relevant security standards, such as TAPA and ISO 28000.
* Proficiency in Excel for data analysis and reporting. Experience with Power BI or similar data visualisation tools is an advantage.
* High level of English (C1) and fluent Spanish, with the ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders, international teams and external authorities.
* Strong leadership, negotiation and decision-making skills, with a proactive approach to risk prevention, problem-solving and continuous improvement.
* Willingness to travel frequently across Spain and Portugal (approximately 40%, typically 2–3 trips per month) and provide out-of-hours and on-call support.

***Nice to have***

* ASIS CPP/APP, TAPA, ISO 28000 or other relevant security certifications.
* Wicklander–Zulawski training or other investigation-related qualifications.
* Training in crisis management and emergency response.
* A Master's degree in Private Security or Security Management.
* Experience in logistics environments or dedicated corporate physical security departments.

**What do We Offer?**

* Language platform

* Wellbeing programme

* Flexible working hours

* Online platform for lifelong learning

* Competitive salary

* Flexible remuneration services can be contracted

**Why join us?**

At InPost, you will play a key role in shaping how millions of customers interact with last-mile delivery solutions. You will work in a fast-growing, innovative environment where your contributions directly support the company’s expansion and market presence. Our culture is built around five key behaviours, driven by a strong “Go Go Go” mindset focused on speed and determination.

* **CHAMPION THE CUSTOMER:** We put the customer at the center of everything we do and strive to exceed expectations.

* **OWN IT:** We take responsibility, act with initiative, and proactively drive solutions.

* **DARE TO DISRUPT:** We embrace innovation, ambition, and continuous learning to grow and improve together.

* **MAKE IT HAPPEN:** We adapt quickly, learn constantly, and move forward with Smart execution.

* **WIN TOGETHER:** We achieve great results through collaboration, recognition, and a shared winning mindset.

**Inclusive Culture**

InPost has an Equal Opportunities Plan that promotes equality at all levels. We aim for equality in the company's workplaces, focused on promotion, as well as gender equality, diversity, equity and inclusion of people regardless of their abilities and conditions.

title: Senior FX Product Manager - Hedging Conversion
description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you're a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we'd love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

**FX Senior Product Manager - Hedging conversion**

**Ebury Madrid Office - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week**

As Ebury scales globally, we are evolving from a delivery-led organisation into a **platform-led product** company - building shared foundations that allow teams to move faster, operate safely in regulated environments and deliver high-quality client experiences across channel

**The Opportunity**

We're looking for a **Senior Product Manager** to own one number: the share of Ebury's clients who convert into hedgers — and to build the journeys, workflows and decision tools that get them there.

Ebury has a real hedging business. Thousands of clients already hedge with us, they're our most valuable and stickiest, and Hedge works. The problem isn't proof of concept — it's rate. For every client who converts, several more carry the same currency exposure, would benefit from the same forward, and never get there.

Here's the honest reason why. Hedging isn't a product you sell; it's a conclusion a client reaches once they can see what their international business is actually exposed to. Today that seeing happens in a CPM's head and a spreadsheet, one client at a time. The client can't see their own exposure clearly, the CPM can't see it at scale, and so the conversation that should be obvious either happens late or never happens at all.

This role builds the layer that changes that: guided journeys and lifecycle workflows that carry a client from unaware exposure to a first hedge to a standing policy — and the decision tools that let both the client and their CPM understand the client's international business well enough to make the right call, not just the next call.

You'll sit at the intersection of product, data, and commercial, working closely with:

* CPMs and Sales teams who convert clients today
* Data and Analytics
* Design and Engineering
* Compliance and Risk
* Clients directly

**What you'll do**

You will own the end-to-end conversion journey into hedging, backed by a dedicated squad of developers, including:

**Journeys & Lifecycle Workflows**

* The path from spot client Hedge-active policy client, and every drop-off point along it
* Guided, staged journeys rather than one-off prompts: the right message, to the right client, at the moment their exposure is real to them
* Triggered workflows off real events, a new currency pair, a large invoice, a rate move against them, a forward maturing
* Understanding what separates the clients who convert from the ones who don't, and building for the difference

**Decision Tools for Clients**

* Showing a client what their international business is actually exposed to, in their own numbers and their own currencies
* Exposure views, scenario and impact modelling, MTM and forward comparisons a finance lead can act on without training
* Turning "should I hedge?" into a question the client can answer for themselves, with confidence
* Balancing honesty about risk against simplicity of decision, the goal is a well-made decision, not a sold one

**Tooling for CPMs**

* Giving CPMs a portfolio-level view of client exposure, trades and performance, so they know who to talk to and what to say before the client asks
* Surfacing the signals that make a conversation timely: unhedged exposure, changing trade patterns, policy lapses
* Learning from the conversations that already convert clients, and productising them

**Repeat Hedging & Policy**

* Turning a first hedge into a second and a third
* Moving clients from ad-hoc trades onto a standing hedging policy they run every month
* Statements, notifications and review moments that build the habit and prove the value after the fact

**Experimentation & Measurement**

* A cadence of A/B tests across the journey, not a feature backlog
* Reading results honestly, including the ones that kill your own ideas
* Building the measurement so conversion, and what's driving it

**What success looks like (12-18 months)**

* Spot-to-hedger conversion rate is measurably higher, and you can attribute the lift
* A meaningful share of new hedgers convert through product journeys rather than a CPM conversation
* CPMs work from exposure signals in a tool instead of instinct and spreadsheets, and cover more clients as a result
* Clients can articulate their own FX exposure — and clients who hedge once come back without being called
* More hedgers move onto hedging policies rather than trading ad hoc
* Product — not people — becomes the primary driver of hedging conversion

**What makes this role hard**

* You're changing behaviour, not shipping features. The instrument already exists and works; the reason more clients don't use it is understanding, trust and habit.
* It's a two-sided problem. Clients and CPMs need different views of the same truth, and building for one badly makes the other worse but the CPMs must know what the client can see to have consultative conversations
* The baseline isn't zero. There's an existing business and an existing way of converting clients, you have to improve on it without disrupting it.
* Exposure is genuinely hard to model. Client data is incomplete, trade history is a proxy for intent, and being confidently wrong about someone's exposure destroys trust instantly.
* You're helping non-experts make decisions with real financial consequences. Oversimplify and you mislead; don't simplify and nobody acts.
* You'll navigate real-world complexity: regional and regulatory nuance, credit and margin implications, and client segments with genuinely different needs.

**Who we are looking for**

Prior FX or hedging experience is a plus, not a requirement. We're looking for someone who can move a hard conversion number in a complex, regulated environment — with strong agency, sharp analytical instincts, and a real feel for why people do and don't act.

**Must-have:**

* 4+ years of product management experience, including at least one role owning conversion, adoption or engagement outcomes end-to-end
* Strong analytics and experimentation skills — funnel analysis, cohort and retention analysis, designing and interpreting A/B tests
* Experience designing lifecycle journeys or triggered workflows, and the messaging that carries them
* Fluent English (daily collaboration with global commercial, tech and Legal/Compliance/Risk stakeholders)

**Nice-to-have:**

* Familiarity with foreign exchange, hedging or other asset classes
* Experience in fintech or regulated financial products
* Experience building internal or advisor-facing tooling alongside client-facing product
* Localisation awareness

**Core Capabilities**

* **Strong Product Fundamentals** — breaks down ambiguous problems into clear product opportunities; comfortable working across UX, data and operations; focused on outcomes, not just delivery.
* **Funnel & Journey Thinking** — instinctively looks for where clients fall out and why; designs staged journeys rather than isolated features; sizes the opportunity before designing the fix.
* **Two-Sided Design** — builds for clients and the internal teams serving them at once; understands the trade-offs between automation and human judgement.
* **Behavioural Instinct** — thinks in triggers, incentives and habit loops; understands that conversion is earned, not shipped.
* **Analytical Depth** — partners with Data rather than outsourcing the thinking; can build the exposure and funnel view themselves and defend it.
* **Commercial Awareness** — understands how product decisions land in revenue and margin; prioritises on business impact, not just user feedback.
* **High Agency & Pragmatism** — comfortable operating in under-defined environments; bias to action; doesn't wait for perfect structure.
* **Deep Customer Curiosity** — regularly speaks to clients and CPMs; uses it to inform decisions, not just validate them.

**Why Ebury?**

* **Competitive Starting Salary** with an **annual discretionary bonus**that truly rewards your performance from day one.
* **Dedicated Mentorship:** Learn directly from experienced managers who are invested in your success.
* **Cutting-Edge Technology:** Leverage state-of-the-art tailor made tools and systems that enable you to perform at your best.
* **Clear, Accelerated Career Progression:** Defined pathways to leadership and specialist roles within Ebury.
* **Dynamic & Supportive Culture:** Work in a collaborative environment where teamwork and personal growth are prioritized.

description:
TANlock, a dormakaba Group company, is a fast-growing technology business specializing in intelligent high-security access solutions for data centers and other critical infrastructure. Since joining the dormakaba Group in July 2025, TANlock has gained access to a global network, expanded international market reach, and exciting new growth opportunities. At the same time, we continue to operate with the agility, innovation, and entrepreneurial spirit that define our company culture. Based in Georgensgmünd near Nuremberg, our dedicated team develops advanced electromechanical rack locking systems, versatile authentication modules and smart IP readers that help secure server and control cabinets around the world.

  

Position overview

This exciting expansion role requires an experienced technical pre-sales manager to lead our pre-sales engineering processes and team across the EMEA, USA, and Asia territories. Reporting directly to the Global Head of Sales, you will work closely with TANlock Regional Sales Managers and inside sales to provide deep technical and business support to new and existing key customers, distributors, resellers, and integrators.

You will serve as technical pre-sales leader and become the "voice of the customer," bridging the gap between our go-to-market teams, our TANlock Sentinel channel partners and our Germany HQ engineering, product, and operations teams.

What you will do

Technical Strategy & Consultation

* Solution Architecture: Discover customer technical pain points to recommend the optimal TANlock configurations (Biometric, RFID, PIN or mechanical locks).
* Integration: Advise/recommend clients on integrating TANlock with 3rd party access control providers, operating systems and management platforms.
* Technical Ecosystem expansion: Build in TANlock technical solutions alongside partner ecosystem OEMs and integrator systems.
  

Partner & Sales Enablement

* Trust Building: Identify and build credibility and authority with client network, IP, and security tech teams to design, test, and validate products for critical infrastructure sites.
* Channel Onboarding: Build and deliver technical training workshops to onboard partners into the Sentinel program for all TANlock products
* Tenders & Events: Guide and shape technical responses for multinational RFQs/tenders and attend trade shows, exhibitions, and distributor roadshows.
* Work in tandem with Regional Sales Managers across partner training, customer visits, pre-tender specification definition, and post-tender support.
* Build an overview of all integration and OEM solutions and leverage these relationships to cross-sell to end customers. Drive knowledge of these integrator solutions into the sales team and promote them to end customers.
* Establish, monitor and expand our competitor comparison matrix so we can monitor and ensure feature and product leadership.
  

Operations, PoC & Lifecycle Management

* Team Management: Train, nurture and lead the pre-sales engineer team and technical sales processes globally.
* Evaluation & PoC: Design, approve and manage Proof of Concept (PoC) deployments alongside local partners to pass validation. Establish a process and test plan to follow.
* Own and develop database and tools which capture all access control software we support, cabinet and server rack door OEM’s and streamline process to develop adaptors.
* Sentinel partners: Support onboarding across their technical sales teams.
* HQ Collaboration: Gather field requirements to assist in the specification of new products and features through TANlock new product development process.
* Support & Intelligence: Diagnose field hardware faults and triage Level 1 post-sales issues before handover to technical support.
  

What we require

* Education: Engineering degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, RF, Electronics, Networking, or Technical Services.
* Domain Expertise: Minimum 7 years of related technical and market experience within physical access IP authentication and access control products.
* Pre-Sales Record: Minimum 4 years of experience in pre-sales or field engineering, troubleshooting hardware, software, and IP systems. OEM or vendor experience is highly beneficial.
* Soft Skills: Proven track record with field engineering, troubleshooting large and complex IP systems and working methodologically to resolve issues.
* Good communication skills required to develop strong relationships with regional sales team, engineering, post-sale support and key technical customer contacts. Able also to leverage relationships with other business units and/or external partners to deliver solutions.
* Self-motivated, inquisitive, and possesses a "Go-Get" attitude with excellent communication skills to influence technical managers and C-suite executives alike.
* Valid German driving license. Commitment to travel up to 40% of the working week in Germany HQ and globally including week-long regional sales trips gional sales trips.

  

What we offer

  

* Competitive salary package with performance-based incentives
* Exposure to international customers and partners
* Direct access to senior leadership and decision-makers
* Opportunity to make a visible impact in a growing business
