title: Managing Tech Lead - Europa Universalis V
description:
You will join the studio as the manager of our technical team working on a live grand strategy game, together with the designers, artists and QA who build and test it. We are looking for a Managing Tech Lead to lead the team and keep the existing codebase healthy: maintaining it, improving it and making sure it keeps supporting the game as it grows.

We care about how the team works: clear technical goals, honest conversations about priorities, and people who grow. If you enjoy helping engineers do their best work, and still want to stay close enough to the craft to make good calls, this is a good place for that.

Here the leads plan, decide and build. Judgment and hands-on work go together. Stay close to the code, develop your leadership skills and make great games.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Manage the programming team: one-to-ones, feedback, career development, performance, hiring and onboarding.
* Set clear technical objectives for the team that support the creative vision and the product roadmap, and contribute to technical direction alongside the other leads.
* Drive improvements to the game and the existing codebase, with a focus on performance, stability and maintainability.
* Work with the other managers to remove blockers, keep production moving and balance technical decisions against scope, schedule and budget.
* Keep the team's work aligned with the roadmap across concurrent update branches, so that we build and release with as few technical setbacks as possible.
* Stay connected to Paradox's wider technical organization, so that practices, tools and knowledge flow in both directions.
* Time permitting, contribute hands-on: implementing features and systems, reviewing code and solving gameplay problems with efficient technical solutions.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* Solid C++ experience in a professional setting, ideally in games, including at least one shipped or live title.
* Experience leading a team of programmers, including the people side: setting expectations, giving feedback, and having the difficult conversations.
* Technical judgment: you prioritize under real constraints, make trade-offs and own the call.
* The ability to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and non-engineers alike.
* A history of improving how a team works. There is a practice, tool or workflow that exists, or was killed, because of you.
* Clear, direct communication in English, written and spoken.

**Things to elevate your application**
--------------------------------------

* Paradox grand strategy experience, Europa Universalis especially. Genuine interest in the genre matters more than logged hours.
* Experience on a live title with a recurring update cadence.
* Experience working with a large, long-lived codebase.

**The Studio**
--------------

Paradox Tinto was founded in 2020 by a small and dedicated team of industry veterans led by Johan Andersson, and building on our experience from Paradox Interactive and Paradox Development Studio, we develop Europa Universalis V, the latest entry in the grand strategy franchise that started it all more than twenty-five years ago.

**The Team**
------------

At Paradox Tinto we work in a small, gameplay focused team, where everyone is part of crafting the player experience and has input on the design of the game. We believe game development should be fun, and we strive for a relaxed, stress-free atmosphere. Being a small studio built from the ground up, we expect everyone to contribute to the development of the studio and its culture. We are also proud of having accessible, experienced managers who lead you and care about you. Your contributions matter to us, to the whole studio, and to the games we make. You will be close to the final product, our community and our fans. We will encourage you to interact with our players directly through social media, our forum, and via streams. Work/life balance matters to us, so our development plans do not rely on crunch. This does not mean we never work overtime, but overtime is relatively uncommon and not encouraged.

**The Location**
----------------

Our office is 300m from one of the beaches of Sitges, a picturesque Mediterranean coastal city. It is well connected by public transport and within walking distance of restaurants, bars, pharmacies, supermarkets, shops and hotels. Sitges is barely 20 minutes by car or bus from El Prat, Barcelona's international airport. It offers 17 beaches along its own coastline, the Costa del Garraf, and an average of 300 days of sun a year, which is hard to argue with for outdoor sports and weekends. Mountain lovers still have the Pyrenees, only a two hour drive away. The town will also captivate you with its cultural events, Mediterranean food and, of course, excellent Spanish wine.

**Some of our benefits**
------------------------

* 25 working days of vacation per year (23 per the collective agreement, plus 2 extra)
* Private health insurance
* Wellhub subscription: gym access and digital wellbeing apps
* A private gym at the office, plus optional free yoga and HIIT sessions
* Cobee by Pluxee flexible compensation, letting you allocate part of your gross salary to meals or public transport
* Free access to the full Paradox catalogue on Steam, over 100 games
* Healthy snacks and soft drinks, a private garden, and regular team activities

If you think this description matches you, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we interview candidates continuously. If you don't match all the requirements, tell us how your passion, attitude and interest in Paradox might compensate.

At Paradox Interactive we celebrate difference and care deeply about diversity and inclusion. We therefore encourage you, no matter who you are, to apply for this job if you think you'd be a great addition to our team.

**Practical information**
-------------------------

Scope: Full-time and permanent

Location: Sitges, Barcelona (Spain)

WFH/WFO: 100% onsite

Reports to: Head of Operations

description:

As an accredited Living Wage employer, we put our people first and fight cruel practices like animal testing, promote regeneration, and show that it is what’s inside that counts - whether that’s an ingredient in a product, or the minerals in a smartphone.  
  
Want to see where a career at Lush could take you? Head over here to explore real stories of growth and development across the business.  
  
Lush is committed to pay transparency and equal pay for equal work or work of equal value. Pay decisions are made objectively based on role scope, geographic market data, experience, and capability, without regard to gender or protected characteristics.  
  
**Role overview:**

Develop meaningful and mutually beneficial relationships between people practices and commercial business success across our European major markets. Engage with regional leaders, country managers, and business partners. Deliver change and transformation, taking the lead in people related projects with a broad and objective view of the impact across diverse business areas and geographies within the region.

This role involves direct line management and leadership of People Leads across our European entities. Driving regional alignment, operational consistency, and team development. You will utilise sound knowledge of Lush people principles and best practices, working collaboratively and proactively with other members of the global and regional people team on cross functional projects, in support of colleagues doing their best work across multiple markets.

**Office Location:** This role will support our colleagues in France, Germany, Italy and Spain and ideally you're main location of work will be Paris, Berlin, Milan or Madrid.

**Business Travel:** As this role will be supporting France, Germany, Italy and Spain, travelling will be a requirement.  
  
**Please note: We may close this vacancy early if we receive an overwhelming response or our business requirements change.**

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Directly line manage and empower the People Leads across European entities, fostering their growth, setting clear operational standards, and ensuring strong local HR delivery.
* Work alongside the Leader/Director, FBP, and their team on a wide range of topics, such as change management, projects, organisational design, recruitment, training and development, and communications.

* Desire to represent a professional and fair approach.
* Strong ability to constantly assess and prioritise the needs of the business and individuals.
* Positive attitude, motivated, action oriented.
* Able to support the growth and development of individuals at all levels.
* Competent in recruiting, interviewing, career conversations in addition to performance management, sensitive feedback, or exit conversations.
* Commercially minded, analytical, and objective, with a strong grasp of regional market data and trends.

title: Head of Performance Creative
description:

****AtlasBrands is looking for a Head of Performance Creative (Meta) to serve as the "CEO" of our primary acquisition channel.****
Because Meta represents 100% of our customer growth, you will take complete, end-to-end ownership of the channel and leading with an obsessive, direct-response creative strategy while cross-functionally overseeing media buying execution.
  
  
You are a world-class performance creative lead who stays deeply in the trenches, studying market trends and competitor ads to craft high-converting hooks and concepts. Your core objective is to build and scale a pod-based creative department that powers rapid revenue expansion while maintaining strict unit economics, total account stability, and proactive resolution of ad rejections and account risk across high-risk verticals (e.g., supplements). Operating as a strategic player-coach, you will transition current lead oversight, build custom tracking dashboards, and recruit an A-player team that executes with speed and autonomy.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Channel Onboarding & Transition: Audit active ad accounts, creative pipelines, and team members to deliver a clear execution plan. Fully assume Meta decision-making (budgets, launches, creative) and seamlessly transition the incumbent lead into a dedicated Creative Strategist role.
* Brand Scaling Systems: Execute staged growth targets for existing brands at first-rebill break-even or better. Establish a standardized launch protocol for new brands to reach scale rapidly while maintaining a near-perfect success rate.
* Retention & Margin Optimization: Shift brands from first-rebill break-even to first-purchase break-even as they mature, sustaining performance month-over-month. Proactively flag risks ahead of time with actionable recovery plans.
* Ad Rejection & Account Health Management: Rapidly troubleshoot and resolve ad rejections, policy flags, and disablements inherent to high-risk verticals (e.g., supplements). Set up and manage redundant account architecture (backup BMs, ad accounts, payment methods) to guarantee zero downtime and keep spend scaling uninterrupted.

* Analytics & AI Operations: Build custom AI-driven live dashboards (using Claude) tracking spend, acquisition costs, payback periods, creative win rates, and rejection rates. Lead concise weekly executive syncs that require zero prep from leadership.

At AtlasBrands, we value your time and expertise, which is why we’ve built a streamlined, highly transparent interview process designed to look for a true partner rather than a transactional contributor.

title: Director of Brand & Communications
description:
A
**profitable DTC pet brand doing $50M+ a year, scaling to $100M+, fully remote**
is looking for an experienced brand consultant, freelancer or agency to lead our brand revamp and set our brand direction as Head of Brand & Community, on a project / consultant basis! You will own how people see and feel about our two brands: the brand story and identity, and the brand moments that build awareness and goodwill, including shelter and charity partnerships, activations and events, PR and community.
  
  
We are looking for someone who has
**done it before**
and really understands building a brand: creating brand moments and knowing how to actually make them happen, so we build our brand and brand awareness from the ground up. The ideal candidate has
**7+ years**
in brand, communications or brand marketing at consumer brands, a track record of building awareness through cause partnerships, events and PR, and has run campaigns for a North American audience.
  
  
**The mission of this role**
Make our brands the most loved and trusted pet brands in North America, not just the most bought. You will own how people see and feel about our brands: a clear brand story and identity used everywhere, and the brand moments that build awareness and goodwill, including shelter and charity partnerships, activations and events, PR and community. Success is more people searching for us by name, more customers coming from word of mouth, more earned press, and a giving-back program customers know us for.
  
  
**Who are we?**
We're a profitable DTC pet brand selling premium stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space - $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched a dog brand, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.
  
  
**What is our culture like & who is a good fit?**
Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:
  
  

* Better Everyday: review every brand moment against its goal, and make the next one bigger, cheaper or better
* Speed Is King: jump on cultural moments and press opportunities the same day, and launch every brand moment on schedule
* Work Smart: use partners, agencies and AI instead of a large team. For example, use Claude to draft press pitches and partner outreach, track media mentions, turn reviews into customer stories, and build the monthly brand-health report from search, survey and press data
* Overdeliver: bring the CEO new partnership and brand-moment ideas before being asked, and get more press and goodwill from each moment than the plan called for

**If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it.**
If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active - then you've come to the right place.
  
  
**Outcomes (what Success Looks Like)**
*90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.*

* More people know and search for our brands: branded search volume and direct traffic, monthly vs the same month last year
* More new customers come from word of mouth and press: share of new customers who say friend, family, press or social (not an ad) in the post-purchase survey
* We earn press and attention: earned media mentions and their reach each quarter, including press from each brand moment
* Our giving-back program makes a real, visible impact: shelters partnered, pets helped, and product and dollars donated each quarter, shown on the website
* The brand looks and sounds the same everywhere: quarterly brand audit across website, packaging, ads, email and social

**Key Objectives**

* Own the brand story, positioning, tone of voice and brand guidelines for both brands, and keep the two brands distinct
* Design and run a giving-back program with shelter and rescue partners that customers know us for, and track its impact
* Build the yearly brand-moment calendar and run each moment end to end: concept, partners, budget, website and email, social and creators, and press
* Run pop-ups, events, sponsorships and stunts, each with its own budget and goal
* Win earned media: pitch every brand moment, cause campaign and launch, directly or through a PR agency you manage
* Build a super-fan community and turn customer reviews, photos and stories into brand content
* Report brand health monthly and own the brand budget

**Requirements**

* Fully remote, project / consultant basis (freelancers, consultants and agencies welcome), based in Mexico, Ukraine or Brazil
* Fluent in English
* Brand Experience: 7+ years in brand, communications or brand marketing at consumer brands is ideal; 5-6 years with strong results is also considered
* Brand Builder: You have built awareness and goodwill for a consumer brand through causes, events and PR, not just design, ideally from an early stage
* Brand Moments: You have planned and shipped brand moments end to end, on time and on budget, across many partners
* Cause Marketing: You have run nonprofit or shelter partnerships that were real, measured and credible, not a logo on a page
* PR & Storytelling: You turn a moment into a story that press and customers repeat, and you have the press wins to show for it
* North America: You have run campaigns for a North American audience, and can run events and partners there remotely through agencies, partners and local contractors
* Brand Taste: A sharp eye for what is on-brand, and you protect consistency across every touchpoint
* Commercial Mindset: You tie brand work to measurable results like branded search, word of mouth and press
* No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You are passionate about your work
* Excellent cultural fit as per our values above
* Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder
* Bonus points: pet industry experience

**Accountabilities**
*What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week.*

* Brand foundation and guidelines: Own the brand story, guidelines and asset library for both brands, review new pages, packaging, emails and key ads before they go live, and run a quarterly brand audit across every touchpoint
* Cause and shelter partnerships: Choose each brand's anchor causes with the CEO, sign and manage national and local shelter and rescue partners, run adoption events and donation drives, and track and report the impact
* Brand moments and activations: Build the yearly brand-moment calendar (National Cat Day, National Dog Day, Clear the Shelters, Giving Tuesday and our own owned moment), run each one end to end, and hand its story and assets to the growth and creator teams
* PR and earned media: Pitch press and podcasts directly or through a PR agency you manage, win reviews, gift-guide placements and awards, keep the press kit current, and track every mention
* Community and customer stories: Turn reviews, photos and stories into brand content, build a super-fan community with surprise-and-delight moments, and make the website show the brand properly
* Brand reporting and budget: Report brand health monthly, own the brand budget (events, donations, PR, sponsorships), set monthly Rocks with the CEO, and write SOPs so the playbook works without one person

**How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate**

* Application + Screening Interview
* In-Depth Interview with the CEO
* Reference Calls
* Final In-Depth Interview with the CEO

**Rate Expectation**
**US$3,750-5,850 per month retainer (or equivalent day rate), based on experience and expertise.**

title: Licensing Manager, Israel & MENA
description:

We are looking to add to our talented team of innovators that can help us manage some of the most profitable and enduring brands in the world! We believe that our partnerships are about clarity, openness, and trust, and we are widely known for our straightforward approach.

**About the Role**

WildBrain CPLG is looking for a commercially driven Licensing Manager to join its MENA team in Dubai, reporting to the Commercial Director, MENA.

The Licensing Manager will take primary responsibility for managing and developing WildBrain CPLG's licensing business in Israel. This will include growing existing licensee relationships, identifying and securing new partners, and building relationships with key retail and commercial contacts.

The role will also support the wider MENA commercial team by developing business cases and pitches, maintaining sales materials, conducting retail visits and providing relevant market intelligence. In addition, the Licensing Manager will support the development of selected location-based entertainment opportunities across the region.

This is a hands-on commercial role for someone who can independently manage existing partnerships, develop new business in Israel and provide practical support to the wider regional growth plan.

 **Job Description**  

* Israel business development and account management
* Act as the main commercial contact for licensees and partners in Israel.
* Develop and implement the licensing strategy for Israel, aligned with regional priorities and licensor objectives.
* Manage and grow existing licensee relationships while identifying and securing new partners.
* Conduct market, retail and category analysis to identify gaps and new business opportunities.
* Develop commercial proposals and lead negotiations for new deals, renewals and amendments.
* Build and maintain relationships with key local retailers to improve retail placement and identify opportunities for licensed products.
* Help expand WildBrain CPLG’s portfolio by identifying opportunities to represent additional brands in Israel.
* Manage account performance and coordinate with Finance on reporting and payments.
* Own the Israel territory forecast, regularly reviewing revenue expectations, account performance and the commercial pipeline.
* Work with Creative Services and Product Development on product submissions and approvals, and with Legal on contract execution.

MENA sales support

LBE development support

* Strong commercial, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
* Proven ability to manage existing accounts and develop new business opportunities.
* Fluent written and spoken English.
* Previous exposure to the Israeli market and understanding of the local retail landscape is preferred.
* Hebrew language skills are preferred but not essential.
* Previous experience in licensing, retail or consumer products is preferred.
* Strong presentation and communication skills.
* Comfortable managing multiple internal and external stakeholders.
* Proactive, organised and able to work independently.
* Comfortable working with commercial data, forecasts and business plans.
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

**Additional Information**

**What We Offer** Working at WildBrain is more than a job — it’s the opportunity to join forces with extraordinary, insightful, and imaginative people who will recognize your talents and encourage your professional growth and development in a work environment that promotes creativity and individuality. We demonstrate our commitment to this by striving to provide a supportive work environment and a corporate culture that welcomes and encourages equal opportunities for all employees. We recognize that people bring experience and talent that goes beyond the technical skills and requirements of a job. If you possess similar experience that is close to what we’ve listed here, we encourage you to please still consider applying. We strongly believe that diverse experience, transferable skills, and passion are key! WildBrain accommodates people with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Applicants are encouraged to make their needs known in advance if accommodation is required.

**About WildBrain CPLG**

WildBrain CPLG is a trusted licensing partner for leading brands worldwide, offering 50 years of expertise building consumer products and location-based entertainment programmes across the entertainment, sport, corporate and lifestyle sectors. With over 20 offices serving the UK, Europe, India, the Middle East, China, Asia Pacific and the US, WildBrain CPLG combines the strength of global reach with expertise in local markets to achieve the best results for partners. title: Head of Product, UX & Design (Product Owners, Experience & Creative)
description:
**Company Description**
Our Client is a real estate developer creating AI-native, agentic homes and workplaces, with an intelligent agent that learns its occupants and adapts the environment toward wellness and longevity. Their approach is built around the idea that a smart home should know you, care for you and make you healthier over time, not just act as a remote control on an app.
  
  
Our Client runs a lab and experience centre where products are tested with real residents and office users, and has a pipeline of thousands of units to deploy into. Our Client is a fast-moving, founder-led organisation, with a mandate to set a new design standard for the industry.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an exceptional Head of Product, UX & Design to own what our client builds and how it feels. The client is creating AI-native, agentic homes and workplaces, spaces with an intelligent agent that learns their occupants and continuously adapts the environment toward wellness and longevity.
  
  
Reporting to the Chief AI Officer (CAIO), you will lead all product owners, product managers, designers and creative talent. You will turn the CAIO's vision into clear product roadmaps and an unmistakably premium experience across every touchpoint: the super app, wall switches, smart mirrors, voice, a 3D AI agent, and the physical spaces themselves.
  
  
We are looking for a design superhero with product leadership depth: someone of the calibre found at Apple, Uber, Noon, Swiggy, Revolut or leading health-tech companies. You must hold a very high bar, and be confident enough to push back when something isn't good enough.
  
  
**Reporting & Team**
Reports to: Chief AI Officer (CAIO)
  
  
Key partners: Head of Technology (engineering delivery); Technical Program Manager; Marketing & Brand (including external brand agencies); Sales & Go-to-Market
  
  
Leads:
  
  

* Product owners: Agentic Intelligence, PWA / Super App, Hardware & IoT. Each owns their product end to end and partners day to day with the Head of Technology's engineering teams
* Product management: Product Managers and Product Associates reporting into each product owner
* UX Design: UX Design Manager, Product Designers, UX/UI Designers
* Creative & Graphics: Graphic Design Manager, Senior Graphic Designer, Motion Graphics Designer

**Key Responsibilities**

* Product Leadership & Roadmap
* Own the product strategy and roadmap across the client's three product lines: the agentic intelligence layer, the PWA / super app, and the hardware & IoT experience
* Lead and grow the product owners, giving each a clear mandate, outcomes and accountability for delivering a complete, working product with their engineering counterparts
* Turn the CAIO's vision into prioritised, sequenced roadmaps that balance residential first (the current priority), commercial workplaces, and later hospitality
* Define success metrics and run the product cadence (discovery, PRDs, sprint reviews, launch readiness) together with the Technical Program Manager
* The Super App & Customer Journey
* Own the end-to-end journey in the PWA, evolving it into the super app for agentic living:

+ Pre-sales: an AI-guided digital brochure, delivered through brokers, that helps buyers choose an apartment and its customisations
+ Onboarding: the resident "interviews" their home agent, building their profile, preferences and household setup (with privacy between family members)
+ Handover: construction updates, fit-out choices and move-in readiness
+ Living: daily control and wellness insights, plus communicating with the home from anywhere

* Design for multiple modalities (chat, voice, a 3D/avatar agent and touch) while keeping the experience simple for people who don't want to "talk to AI"
* UX, Interaction & Design Systems
* Build and own the design system across app, web, wall switches, smart mirrors, tablets and in-space displays
* Define the interaction language for ambient, mostly invisible automation: how the space shows what it is doing, what it detected, and how the occupant can override it
* Champion research and usability testing with real residents and office users in the lab and Experience Centre
* Set and protect a world-class quality bar for micro-interactions, motion and polish
* Creative Direction & Brand Expression
* Lead the creative and graphics team: visual design, motion graphics, product storyboards and sales/marketing assets
* Partner with Marketing and the brand agency so that the brand direction (bold and colourful, "Nike meets Apple", glassmorphism and neumorphism, biophilic cues) shows up consistently in the product
* Produce product vision videos and prototypes that make an invisible, passive experience visible and compelling to investors, buyers and partners
* Wellness, Data & Trust
* Translate biometric and wellness data (from wearables such as Whoop, Oura and Ultrahuman, and from in-space sensing) into insights and nudges people actually act on, without being creepy
* Make privacy and consent a first-class part of the experience, working with the Head of Technology on privacy-by-design

**Requirements**
**Requirements**
**Product & Design Leadership Requirements**

* Product Leadership: Product strategy, roadmapping, OKRs, managing product owners/managers, outcome-based prioritisation
* UX & Interaction: Multi-platform UX (mobile, web/PWA, embedded displays), conversational and voice UX, prototyping, user research
* Visual & Creative: Design systems, typography, motion design, brand-to-product translation; strong portfolio required
* AI Product Literacy: Understanding of LLMs and agents, and how to design trustworthy, explainable AI experiences
* Tooling: Figma (expert), prototyping tools (ProtoPie, Framer or similar), After Effects/motion tooling, analytics platforms
* Collaboration: Proven partnership with engineering leadership; experience working with external agencies
* Leadership: Built and led combined product + design teams of 10+; hiring and mentoring across seniority levels

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hardware-Adjacent Products: Experience designing products that extend beyond the screen into smart home, IoT, wearables, automotive or connected devices
* Health/Wellness Tech: Product or design leadership at a health-tech or wearables company (e.g. Whoop, Oura, Ultrahuman, Eight Sleep) is a strong plus
* Consumer Super Apps: Experience at companies known for design excellence and complex consumer journeys (e.g. Apple, Uber, Careem, Noon, Swiggy, Revolut)
* Zero-to-One Experience: You have built a product and a team from scratch, not just optimised an existing one
* Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: You will push back on a bad idea, including the CEO's, and change your mind when the evidence says so

**Why This Role?**
Most real-estate "smart homes" are a remote control on an app. Our client is building something different: homes and workplaces that know you, care for you and make you healthier over time. You will define the face, voice and feel of that intelligence, from the first time a buyer meets the client's agent on a broker's tablet to the moment a resident's bathroom mirror suggests a better night's sleep. You will have the mandate, the team and the executive support to set a new design standard for the industry.
  
  
**Additional Suggestions For The Candidate**

* Portfolio Is Everything: Please include case studies that show product thinking and craft, ideally including motion and multi-device work
* Think Beyond the Screen: Come ready to discuss how you would design an experience where the best interaction is often no interaction at all
* Bring a Point of View: Tell us one thing you would change about how today's smart home apps work, and how you would do it better

**Benefits**

* Offered Salary: Competitive, in line with market standards for the role and seniority, along with additional benefits as per the company's band structure

title: Senior Director of Experience Design
description:
Full-time  
Remote with some travel

$165,000 – $190,000

**About Us**
------------

The Ammortal Chamber integrates five science-backed modalities into one immersive 25-minute session. It is used in wellness clinics, spas, hotels, and homes. Our clients include specialty spas and clinics, professional and collegiate sports teams, hospitality partners, and individuals who care deeply about their recovery and performance.

We are a small team with a startup culture. After our first full year shipping a finished product, we have shown strong growth, and we are now scaling into our next stage. Our team is made up of engineers, designers, health professionals, and startup entrepreneurs.

As we continue expanding, this role offers the chance to shape how people experience Ammortal at every touchpoint, to build a design practice from a strong foundation, and to make a tangible impact on the future of wellness technology.

**What is this role and why does it exist?**
--------------------------------------------

The Chamber is in more places than ever, and the experience now reaches well beyond the session itself. It includes the screen a guest touches before they lie down, the guidance they hear inside, the tools our partners use to run their day, and the website where many people first meet us. Capable people design each of these today, often in parallel. What we need now is one leader who holds them together as a single experience.

The VP of Experience Design leads design across the Chamber, our software, and our digital presence. Over time you will build the experience design team, the design system, and the standards that keep the experience coherent as we grow. You will report to our Chief Product Officer and work closely with Engineering, Marketing, Customer Experience, and Operations. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will set direction, and you will also sit in the work.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* **Experience vision and strategy:** Define the end-to-end experience for Ammortal, from first impression to the moment a guest steps out of the Chamber. Translate it into principles, priorities, and a design roadmap shared with Product and Engineering.
* **Chamber and software experience:** Lead the design of every interface people use with the Chamber, including on-Chamber controls, the kiosk, in-session guidance, and the apps and tools our partners and guests rely on. Make each one calm, clear, and trustworthy, for first-time guests and regulars alike.
* **One design system across every touchpoint:** Build and own a unified design system, grounded in the Ammortal brand, that spans the Chamber, our software, and ammortal.com. Partner with Marketing and other teams so the website, the product, and the session room feel like one company, one product, one experience.
* **Team and partner leadership:** Lead, grow, and mentor Ammortal's internal design team, including interaction design. Direct external design partners and agencies with clear briefs and a single bar for quality.
* **Research and craft standards:** Build a research practice that brings guests, partners, and staff into major product decisions. Set the reviews, specifications, and standards that turn design intent into shipped quality.

**Skills to Excel**
-------------------

* **Systems thinking across physical and digital**
* + The Chamber is an object, a room, a screen, and a voice. This person treats them as one system and designs the transitions between them as carefully as each surface.
* **Restraint and taste**
* + Our first design tenet is "Less, but better." This person removes before adding, and can explain why a choice earns its place.
* **Calm, credible leadership**
* + Earns trust with engineers, marketers, and executives. Gives clear direction to internal teams and outside partners without adding process for its own sake.
* **Research-led judgment**
* + Turns what guests, partners, and staff do into decisions, and knows when the evidence is strong enough to act on.
* **Hands-on craft**
* + Still designs, prototypes, and critiques at a high level. Comfortable moving between strategy, interface detail, and physical prototypes in the same week.

  
**Requirements**  

**What technical knowledge do you need to perform in your role?**
-----------------------------------------------------------------

**Required**

* Figma, including shared libraries and design system management
* Interactive prototyping tools (ProtoPie, Framer, or similar)
* Design-to-engineering handoff and specification practices
* Qualitative and usability research methods

**Preferred**

* Touchscreen, embedded, or HMI interface design
* Voice, audio, or lighting as interface elements
* Motion design
* Web platforms such as Webflow or Shopify
* AI-assisted design and research tools
* Linear and Notion

**Qualifications (Must haves):**
--------------------------------

* 12+ years in product, interaction, or experience design, including 5+ years leading design teams
* A portfolio of shipped work that spans hardware and software, or physical and digital experiences
* Experience building and scaling a design system across multiple products or surfaces
* A track record of leading both in-house designers and external partners or agencies
* Experience working closely with brand and marketing teams
* Real interest in wellness and in how people feel, not only in how they click

**Qualifications (Nice to haves):**
-----------------------------------

* Experience in consumer hardware, wellness, health technology, or hospitality
* Industrial design or physical product background
* Experience designing immersive or sensory environments (light, sound, space)
* Experience designing operator tools such as staff consoles or business dashboards
* Experience growing a design team through Series A and beyond

  
**Benefits**  

**Pay, Location, and Benefits**
-------------------------------

* Pay range: $165,000 - $190,000
* Equity: 25,000 options vesting over 4 years with a 1 year cliff
* Benefits: 80% health, dental, vision covered
* Location: Remote (US), with some travel to our studio in Mars Hill, NC, about 20 minutes north of Asheville

title: Director of Creative (Remote US)
description:
**Directive Consulting** is the leading B2B marketing agency for companies that are done optimizing for metrics that don't move the business. With over a decade of expertise and 420+ B2B brands behind us, we know what real results look like. We operate through 3 divisions: **Performance, Communications, and Commerce,** each built to share intelligence and align on revenue. Our methodology, **DiscoverabilityOS**, aligns brand and demand to guide your ICP to choose you across every decision point. Across Technology, Industrial, and Services verticals, that system spans everything from Paid Media and **Content** Marketing to PR and Paid Social to Marketplace and Lifecycle Marketing.

At Directive, we're always looking to connect with talented people who care about work that actually counts. As we grow across all 3 divisions, we're seeking forward-thinking people who thrive in fast-paced environments, are obsessed with analytics and storytelling, and are ready to make their mark doing B2B marketing that actually means something.

**THE ROLE**

We're looking for a Director of Creative to lead our Performance Design department — a team that sits at the intersection of creative craft and performance marketing. This is not a traditional Director of Creative role. In this role, you will often wear two different “hats”. You'll be equally responsible for the strategic & financial direction of the department and the day-to-day development of the people and work within it. You'll inherit a team with strong momentum, an established methodology, and a clear positioning — and your job is to scale it.

This role reports to senior leadership and manages the full Performance Design team, including designers, project management, and motion contractors.

**Creative Leadership & Output**

* Own the creative vision and quality standard for the Performance Design department
* Ensure all work meets both craft and conversion benchmarks — great looking and built to perform
* Review and elevate creative across paid social, display, video, and landing page formats
* Build systems and workflows that help support excellent creative output for our clients both internally and externally.
* Ensure we’re running campaigns vs. ads
* Ensure we are testing & learning
* Partner with Directive senior leadership to develop our unique and ownable creative process that supports DiscoverabilityOS

**People Management & Team Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary team of designers and motion contractors
* Set clear expectations, foster accountability, and build a culture where creative people do their best work
* Identify growth opportunities for team members and actively invest in their development

**Strategy & Client Partnership**

* Partner closely with paid media and client success teams to ensure the creative is data-informed from the start
* Represent the department in new business pitches, cross-sell opportunities, and client conversations. While you will not be client-facing from a day-to-day perspective with our clients, you will be expected to meet with them monthly during leadership meetings to discuss quality & results.
* Articulate the value of Performance Design as a strategic capability, not just an execution function.

**Financial Ownership**

* Own and manage the department P&L - helping to make all budgeting decisions around staffing, tech investments, and other investments for the department.
* Monitor margins, manage resourcing decisions with financial impact in mind, and ensure the department operates as a profitable, scalable business unit with monthly revenue targets and direct margin goals.

**AI & Technology Integration**

* Lead adoption of AI creative tools across the team
* Identify where emerging technologies can sharpen output and improve efficiency
* Build AI into real production workflows — not just as a proof of concept

**WHAT YOU OFFER**

**Experience & Background**

* 5+ years in creative roles within performance marketing, paid media, or growth-focused agency environments
* Proven track record in managing creative teams and balancing creative quality with business outcomes
* Comfortable presenting department strategy and financial projections to VPs and CMOs, just as much as reviewing a creative brief

**Business Acumen**

* Strong understanding of how a creative department operates as a business
* Direct experience managing or having visibility into P&L, margin, and resourcing decisions
* You think like an owner and make decisions with financial impact in mind

**AI & Tools**

* Hands-on experience with AI creative tools — generative image, AI-powered video, design analytics, or similar
* Knows how to integrate AI into real production workflows, not just demo it
* Experience with platforms like EyeQuant, Creatify, or Superside is a plus

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* Strong communicator with executive presence who can translate creative thinking into business language
* Track record of building trust with both creative practitioners and senior leadership

**What Success Looks Like:**

In the first 90 days, you've built strong relationships across the team and key internal stakeholders, identified gaps in methodology and workflow, and begun making your mark on the department's output.

Within six months, you're running the department with full confidence — driving creative quality, owning margin targets, making smart resourcing decisions, and positioning Performance Design as a competitive differentiator in new business conversations.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* We have a set living wage at Directive; The annual base salary range for this position based in the US is $160,000-$185,000 USD. This salary range is an estimate, and the actual salary may vary based on Directive's compensation practices, job related skills, and depth of experience.
* Medical, dental, vision plans, disability, and life insurance coverage for you and your family that fit your lifestyle

  + Including a 100% employer-paid plan for you and a 50% employer contribution for your dependents
* Benefits to Support the Whole Person:

  + Mental - Access to certified therapists through Spring Health, membership to Headspace
  + Physical - Physical therapy through Omada, fertility support through Carrott, thousands of Aaptiv virtual workouts, complimentary One Medical membership for primary and virtual care
  + Time Off - Unlimited PTO (2-week minimum), Paid Company Holidays, Your Birthday Off, End of Year Recharge (Closed December 24 - January 1), Paid Parental Leave
  + Financial - Traditional and Roth 401(k) with a 3% company match
  + Bonus - Annual bonus based on tenure, which scales in total amount over time

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

Directive is a remote-first company. This role operates 100% virtually from your home office. We collaborate through Zoom and Slack. You will need a reliable setup, high-speed internet, and a professional working environment capable of running Adobe Creative Suite and video production software without interruption.

We accommodate global candidates in markets where Directive has established business operations, including Canada, Mexico, and the UK. Current, permanent work authorization in that country is required. Due to the nature of this role, you must be able to remain stationary for extended periods, operate design and video software on Mac or PC, and observe and interpret written and verbal communication consistently. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities — contact recruiting@directiveconsulting.com.

**ADDITIONAL INFORMATION**

At Directive, one of our core values is People First. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture in the digital landscape. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you require reasonable accommodations in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to recruiting@directiveconsulting.com.

title: Director of Creative Performance
description:
**Department:** Marketing

**Reports To:** Head of Growth

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Location:** Remote

**Base Salary:** $170,000–$190,000 + bonus

**About Bask & Lather**

Bask & Lather is a rapidly growing beauty and haircare company dedicated to helping consumers achieve healthier hair and feel confident in their natural beauty. Rooted in a scalp-first philosophy, product efficacy and authentic storytelling, we serve customers across DTC, Amazon, TikTok Shop and national retail. Our mission is to help customers grow it and keep it too.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Director of Creative Performance to lead our paid acquisition creative function. You will turn customer insights and performance data into compelling ads, build a disciplined testing and learning process, and develop a reliable pipeline of creative that can sustain profitable spend.

Reporting to the Head of Growth, you will own creative strategy, briefs, production coordination, quality assurance, and creative performance analysis. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring analytical depth, creative judgment, and strong execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Creative strategy and testing:** Build a prioritized roadmap for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other active acquisition channels. Define customer audiences, objections, product benefits, hooks, formats, and hypotheses for each test.
* **Production and delivery:** Translate strategy into clear briefs, scripts, demonstrations, and channel-specific assets. Manage the production calendar, feedback, approvals, and delivery against agreed deadlines.
* **Creative learning and iteration:** Review results with Growth, identify why concepts perform, and turn findings into the next briefs. Expand winning concepts and diagnose weaker executions before deciding whether to revise or retire them.
* **Creators and partners:** Manage performance creative agencies, UGC partners, freelancers, and production vendors. Improve quality, turnaround time, and cost efficiency while building dependable production capacity.
* **Team and resources:** Lead assigned creative resources, establish clear ownership, and manage approved production budgets. Recommend staffing, partner, and capacity changes to the Head of Growth.

**Cross Functional Collaboration**

You will own the paid acquisition creative roadmap and production priorities within approved resources. Growth owns media budgets, campaign execution, and spend allocation; you will jointly define testing conditions, evaluate results, and recommend which concepts merit additional investment.

Partner with Brand and Design to uphold brand standards, and with Product Development and the appropriate reviewers to ensure product education and claims are accurate. Coordinate with Integrated Marketing, Ecommerce, and Retention around launches, offers, customer insights, and reusable assets. Organic social, brand campaigns, and lifecycle creative are partner functions with separately agreed priorities.

**Creative Operations and Accountability**

* Maintain a searchable asset library with consistent naming, concept tagging, performance history, usage rights, and approval records.
* Plan production capacity against the testing roadmap and budget. Flag delivery risks early, resolve bottlenecks, and maintain backup partners for critical needs.
* Establish a consistent review process for product accuracy, demonstrations, brand alignment, platform specifications, and creator permissions before launch.
* Use AI and workflow automation where they improve research, ideation, briefing, reporting, or production efficiency, with human review for accuracy and quality.
* Run a weekly creative review covering results, lessons, fatigue, production status, budget, next tests, owners, and deadlines. Bring recommendations supported by evidence and clear hypotheses.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

During onboarding, you and the Head of Growth will establish baselines, consistent metric definitions, and numerical targets. The scorecard will track:

* **Creative effectiveness:** The share of original concepts that meet agreed acquisition or profitability targets at a defined spend threshold, the spend sustained by winners, and their useful lifespan.
* **Testing and learning:** Original concepts tested, meaningful hypotheses validated, and the speed at which learning becomes new creative. Track original concepts separately from asset variations.
* **Operating performance:** Brief-to-launch time, on-time delivery, cost per tested concept, budget adherence, and production capacity against the approved roadmap.
* **Diagnostic metrics:** Channel-appropriate hook and hold rates, CTR, conversion, CPA, ROAS, and fatigue indicators. Interpret these in the context of spend, audience, placement, attribution, and offer.

Acquisition and profitability outcomes are shared with Growth. Creative output volume alone will not define success.

**Required Experience and Capabilities**

* 8+ years of relevant experience in performance creative, creative strategy, or growth marketing, including leadership of creative teams or external production partners.
* A demonstrated record of developing ads that supported profitable acquisition for a consumer product brand. Beauty, personal care, or wellness experience is strongly preferred.
* Deep working knowledge of Meta and TikTok creative, with experience adapting concepts for YouTube and other acquisition channels.
* Strong analytical judgment and the ability to distinguish a creative insight from an attribution, media, audience, or offer issue.
* Hands-on skill in briefing, scripting, product demonstrations, UGC, editing feedback, and translating customer objections into effective creative.
* Experience managing production budgets, agencies, creators, timelines, and competing priorities. You set clear expectations, surface risks early, and follow through.

**Portfolio and Results Standard**

Be prepared to walk through examples showing the original hypothesis, your contribution, testing approach, spend supported, performance results, and subsequent iterations. We want to understand what you built, how you measured it, and what you learned. Share team and budget scope where possible, using anonymized information when needed.

**Compensation and Benefits**

Base salary of $170,000–$190,000, plus annual performance bonus tied to agreed role and organizational goals. Comprehensive benefits and paid time off.

description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

**21GRAMS, a Real Chemistry subsidiary, is an advertising agency born to make healthcare more human.** Not just in our work, but in how we conduct business, approach client relationships, and treat each other. We believe in being good to each other and hard on the work, and in creating work that makes a meaningful difference for patients, caregivers, healthcare professionals, and brands.

#### **Job Summary**

The Director, Product Design is a senior design leader responsible for setting the product design vision, raising the quality of the work, and building the conditions for teams to deliver cohesive, accessible, and effective digital experiences. This role leads complex engagements across websites, platforms, products, services, and connected ecosystems, translating user needs, brand strategy, business goals, technology constraints, and healthcare requirements into clear experience direction.

This is not solely an execution role. The Director is accountable for design strategy, client leadership, team development, resourcing, design operations, and measurable experience outcomes. They remain close enough to the work to guide critical decisions, facilitate discovery, critique design, and step into high-impact moments while enabling senior designers to lead day to day.

#### **What You Will Do**

**Design Vision and Product Strategy**

* Own the product design vision and experience strategy across a portfolio of complex client engagements, connecting user needs, brand intent, business objectives, and technical feasibility.
* Partner with Experience Strategy, UX, Product Management, Creative, Technology, Data, Medical, Strategy, and Account leadership to frame opportunities, define roadmaps, and establish measurable outcomes.
* Lead discovery and definition activities, including stakeholder alignment, experience principles, journey framing, service blueprints, value propositions, prioritization, and product or platform planning.
* Identify opportunities that extend beyond the immediate brief and turn them into clear, decision-ready recommendations for clients and agency leadership.

**Design Excellence and Delivery**

* Set and uphold a high bar for interaction design, visual design, responsive behavior, content hierarchy, prototyping, motion, and end-to-end experience coherence.
* Guide teams from early concepts through detailed design, validation, launch, and optimization, ensuring that strategic intent is maintained through implementation.
* Oversee scalable design systems, component libraries, pattern governance, and documentation in Figma, working with engineering partners to improve quality and delivery efficiency.
* Build accessibility into the work from the start, applying WCAG 2.2 AA principles and inclusive design practices rather than treating compliance as a final review step.
* Use qualitative research, analytics, usability findings, and business measures to evaluate design decisions and recommend iteration.

**Client and Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Act as a trusted senior design partner to clients, clearly articulating experience strategy, design rationale, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations to executive and working teams.
* Lead high-stakes presentations, workshops, critiques, and decision-making sessions, creating alignment across internal and external stakeholders.
* Partner with project and account leadership on scope, staffing, schedules, assumptions, and change management; surface delivery risks early and propose practical solutions.
* Represent Product Design in new-business opportunities, estimates, proposals, capability presentations, and pitch work.

**People Leadership and Practice Development**

* Manage, coach, and develop product designers across levels through clear expectations, actionable feedback, growth plans, and regular career conversations.
* Create an environment where designers can do their best work, with strong critique, psychological safety, accountability, and thoughtful delegation.
* Partner with Experience leadership on hiring, staffing, performance management, succession planning, and capability development.
* Improve the Product Design practice through reusable methods, templates, standards, training, and responsible adoption of emerging tools, including AI-enabled workflows.
* Contribute to a culture of collaboration across Product Design, UX, Creative, Technology, and Strategy, reducing silos and improving continuity from concept through launch.

#### **What Success Looks Like**

* Clients see Product Design as a strategic partner, not only a production capability.
* Teams have clear experience direction, decision criteria, and an appropriate level of design leadership from discovery through delivery.
* Creates a more consistent, accessible, and high-quality experience across the portfolio.
* Designers receive strong coaching, understand what is expected of them, and demonstrate measurable growth.
* The practice becomes more scalable through better systems, methods, staffing decisions, and cross-functional ways of working.
* Experience recommendations connect to defined user, client, and business outcomes.

#### **What You Should Have**

* 10+ years of experience in product design, experience design, interaction design, or a related discipline, including 3+ years managing and developing designers.
* A portfolio demonstrating leadership across complex, multi-channel digital products or platforms, from strategy and concept through detailed design and launch.
* Experience leading multiple workstreams or a portfolio of client engagements in an agency, consultancy, product organization, or similarly complex environment.
* Deep fluency in human-centered design, interaction design, visual systems, prototyping, responsive design, information architecture, and design systems.
* Strong working knowledge of Figma and modern collaborative design workflows; familiarity with Adobe Creative Cloud and prototyping or motion tools is helpful.
* Practical knowledge of accessibility standards, including WCAG 2.2 AA, and the ability to guide teams in designing inclusive experiences.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with engineering, product, research, content, analytics, strategy, creative, and account teams.
* Excellent executive communication, facilitation, storytelling, critique, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Experience defining design outcomes and using research, usability testing, analytics, and performance data to improve experiences.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity, making informed trade-offs, and balancing strategic leadership with hands-on guidance when the work requires it.

#### **This Position Is a Strong Fit If**

* You can move between the 30,000-foot view and the detail that determines whether an experience actually works.
* You are direct, low-ego, generous with feedback, and able to challenge the work while supporting the people doing it.
* You bring structure to ambiguity, anticipate needs, and help teams make better decisions faster.
* You care about craft, but judge success by the quality, usefulness, accessibility, and impact of the experience.
* Our Company values – *Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always* and *Accountability with an “I”* – really speak to you.
* You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
* You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
* You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

#### **Preferred Experience**

* Healthcare, pharmaceutical, patient support, medical technology, or other regulated-industry experience.
* Experience with privacy, consent, regulated content, and design considerations for patients, caregivers, and healthcare professionals.
* Experience supporting business development, scoping, estimating, and presenting capabilities or pitch work.
* Experience leading enterprise websites, authenticated platforms, service ecosystems, omnichannel programs, or AI-enabled experiences.

title: Community Manager
description:
Kickstarter is the leading crowdfunding platform for creative projects across film, games, music, art, design, and technology. Since our founding in 2009, our mission to help bring creative projects to life has been powered by the people behind the work.

Together, we’ve helped creators around the world launch creative projects that have generated billions of dollars in pledges. That same commitment extends inward. Rooted in shared values, Kickstarter invests in the growth and success of our team, treating employees as whole people and empowering them with the autonomy and space to participate in decisions that shape their work and our company.

Kickstarter is seeking an experienced Community Manager to join our Marketing team. This role sits at the heart of how Kickstarter shows up and is perceived across the places our community talks: social, Reddit, Discord, review sites, forums, and the corners of the internet where creators and backers compare notes. Reporting to the Director, Brand and Communications, the Community Manager will listen, respond, and engage, and will work closely with cross-functional teams to route what they hear to the people who can act on it.

As the owner of Kickstarter’s community presence and reputation, they serve as our early-warning system when sentiment shifts or a problem starts to spread. This is not a “schedule posts and check metrics” role. The ideal candidate is already deep in these communities, knows the norms of each one, and gets a little twitchy when a thread starts to turn.

The salary for this role in the United States is $115,905.50.

#### **In This Role, You Will:**

*Reputation Management and Monitoring*

* Monitor brand mentions, sentiment, and emerging narratives across social, Reddit, Discord, review sites, forums, and the broader web, in real time.
* Spot early signals of reputational risk (a viral complaint, a controversial project, a misunderstanding of our policies), assess severity, and lead the response, partnering with Communications, Trust & Safety, Legal, and leadership on sensitive or high-stakes moments.
* Design and own the escalation framework with Communications, Trust & Safety, Support, Product, Legal, and leadership, including severity tiers, owners, and response timelines.
* Build, own, and continuously refine response playbooks for common scenarios (project controversies, creator disputes, outages, policy changes, and press-driven moments), and run post-incident reviews to improve them.
* Define how we measure community sentiment and reputation, and deliver regular reporting to senior stakeholders that connects trends to business and mission impact, with clear recommendations.

*Community Engagement*

* Show up as Kickstarter in public conversations, in a voice that is human, direct, and well-informed.
* Participate credibly in Reddit and Discord communities, following each community’s rules and culture rather than treating them as broadcast channels.
* Correct misinformation helpfully, de-escalate heated threads, and know when not to respond.
* Support creators and backers by pointing them to the right resources, and handing off to Support when an issue needs a ticket.
* Celebrate creator milestones and engage with backers and make Kickstarter feel present and human beyond our owned social channels.
* Set voice, tone, and engagement guidelines for Kickstarter’s presence in community spaces, and coach teammates who engage on the company’s behalf.

*Feedback Loop*

* Own a community feedback program that turns unstructured community input into prioritized, evidence-backed insights for Product, Design, Policy, Support, and Creator Success, and track what gets acted on.
* Maintain a living picture of the top recurring pain points, feature requests, and trust issues, with examples.
* Close the loop publicly when we ship something the community asked for.
* Build and run a creator and backer advocacy program, identifying enthusiastic community members for testimonials, campaigns, and storytelling.

*Programs and Operations*

* Own the strategy and operation of Kickstarter-owned community spaces (e.g., Discord, creator forums), including moderation guidelines, tooling, and volunteer or mod programs.
* Align Social, Comms, and our creator-facing teams on campaigns, launches, and announcements so community context is built in from the start.
* Select, manage, and optimize our social listening and community tooling, including vendor evaluation and measurement.
* Track emerging creator communities, cultural trends, competitor conversations, new platforms and community behaviors.
* Translate community insights into recommendations that inform marketing, acquisition, and product priorities.

#### **About You**

* You have 4+ years in community management, social media, reputation management, or a related role, ideally at a platform, marketplace, or consumer tech company.
* You have deep, demonstrable fluency in Reddit and Discord, as a longtime participant and not just a brand account. You know what a good community looks like and what gets a brand banned or mocked.
* You have hands-on experience across the major social platforms (X, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Threads), including how norms and audiences differ on each.
* You have experience monitoring and managing sentiment on review and feedback sites (e.g., Trustpilot, App Store and Google Play reviews, Hacker News, and niche forums).
* You have strong judgment under pressure and ambiguity: you can tell a vocal minority from a real problem and a mistake from a crisis, and you make clear recommendations or calls without waiting to be told what to do.
* You are an excellent writer. You can be warm, plain-spoken, and precise, and you can adapt tone to the platform and the moment.
* You have experience with social listening and community tools (e.g., Sprout Social, Brandwatch, Sprinklr, Meltwater, Mention, or similar).
* You have experience building processes and aligning cross-functional partners, and you communicate clearly and credibly with executives, Legal, and Trust & Safety when stakes are high.
* You have a track record of owning a community, reputation, or voice-of-customer program end to end, with measurable results.
* You are familiar with crowdfunding, creator economy, or maker communities (games, comics, film, music, design, publishing, tech).
* You are familiar with platform-specific communities like BoardGameGeek, Product Hunt, Indie Hackers, or creator-focused Discords.
* You have experience handling public-facing communications during controversies or policy changes.
* You have data skills: you are comfortable building dashboards or pulling insights from large volumes of unstructured text.

**Our Fully Virtual Team**

We’re currently able to support employees based in the following US locations: CA, CO, CT, GA, IL, MA, MD, NC, NJ, NY, OR, SC, VA, VT, and WA. We're also able to support employees in the United Kingdom. If you live in—or are willing to move to—any of these locations, we look forward to your application! If there is a required or preferred location for an open role, it will be listed in the job description.

Kickstarter is an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to fight for equality, we work to ensure a fair and consistent interview process. We celebrate diversity, and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.

Reminder to applicants: Authentic communications from Kickstarter will always originate from official Kickstarter email domains (@kickstarter.com). Exercise caution and verify the legitimacy of anyone who claims to be representing Kickstarter on other platforms.

Please reach out to Kickstarter’s Help Center to report potentially fraudulent contact here: https://help.kickstarter.com/hc/en-us/requests/new

Care Access is working to make the future of health better for all. **With hundreds of research locations, mobile clinics, and clinicians across the globe, we bring world-class research and health services directly to communities that often face barriers to care.** We are dedicated to ensuring that every person has the opportunity to understand their health, access the care they need, **and contribute to the medical breakthroughs of tomorrow.**

**This is a full-time, 6-month temporary position.**

If storytelling were in the Olympics, you'd be a gold medalist. You want to join a team that's not just about work; you want to make an impact and leave an amazing legacy behind. Your daily diet includes passion, self-motivation, proactiveness, creative thinking, flexibility, and juggling responsibilities, and you are not intimidated by new challenges. You're not looking for a job, you're looking for a playground for your brilliance in story telling via creative audio/video production.

You log in early morning while sipping coffee or tea and realize that there is a Care Access event taking place in Santa Claus, Indiana. You quickly, without hesitation, pitch several ideas to the team. Dept Manager messages the team: "Folks! We accidentally hired a genius!". As challenges and barriers face you, you know that you're not alone. You communicate with team members in removing those barriers.

The plot thickens; you must be in three places at the same time! You resolve that by vetting and finding resources. While that is taking shape, you realize that this is not about projects. This is about human lives and the future of medicine. Finally, you do not end up with completed projects; you end up being part of the ever-evolving story of the future of medicine.

* Pre-Production Strategy: Oversee all facets of the pre-production lifecycle, creating comprehensive shot lists, scheduling production timelines, and building visual storyboards to align the crew before filming.
* On-Set Directing & Production Leadership: Confidently manage physical film sets, direct on-screen talent, and collaborate closely with cinematographers, designers, and crew members to ensure brand alignment and story integrity.

**Summary**

Yelp’s mission is to connect people with great local businesses, and our social channels are a vital part of how we inspire discovery and build love for the brand. As the Social Media Specialist on the Consumer Growth Marketing team, you’ll be the person who knows what people are saying about Yelp, local businesses, and culture, and what Yelp should do about it. You’ll run social listening and community engagement, identify the cultural moments Yelp should tap into, own static asset production in close partnership with our video lead, and lead nuanced engagement on Reddit. This role calls for a high level of independence and judgment, and reports to the Associate Director of Social Media.

We’d love to have you apply, even if you don’t feel you meet every single requirement in this posting. At Yelp, we’re looking for great people, not just those who simply check off all the boxes. This is a full-time remote role based in the United States.

**What you'll do:**
-------------------

* Run day-to-day social listening across Yelp, competitors, the local business landscape, and wider culture in Brandwatch, including building and maintaining Boolean queries, topic tags, and alerts.
* Identify the cultural moments Yelp should tap into, from fashion weeks and award shows to viral trends and local events, and pitch the unexpected, useful angle that earns Yelp a place in the conversation.
* Move fast on those moments: shape the idea, build the asset, and get it approved and live while the moment is still happening.
* Turn signals into recommendations with a clear loop (what we’re seeing, why it matters, what we should do, who owns it); deliver recurring listening readouts and quick-turn analyses for launches and news cycles.
* Own proactive and reactive community engagement across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, Threads, X, and Facebook, writing replies that sound human, quick, and unmistakably Yelp.
* Lead nuanced engagement on Reddit: build a trusted presence in local food, city, and home services subreddits, handle critical and sensitive threads with care, and develop the playbook for when Yelp posts, replies, or stays out.
* Own static asset production from concept to publish, including reactive posts, carousels, static graphics, copy-led posts, and UGC features, using Canva and Figma.
* Partner closely with our video lead so that every insight and cultural moment lands in the right format, and plan the biggest moments together.
* Source, vet, and clear user-generated and review-based content for our channels.
* Manage the social editorial calendar in Wrike and Sprout Social, balancing planned campaigns with always-on and reactive content.
* Flag risks early and collaborate cross-functionally with Comms, PR, Support, Brand, Creative, and Product Marketing on escalations and campaigns.
* Report on content and community performance; deliver clear recommendations on what to repeat, change, scale, or stop.

**What it takes to succeed:**
-----------------------------

* 4+ years in social media for a consumer audience, with hands-on experience across social listening, community management, and content production.
* A strong read on culture: you know which moments are worth joining, which aren’t, and how a brand can show up in a way that feels earned. Include 2–3 examples of reactive or culture-led work with your role and results.
* A portfolio of static and carousel work that shows a strong design eye (Canva, Figma, or Adobe). Include 2–3 examples of reactive or culture-led work with your role and results.
* Working fluency with a social listening tool (Brandwatch, Sprinklr, Talkwalker, Meltwater, or similar), including writing Boolean queries.
* Deep fluency in platform norms, especially Reddit, where tone and timing make or break a brand’s presence; experience building a brand presence on Reddit is a strong plus.
* Sharp, adaptable writing, with a feel for when to be funny, helpful, or quiet.
* Strong judgment under pressure about when to engage, when to escalate, and when to stay out.
* Ability to work independently: take a loose brief, make judgment calls, and deliver finished work without close supervision.
* Exceptional organizational skills and experience managing a content calendar across multiple channels and stakeholders.

--------------------

* 15 days PTO (accrual begins on date of hire and increases with 2+ years of tenure thereafter), 12 paid holidays, plus one floating holiday
* Up to 14 weeks of parental leave
* Monthly wellness subsidy
* Work from home reimbursement
* Flexible spending account
* 401(k) retirement savings plan
* Employee stock purchase plan
