title: Associate Director, Client Management (Influencer & Celebrity)
description:
Brilliant is seeking a full-time **Associate Director, Client Management** for our Influencer & Celebrity team. This role will own the day-to-day client relationship and keep every influencer program on time, on budget, and flawlessly executed.

**The Role**
------------

This is a client-facing, project-management-first role. All day, every day, you are the voice of Brilliant to our clients: you run the calls, write the recap, chase the approvals, and make sure nothing slips. Our strategy and talent leads build the programs; you make sure they get delivered.

You are hyper-organized. You know where every creator, contract, deliverable, and invoice stands at any moment. You understand influencer budgets inside and out, and you have done this in high-volume agency settings where dozens of creators and multiple brands are live at once.

**Who We Are**
--------------

We’re a fully remote performance team built on a simple promise: *Work Hard. Play Hard. Laugh Hard.*

We aren't for the faint of heart. We move fast, hold a ridiculously high bar for excellence, and thrive on driving real ROI for our clients. But we also believe that intense drive should come with great culture, which is why we offer unlimited PTO, Fabulous Fridays (doors close at 3pm), virtual happy hours, a monthly book club, and endless reasons to win together.

And the industry notices: we were recently named an **Inc. Best Workplace 2026** and landed on the **Inc. 5000 List of America's Fastest-Growing Private Companies for 2026.**

**What We Do**
--------------

Since 2008, Brilliant has been where bold ideas meet relentless execution. We're a performance marketing agency with deep expertise in family-focused brands, bringing together PR, Influencer, Social, Paid Media, Affiliate, Retail Support, Experiential, and AI Intelligence to create integrated, full-funnel campaigns that shatter targets and cut through the noise.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Own the client relationship**

* Serve as the primary day-to-day point of contact for multiple influencer and celebrity accounts across Zoom, email, and Slack.
* Lead weekly status calls and client meetings, and send same-day recaps with clear next steps, owners, and deadlines.
* Know your clients’ brands, products, retail calendars, and stakeholders cold, and build relationships they trust.
* Manage expectations proactively: flag risks early, present solutions, and keep clients informed before they have to ask.
* Pull together campaign data, content, and results for client reviews, QBRs, and milestone presentations.
* Listen critically in every meeting to spot incremental opportunities within existing accounts, and bring them to leadership.

### **Run the project, end to end**

* Own campaign timelines from kickoff through final reporting, so every program is delivered on time and aligned with client objectives.
* Build and maintain project management tools and trackers (AirTable, Asana, or similar) that give the team and clients a single source of truth.
* Track every moving piece: creator outreach, contracts, product shipments, content drafts, client approvals, go-live dates, and usage windows.
* Coordinate across Brilliant’s strategy, talent, paid media, PR, social, and analytics teams to keep integrated campaigns in sync.
* Ensure every program meets FTC disclosure guidelines and brand safety standards.
* Keep creator issues to a minimum, and handle the ones that arise calmly and quickly.

### **Manage the money**

* Own influencer budgets on assigned accounts: track talent spend, gifting, product costs, fees, and paid amplification against approved budgets.
* Build and maintain budget trackers and flag overages or underspend before they become problems.
* Lead monthly billing reconciliation with finance, making sure creator payments, invoices, and client billing match.
* Provide inputs on account profitability and scope, and raise when work is drifting out of scope.

### **Lead and develop the team**

* Oversee specialists and coordinators on campaign execution, and set the standard for client correspondence, follow-through, and attention to detail.
* Mentor junior team members: what training do they need, and how can we encourage their growth?
* Help build and improve the client management processes, templates, and playbooks that let the team scale without sacrificing quality.

### **Stay sharp**

* Keep a pulse on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Pinterest, and emerging platforms, and share trends with clients and the team.
* Bring energy to brainstorms and push the team to think bigger.

**Our Dream Team Member**
-------------------------

* 5–7 years of client service or account management experience, with at least 3 years in influencer marketing.
* Experience in a high-volume influencer agency setting, managing many creators and multiple brands at once. Large-agency experience strongly preferred.
* A deep understanding of influencer budgets: talent rates, fees, gifting, usage rights, whitelisting costs, and how they roll up to a client budget.
* Experience leading monthly billing reconciliation and tracking account profitability.
* Hyper-organized. You build the tracker, you live in the tracker, and you never miss a deadline.
* Fluency in project management tools such as AirTable or Asana, plus familiarity with CreatorIQ, HypeAuditor, Shopify Collabs, or similar platforms.
* Working knowledge of paid, gifted, affiliate, and ambassador programs, plus whitelisting, Spark Ads, and Partnership Ads.
* Experience overseeing or mentoring junior team members.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with composure and confidence on camera in client meetings.
* Can manage up, manage down, and keep a million moving pieces running smoothly.
* Resourceful, committed, deliberate, and genuinely enjoys crossing things off the list.

### **Bonus Points**

* Experience with parenting, baby, kids, toy, or family lifestyle brands.
* Experience with celebrity talent partnerships and working with agents, managers, and publicists.
* Experience on integrated campaigns that combine influencer with PR, experiential, or retail activations.
* A slight obsession with Amazon, online shopping, and discovering new products.

**Benefits**
------------

* Unlimited PTO
* Paid time off between Christmas and New Year's
* Fabulous Fridays: the work day ends at 3pm all year
* 401K with a 3% company match (immediately vested) after the initial 3 months
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Medical and Dependent Care FSA
* Company-paid Life Insurance
* Company-paid Long-Term Disability

**Salary Range:** 85K–95K

title: Director, Brand Marketing
description:
As a Director of Brand Marketing, will own the evolution of MongoDB's global brand identity and creative expression. MongoDB isn't just about logos or design systems—it's about driving real business outcomes, translating our complex technical offerings into stories and experiences, and fostering pride and loyalty among all audiences. This is your chance to shape the creative future of one of the fastest-growing enterprise companies in the world.

You will lead and influence all aspects of MongoDB's brand visual expression. You are an articulate champion for design, passionate about quality and craft, and an experienced leader of diverse teams who can elevate ambitious work while delivering outstanding business results. Reporting to the VP of Corporate Marketing, you will work with peer leaders in Marketing and Product to transform the MongoDB brand to drive mindshare and market share with developer and executive audiences.

You are responsible for leading a team of creative professionals and collaborating with marketing, product, and sales to develop marketing plans, analyze results, and identify opportunities. You are also responsible for meeting budget requirements by forecasting and managing expectations.

### **What you'll do:**

Strategic Impact & Vision

* Develop and articulate a bold, clear, and compelling brand strategy that enhances MongoDB's market differentiation, emotional resonance, and business impact with audiences ranging from developers to senior executives
* Translate MongoDB's business priorities into powerful creative concepts and brand campaigns. Partner with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to craft ideas that move both our brand and the business forward
* Identify and resolve strategic challenges by innovating bold, creative solutions that drive transformation and brand loyalty
* Establish operational goals and metrics to measure awareness, emotional resonance, loyalty, and business outcomes—and implement mechanisms to continuously optimize MongoDB's brand performance globally

Creative Leadership & Brand Development

* Push the boundaries of our brand expression—from timeless visual systems to innovative campaigns—delivering emotional, human-centered work while staying connected to MongoDB's technical roots
* Lead narrative-driven storytelling across a variety of mediums (digital, video, events, product experiences, swag, etc.). Make technical complexity feel engaging, empowering, and relatable
* Stay ahead of emerging creative technologies, including AI, generative design, motion, and interactive storytelling. Leverage these tools not just for efficiency, but to unlock bold, new creative possibilities
* Build for digital-first experiences across platforms. Think intuitively about feeds, formats, and moments, creating a brand presence designed for today's fast-moving, online world
* Lead the refresh of our brand foundation and visual identity, ensuring MongoDB's design system is distinct, scalable, and future-ready

Team Leadership & Collaboration

* Recruit, mentor, and inspire a multidisciplinary creative team of designers, content creators, illustrators, and more, fostering a culture of excellence and inclusion where bold ideas thrive
* Champion a culture of creativity and collaboration, driving strong concept development, attention to craft, and team cohesion
* Build partnerships across Product, Marketing, Employee Experience, and Corporate Communications to ensure brand consistency and cohesion across all touchpoints
* Serve as a key brand ambassador internally and externally, confidently articulating MongoDB's brand vision to executives, employees, and the wider ecosystem

Executional Excellence

* Deliver scalable, high-impact creative campaigns and brand experiences that resonate with developers and executive audiences alike
* Manage resources, timelines, and budgets with strategic efficiency that maximizes ROI while ensuring quality and innovation across projects
* Set a high bar for creative output, inspiring teams to raise the standard for storytelling, emotional connection, and visual expression at MongoDB
* Experiment boldly across digital, live events, swag, and interactive environments to create unforgettable experiences that make "using MongoDB" synonymous with belonging to something bigger

### **What you'll bring to the table:**

* Elevate our storytelling in product and company narratives through clear and compelling visual designs and elements
* Develop and articulate a compelling design vision and operational strategy aligned with MongoDB's goals
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners to align creative work with business objectives and achieve pull-through across brands' platforms. This includes centralizing brand information, guidelines, collaboration tools, and digital asset management to ensure consistent brand communication
* Present design concepts and strategies to senior leadership, influencing decisions and direction. Through regular reviews and meetings, ensure clarity and consistent workflow
* Communicate effectively with cross-functional teams to ensure successful project buy-in and execution
* Track industry trends and best practices, bringing innovative ideas back into MongoDB
* Maintain and model a high bar for quality and taste
* Prioritize work and resources across engagements based on short- and long-term needs and develop schedules by collaborating with designers, copywriters, and production artists
* Conduct brainstorming sessions with the creative team, maintaining strategic thinking to develop innovative and actionable initiatives in a fiscally responsible manner
* Review and approve art and copy developed by the team, ensuring that deliverables effectively address marketing goals and challenges
* Lead creative and design direction for brand initiatives, ensuring consistency and excellence
* Inspire, mentor, and lead a diverse team of design practitioners, fostering a culture of excellence, creativity, and collaboration
* Direct multiple projects, stakeholders, and budgets within deadlines. Manage budgets efficiently, maximizing ROI

### **Required skills and qualifications**

* 10+ years of design leadership in an external agency and/or internal brand team
* Experience crafting and operationalizing branding and design systems for B2B, technology/SaaS brands across print, digital, video, etc. Experience working at or with databases, data analytics, data science, or similar products is a plus
* Leadership of creative production and execution of large in-person events and marketing campaign design alike
* Proven ability to develop successful concepts
* Strong creative vision with an eye on business objectives
* Experience in creating integrated content across all marketing channels: digital, social media, paid media, mobile, offline, and print
* Experience recruiting, retaining, and growing a team of diverse, talented creatives
* Excellent creative management skills with the ability to effortlessly meet deadlines on multiple projects with varying timelines
* Experience working in a fast-paced, high-volume, deadline-oriented environment
* Experience collaborating with cross-discipline senior stakeholders
* Experience pitching ideas that articulate a strategic design approach
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* A positive, kind team player with an optimistic, enthusiastic attitude who's able to collaborate with and influence peers to overcome obstacles

Preferred skills and qualifications

* Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in marketing or business
* Experience as a copywriter, graphic designer, or production artist
* Experience in project management, with a focus on creative direction

### **About MongoDB**

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

title: Director, Marketing Communications
description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered, and recognized.

**What You Can Expect**
-----------------------

Reporting to the Vice President of External Communications, the Director, Marketing Communications leads a team that translates complex innovation into bold, clear campaigns and promotional tactics across Zimmer Biomet’s hip, knee, upper extremities, sports medicine and technology portfolio. You’ll coach a team and give them room to experiment, challenge convention and turn the strongest ideas into campaigns that connect our technology and products to the needs of surgeons and patients to build demand and support sales. You’ll make sure surgeon, HCP and/or patient perspectives come through in our stories, then use clear measures to show what is working and where campaigns can improve. This is an opportunity for a creative leader who pairs imagination with insight and can show how great marketing communication moves the business forward.

**How You'll Create Impact**
----------------------------

* Own the marketing communications strategy for Zimmer Biomet's knee, hip, upper extremities, sports medicine and technology portfolio, ensuring all content and message development is aligned with business strategy and corporate brand goals
* Partner with business unit Marketing to convert business and product strategy into clear creative briefs that ultimately develop into campaigns and/or strategies that generate demand and increase sales.
* Develop campaigns, messaging frameworks, narratives, videos and proof points for the company's portfolio and serve as the authority on messaging to external audiences on our products. Translate robotics, AI, data analytics and implant capabilities into clear, evidence-based stories that help surgeons understand how these tools can support decisions for each case.
* Build and communicate strategy to the team, business partners and senior leaders, creating clarity on priorities, trade-offs, resourcing and expected business outcomes.
* Define and report campaign and product-program metrics tied to commercial goals. Use data, customer insights and competitive intelligence to refine messaging, channel mix and investment decisions, and show how the work contributes to product demand and sales.
* Coordinate interviews and voice of customer sessions with surgeon customers to bring their perspectives into product stories and campaigns. Develop surgeon testimonials and other third-party endorsement strategies in partnership with Legal, Regulatory and Compliance, with appropriate permissions, substantiation and disclosures.
* Ensure alignment of strategic communication plans across business units and identify new cross-portfolio and cross-functional opportunities that increase brand awareness and market share.
* Lead the overarching surgeon- and HCP-facing content integration strategy across print, digital, social and event channels, and oversee the promotional presence for assigned business units, including review and approval of content.
* Lead marketing communications for product launches, clinical and evidence milestones and major congresses, and serve as the marketing communications management approval within the NPI/Business
* Review Checkpoint/Tollgate process, ensuring resources and tasks are assigned to clear each Checkpoint.
* Ensure all content is consistent with Zimmer Biomet brand positioning, architecture and visual identity, and compliant with applicable regulatory, legal and industry advertising and promotion requirements.
* Collaborate with internal cross-functional partners, including Leadership, to influence and align product messaging across all channels.
* Maintain controls, systems and standards that govern marketing and informational materials.
* Manage spend including agency and vendor partnerships, ensuring the right balance of internal and external resources to deliver projects on time and within budget.
* Manage, develop and upskill the team, mentoring in strategy and message development and sustaining an empowered, positive work environment across a distributed team.
* Maintain a high level of industry and communications knowledge to keep Zimmer Biomet brands relevant and gaining share.

***\*\*This is not an exhaustive list of duties or functions and might not necessarily comprise all of the essential functions for purposes of the Americans with Disabilities Act.***

**What Makes You Stand Out**
----------------------------

* Strategic Communications Leadership: Ability to think strategically and translate complex business, clinical and technical information into clear, differentiated messaging and integrated communication plans that advance portfolio and enterprise objectives.
* MedTech Market and Regulatory Acumen: Knowledge of the orthopedic/MedTech market, surgical and selling processes, and the development and regulatory environment, including evidence-based claims and advertising and promotional review requirements.
* Execution Excellence: Excellent organizational and program management skills, with the ability to handle many issues independently and prioritize accordingly; consistently supports timely execution with precision and within budget while sustaining a longer-term strategic view.
* People Leadership and Development: Skilled at building, coaching and upskilling teams and mentoring communications leads, particularly in developing direct reports' strategic thinking and messaging capabilities, and at leading effectively in a fully remote environment.
* Influence and Cross-Functional Partnership: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to influence and lead cross-functional, multi-disciplined teams, clearly convey information, and inspire confidence in internal and external stakeholders at all levels.
* Customer Insight: Ability to bring surgeon and customer perspectives into campaigns, develop compliant testimonials and third-party endorsement strategies.
* Campaign Measurement and Optimization: Experience in setting clear objectives, tracking campaign performance against commercial goals, and adjusting strategy, messaging or channel mix when results fall short of expectations.

**Education and Experience**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's Degree and 8 years of relevant experience, or Associate's Degree and 10 years of relevant experience, or High School Diploma or Equivalent and 12 years of relevant experience required
* 2 years of experience as a people manager required; 3+ years with direct reports is strongly preferred
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing portfolio, brand or marketing communications strategies for a global, matrixed organization, including ownership of a budget and agency partners required.
* Experience in MedTech, Life Sciences or another regulated healthcare environment strongly preferred, including familiarity with promotional review and new product introduction Checkpoint/Tollgate review processes.
* Bachelor’s degree in communications, journalism, marketing or a related field preferred; agency and in-house experience helpful.

**Travel Expectations**
-----------------------

* Domestic and international travel up to 35% annually.

EOE/M/F/Vet/Disability

Expected Compensation Range: $185k to $205k, plus target bonus and LTI

* Partner with Revenue Marketing, Demand Gen, User Growth, Social Media and Product Marketing to connect brand to pipeline and business results, influencing priorities through data and shared goals.

**Who You Are**

* This is a hybrid role based in New York, NY (availability to go to the office once a month). Willing to travel frequently for brand events, including at short notice and internationally, and to be available for in-person meetings with agencies, partners or the office with little advance notice.
* A proven brand builder with solid experience in brand marketing, including team leadership, and a track record of building and executing consumer brand strategy in the US (positioning, campaigns and brand-led activations) with measurable impact on awareness or consideration.
* Hands-on in experiential and event marketing, with experience managing agencies, vendors and local partners to deliver brand events and campaigns end-to-end.
* Experienced in partnerships, sponsorships or experiential marketing in the US, with a strong local network of vendors and partners.
* Skilled at translating global brand guidelines into culturally relevant US execution while keeping consistency with a global team.
* A self-starter who brings ideas to the table and builds without waiting to be asked, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
* Comfortable building in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment where scope, budget and sequencing can evolve.
* A strong communicator who adapts to the audience (senior global leadership vs. local team) and works effectively across time zones with colleagues in Brazil and Europe.
* A people leader with a focus on development and documented performance.
* A regular user of AI tools in your day-to-day work (ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Perplexity or similar).
* Background in high-growth environments, regionalized operations or subscription businesses is a plus, as is experience in B2B2C, HR tech, benefits or wellness (not a requirement).
* Fluent in English; Spanish or Portuguese is a plus.
* Background in high-growth environments and/or regionalized operations, ideally in B2B2C, HR tech, benefits, wellness or subscription businesses (a plus, not a requirement).

title: Head of Apparel Design & Product Development
description:
**Company:** Controlled Insanity  
**Position:** Full-Time  
**Department:** Product Development & Design

Controlled Insanity is a premium bodybuilding and streetwear brand focused on creating innovative, heavyweight apparel that challenges traditional gymwear. We pride ourselves on unique garment construction, distinctive silhouettes, premium materials, and designs that stand apart from the standard fitness apparel market.

We are looking for someone who shares this vision and can help push the boundaries of what our clothing can become.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly creative, experienced, and innovation-driven **Head of Apparel Design & Product Development** to lead the development of new clothing concepts, garment bases, silhouettes, and product innovations for Controlled Insanity.

This person will be responsible for continuously researching, conceptualizing, designing, and developing new apparel from the initial idea all the way through finalized, manufacturer-ready tech packs and production.

We are not simply looking for someone who can take an existing garment and make minor adjustments. We want someone who can independently come up with original garment concepts, identify opportunities in the market, experiment with new construction techniques, and develop completely new product bases that give Controlled Insanity a competitive advantage.

You will play a major role in shaping the future of our product catalog and establishing a recognizable design identity for the brand.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Apparel Design & Innovation**

* Continuously develop new and innovative clothing concepts and garment bases.
* Create original silhouettes, fits, cuts, paneling, seam placements, and construction techniques.
* Develop unique variations of existing product categories while introducing entirely new categories.
* Experiment with unconventional garment details, functional features, and design elements.
* Push beyond standard gymwear designs to create distinctive, recognizable products.

**2. Technical Design & Tech Packs**

* Create detailed, manufacturer-ready tech packs for every approved product.
* Produce technical flats, garment measurements, construction details, stitching specifications, and material requirements.
* Specify fabric compositions, GSM, trims, washes, hardware, and finishing details.
* Develop measurement charts, grading specifications, and sizing standards.
* Ensure all technical documentation is accurate and production-ready.

**3. Fabric & Material Research**

* Research and source innovative fabrics, textiles, and materials.
* Experiment with different fabric weights, textures, compositions, and treatments.
* Identify opportunities for unique washes, dyeing techniques, distressing, embroidery, printing, and garment finishing.
* Continuously research new manufacturing techniques and apparel innovations.

**4. Market Research & Competitive Analysis**

* Regularly analyze leading bodybuilding, streetwear, and athletic apparel brands.
* Identify emerging trends, product opportunities, and gaps in the market.
* Research successful garment constructions and identify ways to create original alternatives.
* Stay ahead of industry developments and continuously bring new ideas to the team.

**5. Product Development & Sampling**

* Communicate directly with manufacturers and suppliers regarding product development.
* Oversee sample creation and evaluate fit, construction, materials, and overall quality.
* Provide detailed revisions and corrections to manufacturers.
* Manage products through multiple sampling stages until final approval.
* Ensure the finished garment matches the original creative and technical vision.

**6. Catalog Expansion & Creative Direction**

* Continuously expand Controlled Insanity's apparel catalog with new garment bases and product categories.
* Build a library of original, reusable garment silhouettes and construction concepts.
* Work alongside the creative and marketing teams to ensure products align with upcoming collections and brand direction.
* Help establish consistent design standards across all product categories.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who:

* Has professional experience in apparel design, technical design, or product development.
* Has extensive knowledge of garment construction, pattern development, and apparel manufacturing.
* Is highly proficient in creating professional tech packs.
* Has experience working with overseas and domestic manufacturers.
* Understands fabric compositions, GSM, garment washes, stitching, and construction techniques.
* Has a strong understanding of bodybuilding apparel, streetwear, and contemporary fashion.
* Is extremely creative and constantly generating new product ideas.
* Can work independently, identify opportunities, and take concepts from initial sketches to finished products.
* Has a strong portfolio demonstrating original garment development, technical drawings, and completed products.

Performance Expectations

* Consistently present new garment concepts and product innovations.
* Maintain a pipeline of new products and garment bases under development.
* Deliver accurate, detailed tech packs for approved designs.
* Maintain communication with manufacturers and monitor sampling progress.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve existing products and expand the catalog.
* Bring proactive ideas and creative solutions to the brand on an ongoing basis.

Pay: $60,000.00 - $70,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

title: Director of Instructional Design
description:

title: Head of YouTube (Strategy, Scripting & Team Lead)
description:
**IMPORTANT PLEASE READ THE FULL APPLICATION CAREFULLY. IF YOU MISS ANY OF THE ANSWER FIELDS YOU WILL BE AUTOMATICALLY DISQUALIFIED.**  
  
We're hiring a **Head of YouTube** to lead Richard Yu's channels and creative team. Richard teaches people how to build businesses selling digital and physical products through "AI Arbitrage"

### **✅ The challenge**

Our immediate goal is to grow the business channel from ~90,000 to 200,000+ subscribers in six months and bring average views per video above 100,000. These are aggressive goals. We want someone excited by that challenge, with a clear approach to choosing what to make, testing ideas and getting good videos out consistently.

You'll grow the top of the funnel by reaching new viewers who fit our audience. You'll also plan content for viewers who are getting to know Richard, learning about our offers and deciding whether to buy. Ultimately, we want this channel to grow the business, so views and subscribers need to translate into an audience we can serve.

You'll be responsible for what we make, why we make it, how we package and produce it, and whether it worked. You'll work directly with Richard and the leadership team to set direction, goals and KPI's and lead, hire and manage a creative team underneath.

**This is a senior creative strategist and operator role**.
  
  
You will write first-person, long-form scripts yourself, as well as review and improve other writers' work. You should be equally comfortable setting channel direction, giving specific feedback and getting videos published.

### **✅ What you'll own**

* **Strategy and ideation:** own the channel's growth goals, metrics and KPIs. Turn them into a clear plan for topics, formats and ideas, based on what our audience cares about and what we can learn from videos that perform well above their channel's usual results. Plan videos that bring in new viewers, build trust and help the right people take the next step.
* **Testing and learning:** build structured tests with a clear hypothesis, a useful comparison and defined success measures. Decide which tests are worth running, make sense of the results and apply what you learn to the next videos.
* **Packaging:** titles, thumbnail concepts and briefs, A/B tests, and repackaging decisions informed by CTR, retention and traffic sources.
* **Scripting:** write full scripts when needed, and edit and quality-check every script before Richard films it. Build strong hooks, story structure, pacing, curiosity and payoffs that keep people watching. Deliver the title's promise in a natural voice, with concrete examples and verified claims.
* **Production:** give editors specific feedback from the first cut, set clear standards and make sure each video meets them.
* **Analytics:** review what worked, what didn't and what to change next. Track subscriber growth, views and audience quality alongside the channel's contribution to leads and sales, working with the wider marketing team. Be clear about which results we can attribute to YouTube and where we’re still making assumptions.
* **Team:** hire, onboard and manage editors, designers and writers. Coach people to improve and write procedures and checklists that help the team make good decisions independently.

### **✅ Who will do well here**

You have a deep passion for YouTube (storytelling and psychology), and an understanding of channel growth. You can explain why a topic, format, title, thumbnail or script works: what earns the click, what keeps someone watching and what makes them return. You can turn that understanding into work that performs.

You are excited about taking on ambitious goals and being responsible for the results. You track progress honestly, work out what's holding us back and come with ideas for fixing it. You learn quickly, ask for feedback and change your approach when the evidence calls for it.

Strong business judgment, an understanding of marketing funnels and experience in Infopreneurship, online education or Edutech are major advantages. We’ll weigh that experience heavily. We’ll also consider an exceptional YouTube leader who can learn our audience, offers and funnel quickly.

This is a full-time role for someone who wants to focus on one business and take responsibility for both the creative work and the team.

### **✅ Hiring process**

Application, Zoom call, paid test project, final interview, offer. For your application, share existing work you are allowed to share; no new script or channel audit is required at this stage.

### **✅ How to apply**

Review Richard’s business YouTube channel and browse the other channels/accounts linked there for context.
  
  
**IMPORTANT TO BE CONSIDERED YOU MUST SHARE A 3–5 MINUTE VIDEO COVERING:**

**1. Your background and motivation:** Briefly introduce yourself, your role on the YouTube channels you’ve worked on and the results you’re most proud of. What excites you about this opportunity, and why do you want this particular role working with Richard Yu?

**2. Your growth philosophy:** How do you approach growing a business YouTube channel like ours? Which metrics matter most, and why?

**3. Your read on our channel and your first 30 days:** What are we doing well, and what most needs to improve to reach 200k+ subscribers in six months and average over 100k views per video? Briefly explain your reasoning and what you would focus on in your first 30 days. Tell us what you can judge from the public channel and what you’d need to learn from our analytics or team. One or two meaningful observations are enough.

**4. Your leadership:** What creative teams have you led? Share one brief example of a difficult leadership decision, how you handled it and what happened.

Keep it conversational and focus on what matters most. You don’t need slides, a detailed audit or a strategy deck. We want to understand you, your judgment and how you work. Please check that your Loom link is accessible.

 **Requirements**  

* + - * + - * + **You’ve grown a YouTube channel and can show the results and your contribution.** We strongly prefer experience in business, making money online, finance or startups. We’ll also consider strong results in tech, personal growth, edutainment or entertainment.
              + Deep passion for YouTube and demonstrated understanding of storytelling and channel growth. Show us published long-form work and explain what you contributed.
              + Strong creative judgment across topics, formats, ideation, titles and thumbnails. You can explain why people click, keep watching and return.
              + Deep understanding of a winning script: hooks, narrative structure, pacing, curiosity, clear explanations and satisfying payoffs. Ability and willingness to write complete first-person, talking-head scripts and improve another writer's work.
              + A structured approach to testing: clear hypotheses, useful comparisons, defined success measures and sound interpretation of results.
              + Ownership of goals, metrics and KPIs. Strong command of CTR, average view duration, retention graphs, traffic sources and channel growth metrics, with examples of how you used them to make decisions.
              + Experience managing editors and/or designers, setting clear standards, giving specific feedback and helping people improve.
              + You learn quickly, ask good questions and take direct feedback well. You can get up to speed on a new audience, subject and business model.
              + Strong business judgment and experience with marketing funnels, infopreneurship, online education or edusoftware are highly valued. A record of connecting content to leads or sales is a strong advantage. These are not prerequisites for an exceptional YouTube candidate who can learn this side quickly.
              + Fluent spoken and written English is essential. You must be able to write natural, compelling English scripts and communicate clearly with Richard and the team.
              + Confidence using without over-reliance on AI tools, particularly Claude/Codex. You still take responsibility for the voice, accuracy and claims in the finished work.
              + Full-time availability and at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern working hours.
              + Remote: we welcome candidates across the United States, Canada, the UK, Europe, Mexico, Central America and South America, including Spain, Portugal, France, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, Brazil, Panama, Colombia, Argentina and Costa Rica. Exceptional candidates elsewhere are also welcome. What matters is strong YouTube judgment, fluent English and reliable overlap with US Eastern working hours.

  
**Benefits**  

* + **A meaningful challenge.** Help grow a brand with audacious goals, including taking our business channel to 200k+ subscribers in six months and averaging over 100k views per video. Your work will directly shape how we reach people, earn their trust and grow the business.
  + **Real ownership and influence.** We value input from everyone, and few things are off-limits to thoughtful questioning. Bring your perspective, question assumptions and propose better approaches. We listen to good reasoning and are willing to change direction when the evidence supports it. Your ideas and what you learn through testing can influence the broader business.
  + **A team invested in your growth.** We want this to be one of the biggest personal and professional growth experiences of your life. You’ll work directly with Richard and the rest of the leadership team, get honest feedback and take on challenges that stretch your thinking, creative judgment and leadership. We set high standards, and we’re here to help you reach them.
  + **$75,000–$150,000 USD annually plus performance bonuses for exceptional results, in a fully remote, full-time role with reliable overlap with US Eastern working hours.**

title: Director of Design Execution
description:
### **About Switch**

At Switch, we don't just design, build and operate data centers—we are enabling the technology of the future. Led by Founder & CEO, Rob Roy, we believe in revolutionary innovation, operational excellence and the principle of karma. Switch is where talented people come together to EVOLVE the digital world.

We believe that innovation isn't just about technology—it's about the people, culture, and purpose that make it happen. Every Switch team member contributes to a mission greater than themselves: to create the world's most advanced digital infrastructure that powers the progress of humanity.

**The Role: Director of Design Execution**
------------------------------------------

The Director of Design Execution provides enterprise leadership for the practical execution, technical coordination, and field validation of data center designs across Switch's project portfolio. This role leads the team responsible for translating design intent into solutions that are safe, constructible, commissionable, operable, maintainable, and repeatable.

You will lead Design Execution from post-design handoff through construction, commissioning, turnover, and operational readiness while providing technical support throughout the infrastructure lifecycle. You will establish engineering governance, execution standards, decision and escalation processes, and feedback mechanisms that improve reliability and consistency across regions.

This role leads a team of technical subject matter experts and manages supporting third-party consultants and contractors. You will also partner closely with Design Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Operations, EHS, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders to improve project delivery and turn field experience into standards and lessons learned for future projects.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Lead and develop the Design Execution team, including technical subject matter experts and supporting third-party consultants and contractors.
* Set team priorities, allocate resources, establish performance expectations, and provide coaching and development.
* Lead Design Execution activities across the project lifecycle, including design handoff, construction, commissioning, turnover, operations support, infrastructure improvements, and end-of-life planning.
* Establish and maintain the engineering governance framework for post-IFC execution, including handoff requirements, engineering decision management, escalation pathways, design-change oversight, performance metrics, and continuous improvement.
* Translate design intent into practical field execution requirements that support constructability, commissioning, maintainability, and operational readiness.
* Oversee resolution of construction and field engineering issues, including complex procedure reviews, critical equipment concerns, and technical event support.
* Oversee engineering solutions for upgrades and retrofits that increase capacity, availability, efficiency, reliability, or operational capability across existing data centers.
* Provide technical leadership for electrical and mechanical infrastructure, including transformers, generators, UPS systems, power distribution, HVAC and cooling systems, controls, and related critical infrastructure.
* Review and interpret construction drawings, wiring diagrams, schematics, sequences of operation, specifications, submittals, and other engineering documentation.
* Partner with Design Engineering to translate field experience, operational feedback, commissioning results, and lessons learned into improved standards and future designs.
* Coordinate with Construction, Commissioning, Operations, EHS, and other stakeholders to maintain consistent technical and execution standards across projects.
* Manage engineering consultants, vendors, contractors, and other external technical resources supporting Design Execution.
* Establish processes, procedures, and tools that enable consistent execution and support customer and project requirements across data center campuses.
* Establish and monitor Design Execution performance metrics and provide project, risk, and program updates to senior leadership.
* Lead assigned engineering projects and programs and ensure delivery against schedule, budget, quality, and operational requirements.
* Coordinate maintenance windows and implementation activities with facility leadership to minimize operational disruption.
* Ensure Design Execution activities comply with applicable codes, regulations, Switch requirements, and safety standards, including NFPA 70E requirements where applicable.
* Support Operations during turnover, customer-impacting events, near misses, and other complex technical situations.
* Identify systemic issues, recurring field challenges, and opportunities to improve execution, reliability, efficiency, and cost.
* Build strong working relationships across Operations, Finance, Legal, Construction, Commissioning, Design Engineering, and other stakeholders.
* Maintain an active field presence to understand conditions firsthand and validate that solutions can be executed as intended.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* You lead technical teams with clear expectations, accountability, coaching, and consistent follow-through.
* You make sound engineering decisions while balancing safety, reliability, constructability, cost, schedule, and operational impact.
* You can make informed recommendations when technical information is incomplete or conditions are changing.
* You identify design and execution risks early and develop practical solutions before they affect project or operational outcomes.
* You communicate complex engineering issues clearly to technical teams, business partners, and senior leadership.
* You build alignment across Design Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Operations, and external partners.
* You establish standards and governance that improve consistency without creating unnecessary barriers to execution.
* You use field experience, data, root cause analysis, and lessons learned to drive continuous improvement.
* You develop internal talent while holding consultants, contractors, and other external resources accountable for quality and results.
* You are comfortable spending time in the field to understand problems firsthand and validate solutions.
* You demonstrate the judgment, accountability, collaboration, and leadership expected under Switch's Culture Codes.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of progressive engineering experience supporting industrial, commercial, or mission-critical facilities such as data centers, power generation, or oil and gas facilities.
* 5+ years of experience leading engineering teams, technical professionals, consultants, or comparable resources.
* 4+ years of project management experience supporting data center engineering or comparable mission-critical infrastructure.
* Deep understanding of electrical and mechanical systems used in mission-critical environments, including power distribution, transformers, generators, switchgear, UPS systems, cooling systems, HVAC, controls, and fire protection.
* Experience leading or supporting construction, commissioning, turnover, operational readiness, retrofit, or infrastructure improvement activities.
* Experience managing engineering projects, consultants, contractors, and other external technical resources.
* Experience reading, interpreting, and reviewing construction drawings, specifications, submittals, wiring diagrams, schematics, sequences of operation, and MEP documentation.
* Experience with EPMS, SCADA, BMS, or comparable monitoring and controls systems.
* Strong knowledge of safety requirements and applicable OSHA standards for multi-megawatt or mission-critical facilities.
* Working knowledge of NFPA 70E and electrical safety requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute solutions for complex engineering and operational problems.
* Strong project and program management, prioritization, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Experience using engineering, project management, calculation, data analysis, and collaboration tools.
* Ability to support after-hours or weekend activities when required for critical projects, maintenance windows, commissioning, or operational events.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally as business needs require.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
* Professional Engineer registration or other relevant professional engineering certification.
* Experience leading enterprise or multi-region engineering programs within data centers or other mission-critical environments.
* Experience establishing engineering governance, technical standards, design-change processes, or post-IFC execution frameworks.
* Experience supporting root cause analysis, fleet optimization, lifecycle management, and infrastructure reliability programs.

We recognize that qualified candidates may not meet every preferred qualification. If your experience aligns with the core responsibilities of the role, we encourage you to apply.

### **Why Switch?**

title: Director of Product Design
description:
Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

Beacon Biosignals is seeking a Director of Product Design to lead and grow our Product Design function. Product Design at Beacon is a shared function that serves the entire business: the hardware experience of our EEG headbands and other devices, the mobile apps that participants and patients use at home, the web applications that clinical teams and trial sponsors rely on, the printed materials that guide patients and site staff, and the design of internal business processes across logistics, support, and clinical operations. In this role you'll lead a team of three senior product designers, set the vision for how design works at Beacon, and plan the function's growth as the company scales. We expect this role to stay close to the craft. You'll model best practices directly alongside the team, not just direct it from above. This role reports directly to Beacon's VP of Platform.

Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first-class remote work experience, but we also have in-person office hubs located in Boston, New York City, and Paris. For this position, candidates based in the Boston or surrounding area are preferred

**What success looks like:**

As a successful Director of Product Design at Beacon, you'll...

* Lead and coach a team of three senior product designers, helping each of them grow their craft, expand their impact, and build a clear path forward in their careers.
* Craft, iterate, and execute on a vision for what product design should be at Beacon, and translate that vision into a concrete plan for how the function grows alongside the business.
* Operate as a player-coach, particularly in your first year: taking on design work yourself where it sets the standard, demonstrating the practices you want to see, and raising the bar by example rather than by directive.
* Own prioritization across the full breadth of Beacon's design surface, from device and mobile to web, print, and business process, making the tradeoffs that determine where a small, senior team spends its time and ensuring no single designer becomes a bottleneck for the company.
* Build the cross-functional connections that design depends on, partnering closely with Device Engineering, Platform, Clinical Operations, Logistics, Support, and Quality to bring design into decisions early rather than at the end.
* Establish the processes, standards, and shared systems that let design scale: a coherent design language across hardware and software, reusable patterns, and design reviews that improve quality without slowing delivery.
* Ensure design's contribution to Beacon's regulated products is rigorous and well-documented, partnering with Quality and Regulatory on usability and human factors work for our cleared devices.
* Own the headcount plan, budget, and vendor relationships for the function, and make the case for investment in design with the same rigor you'd bring to a design problem.
* Develop a deep understanding of everyone Beacon serves: patients using our devices unsupervised at home, the clinical staff and healthcare providers who care for them, the site teams running trials, and the sponsors who rely on the insights we deliver. Build the research practice that keeps that understanding current.
* Develop an equally deep understanding of how Beacon itself operates, so that design serves our internal teams as well as our external users, from device provisioning and logistics through support and scientific services.
* See around corners: anticipate where design debt, inconsistency, or unowned experience problems are accumulating, and address them before they become urgent.

**What you will bring:**

* 10+ years of product design experience, including 4+ years managing and developing designers.
* Experience building or substantially maturing a design function. You know what the first eighteen months of that work actually look like.
* A portfolio that spans both hardware and software experiences. You're comfortable moving between a physical device, a mobile app, a data-heavy web application, and the printed material that ties them together.
* You have experience and familiarity working in the medical device space, clinical diagnostics, real-world-data, pharma/biotech or other related fields.
* You've worked in a regulated industry before, and have successfully navigated the tension between fast-paced iterative design and strict design controls. Familiarity with usability engineering and human factors practice (e.g. IEC 62366, FDA human factors guidance) is a strong plus.
* You're genuinely energized by coaching senior individual contributors. You can give feedback that a strong, experienced designer will respect and act on.
* You're comfortable being hands-on without defaulting to it. You know the difference between modeling the work and doing the work because it's easier than delegating it.
* Experience designing service and business process experiences, not just product interfaces. You've improved how an organization operates, not only what it ships.
* You bring strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align partners around decisions, tradeoffs, and evolving plans, including in regulated or quality-sensitive environments.
* You demonstrate a bias towards simplicity, avoid misallocating complexity, and try to impose structure at the right time - not too early or too late.
* You're comfortable working in a highly asynchronous remote work environment, and have demonstrated success doing so in the past.

The base salary range for this role is $200,000 - $215,000, depending on past experience, specific skills, and qualifications. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO, and other benefits.

At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and - most of all - a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

title: Director, Dealers and Design - Central
description:
**Job Description:**

The Director, Dealers and Design is responsible for leading and partnering with our field team to develop and grow our Residential, Dealer Segment, and Residential A&D Channel business within the **Central region**.

The leader in this role will work collaboratively to develop territory plans and sales strategies, while working independently and in team-selling scenarios to pursue business development opportunities, lead complex sales pursuits, and manage key accounts.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

**Strategic Sales Development & Execution**

* Develop and execute strategic account and territory plans focused on key accounts, residential design firms, and business development opportunities where Cambria has limited penetration or significant growth opportunity.
* Establish and define a list of strong existing dealers and A&D in your territory that you will ensure stay up to date and grow their mind share and wallet share.
* Identify, pursue, and win net-new business with national accounts, buying groups, specialty markets, and high-value targets within each dealer segment business channel.
* Establish executive and senior-level relationships with top-level decision-makers, purchasing managers, and key influencers across the residential ecosystem.
* Represent Cambria at local, regional, and national trade shows and industry events.

**Field Leadership, Coaching & Mentoring**

* Drive Cambria sales by training, coaching, and mentoring Market Representatives, Showroom/Gallery Managers, and District Managers in a defined region.
* Coach, develop, and mentor field sales teams on best practices for approaching and working within the residential segment by modeling successful use of tools, playbooks, resources, and strategies.
* Provide ongoing training, support, and education to guide field sales teams in their approach to residential business development within the Dealer Segment and Residential A&D Channels.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Field Engagement**

* Partner closely with the Regional Vice President, District Managers, and Market Representatives within the assigned region to align on the development and execution of territory plans and growth initiatives.
* Travel frequently with Market Representatives, District Managers, and Cambria’s SDC Showrooms and Galleries to educate and mentor team members on segment best practices.

**Qualifications & Skills:**

* Proven track record in building material sales and the interior design industry, with strong customer-focused sales skills and the ability to track and close business.
* Demonstrated experience in B2B sales, specification, or design-focused sales channels.
* Exceptional interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills to build strong professional relationships, inspire teams, and gain internal and external support.
* Strong critical thinking, organizational, and calendar management skills, backed by disciplined CRM tracking and timely follow-up.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to work independently from a home office while effectively managing travel across an assigned territory.
* High degree of professionalism, integrity, and fiscal responsibility.

**Minimum Requirements:**

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree preferred.

**Experience:** 5+ years of industry sales experience required.

**Systems:** Google Workspace, Microsoft Office Suite, and Salesforce proficiency required.

**Travel Requirements:** This position will require up to 70% travel within the region for events, meetings, trade shows, and Field Sales training. The candidate must be able to work extended hours, evenings, overnights, and weekends. This role does not require a company vehicle.

* Must hold a valid Driver’s License.
* Must be able to successfully pass a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) check in accordance with Cambria's standards.

**Physical Requirements:** The candidate must be able to lift up to 50 pounds, set up and tear down marketing materials, and meet requirements to attend in-person meetings.

Cambria’s starting salary range for this position is $110,438 - $154,453 Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the target for new hires for the position. Individual pay is determined by several factors, including work location, job-related experience, and relevant education and/or training.

Cambria offers a competitive benefits package that encompasses Health and Dental Insurance, Paid Time Off, 7 paid Holidays , 401(k) plus matching, Discretionary Profit Sharing, Flexible Spending Account; Life, Supplemental Life, and Disability Insurance; Referral Program, Tuition Reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program, Employee Discount and Professional Development Assistance.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

title: Director, Design
description:
**About Plenful**
Plenful is on a mission to transform healthcare operations from the inside out. Fresh off our $50M Series B and backed by Notable Capital, Bessemer Venture Partners, TQ Ventures, Susa/Kivu Ventures, and other leading investors, we’re building the category-defining AI automation platform that healthcare teams rely on to operate smarter, faster, and more efficiently. Our technology empowers healthcare operators across hospital and health systems, pharmacies and payors to eliminate manual work, reduce administrative burden, and improve compliance, all while unlocking critical revenue to fund programs for their in-need patient populations.
  
  
Built by healthcare operators for healthcare operators, Plenful is driven by a deep understanding of the challenges facing today’s care teams. We’re passionate about equipping healthcare workers with world-class tools that deliver real, measurable impact, and we’re proud to serve 100+ leading health systems, pharmacies, and healthcare organizations across the country. If you’re excited to help shape the future of healthcare, we’d love to meet you. Apply now to join our growing team.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a Director of Design to lead and grow Plenful’s design team. You’ll set design direction across our products and partner with Product and Engineering leadership to shape what we build, how it works, and how we know it is helping customers.
  
  
This is a player-coach role. You’ll grow the design team, shape product direction, and stay hands-on with the most important customer problems. You’ll also define how design works in an AI-native organization, moving from insight to working software faster while protecting quality and trust.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Set design strategy across Plenful’s products, partnering with Product and Engineering to choose work by customer impact, business value, and risk.
* Lead customer discovery and testing. Turn complex healthcare workflows into clear, dependable experiences, including thoughtful handoffs between people, automation, and AI.
* Establish an AI-native design practice: use AI tools, code, and agents to explore ideas, build working prototypes, and move validated solutions toward production. Use the speed to learn faster and make better product decisions.
* Coach and grow designers, build future design leaders, and create an operating model that keeps design focused, collaborative, and responsive as Plenful scales.
* Evolve the design system and reusable patterns so teams can deliver consistent, high-quality experiences across products.
* Show how design affects customer outcomes, adoption, and trust, and use that evidence to guide what the team does next.

**You May Be a Fit If**

* You have led and grown product design teams at hyper-growth companies, and know how to keep quality high as the business and product surface area expand.
* Your portfolio shows strong product judgment and craft across complex B2B software, multi-step workflows, and systems with different user needs.
* You connect design choices to customer and business outcomes, and can explain the tradeoffs clearly.
* You use research and testing to simplify complex products and choose the right level of design depth for the decision.
* You have hands-on experience using AI, code, or agents in design and product development, and good judgment about where AI helps or should stay out of the experience.
* You have built design systems or practices that help teams move quickly without making design a bottleneck.
* Experience in healthcare, workflow automation, or another complex and regulated domain is helpful.

**Why You'll Love Working Here**

* 🚀 Mission-Driven, World-Class Team — Join an exceptional group of professionals aligned around a meaningful mission and committed to making an impact
* 📈 Opportunities for Growth — Strengthen your expertise through collaboration with experienced, high-performing leaders across the organization
* 🏢 Flexible Hybrid Work Environment — We're remote-first, with meaningful office presence in San Francisco and New York. R&D roles follow a hybrid model, with two days per week in our San Francisco office

**Benefits & Perks**

* 🏥 Healthcare Coverage — Full medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and participation for your family
* 💰 401(k) with Company Match — Plenful matches 50% of your first 3% contributed
* 📊 Equity — Every full-time employee shares in our success
* 🌴 Unlimited PTO — Take the time you need, when you need it
* 🍽️ Daily Lunch Stipend — $100/week to cover your midday meals
* 💪 Wellness Stipend — $100/month to support your health and well-being
* 🚇 Commuter Benefits — $100/month for SF and NYC-based employees
* 👶 Parental Leave — Paid leave to support growing families

**Compensation**
The compensation range for this position reflects the average span for this role. Where an offer lands depends on your experience, qualifications, and interview performance, measured against Plenful’s internal leveling guidelines and market benchmarks. We set offers individually.
  
  
This role is also eligible to participate in Plenful’s equity plan, subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.
